title: Account Development Representative, UK
descriptionHtml:
Who We Are

Cint is a pioneer in research technology (ResTech). Our customers use the Cint platform to post questions and get answers from real people to build business strategies, confidently publish research, accurately measure the impact of digital advertising, and more. The Cint platform is built on a programmatic marketplace, which is the world’s largest, with nearly 300 million respondents in over 150 countries who consent to sharing their opinions, motivations, and behaviors.

We are feeding the world’s curiosity!

  

Job Description

The Opportunity:

Cint delivers powerful answers, driven by the sentiments of real people. Everyone benefits from data-driven knowledge – whether you’re conducting market research, polling, or seeking to better understand advertising campaigns and brand lift. Lucid Media Measurement is a rapidly growing team built to solve the challenges in advertising research by bringing scale, speed, accuracy, flexibility, and quality to marketing studies. Cint seeks an experienced Account Development Representative to work closely with our sales team in supporting new and existing measurement customers, such as Netflix, Spotify, and Amazon.

This role is open to candidates living in London to work remotely or from our London HQ in Shoreditch.

Responsibilities:

  • Develop and strengthen relationships with clients by advising them on pricing and feasibility for media measurement projects

  • Become familiar with CINT proprietary software and the research technology industry

  • Sell media measurement projects by being quick, accurate, and consultative

  • Effectively partner with clients to resolve their project needs via e-mail, phone, video, and in person meetings (if required)

  • Assist account managers and other business functions to achieve the determined revenue goals

  • Document interactions with clients in Salesforce

What we look for:

  • Independent thinkers and self-starters

  • Understanding and curiosity for how advertising is measured and optimized

  • Tech savvy and forward-thinking

  • Collaborative teammates that enjoy working with a diverse collection of colleagues and partners

  • Excitement for prospecting, outreach, and developing client-focused solutions

 

Qualifications

  • 1+ years of Account Management experience in sales/account development in the Media or Advertising space, including verticals such as Agencies, Publishers, Platforms, or Ad Tech brands

  • Thrives in a client-facing role and a fast-paced environment

  • Excellent communication, numerical, and interpersonal skills

  • Enjoys solving problems and prefers analytical methods

  • Attentive to detail and has the ability to multitask and prioritize

  • BA/BS Degree

title: Account Executive - Cross Industries
descriptionHtml:
Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI. At our core is the Celonis Context Model — which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence into a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can actually understand, turning AI's operational blind spots into operational clarity. World's leading companies trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. We believe there's a massive opportunity to unlock global productivity and sustainability by giving AI the context to understand how every business process really works. Join our mission to make processes work for people, companies, and the planet.

The Team:

You will join our high-performing Swiss sales team. We help leading enterprise organizations in Switzerland optimize their end-to-end processes, increase operational efficiency through our Process Intelligence platform, and provide the contextual layer to industrialize Enterprise AI.

The Role:

Applying a value-driven consultative sales approach, you will build and grow relationships to drive sales cycles from discovery to value realization. You will be responsible for a portfolio of enterprise accounts headquartered in Switzerland, combining existing customers, where you will expand our footprint, with new / greenfield accounts, where you will win new logos for Celonis. Navigating complex organizations from operational leaders up to the C-suite, you will collaborate cross-functionally to understand your accounts' needs and drive the end-to-end sales cycle to a successful close.

The work you'll do:

●    Manage a balanced portfolio of existing customers (land-and-expand) and new / greenfield accounts (new logo acquisition)
●    Build pipeline in greenfield accounts through targeted prospecting and account planning
●    Engage stakeholders across lines of business, from operational leaders up to C-level
●    Drive Celonis Process Intelligence sales motions across the core enterprise value chain, translating business challenges into compelling, AI-enabled use cases that deliver measurable execution capacity
●    Hold an individual revenue target for closing six-figure+ deals within your accounts
●    Engage closely with partners e.g., consulting firms and SaaS vendors
●    Drive sales cycles through orchestrating virtual teams including business development representatives, marketing managers, partner managers, sales engineers / pre-sales, customer success managers, professional services, implementation partners...
●    Grow your skills through structured enablement, coaching and close collaboration with experienced Strategic Account Executives and your Sales Manager

The qualifications you need:

●    3+ years of relevant experience in either one - or ideally both - of the following domains:
○   SaaS Sales: Track record of applying a consultative sales approach to sell complex B2B software solutions to enterprise accounts, ideally with experience in both expanding existing customers and winning new logos.
○    AI / Management Consulting: Experience in a (boutique) consultancy, delivering AI or digital transformation projects with exposure to account management, client relationships, and business development.
●    A track record of meeting or exceeding targets, commitment, and successful career progression with your previous companies
●    A hunter mentality: proven ability to prospect, open doors and build pipeline in new accounts
●    Strong business acumen and a solid understanding of core processes and KPIs across the enterprise value chain (e.g., Finance, Procurement, Supply Chain)
●    Curiosity and the ability to quickly understand different industries and business models
●    Ability to build trusted relationships with Business and IT stakeholders and the confidence to engage up to the C-level
●    Grit, a hands-on mindset, strong discovery skills and a structured approach to running sales processes
●    Excellent communication and presentation skills in German (fluent) and English
●    Eagerness to learn and develop, open to feedback and coaching
●    Ability to adapt to a fast moving, ever changing, high growth environment and approach challenges with positivity, creative thinking, and a growth mindset
●    Willingness to be collaborative, inclusive, to embrace diversity and to have strong interpersonal skills #differentmakesusbetter
●    Ability to leverage internal resources and work as a team #bestteamwins

Zurich area location preferred; candidates based elsewhere in Switzerland must be available for weekly in-person presence and customer visits (primarily in German-speaking Switzerland).

#LI-SS6

What Celonis can offer you:

  • Pioneer Innovation: Work with the global leader in Process Mining and the Process Intelligence Graph to shape the future of AI-driven business operations.
  • Ownership from Day 1: Every full-time "Celonaut" is an owner, receiving Restricted Stock Units (RSUs) and merit-based refresh grants.
  • Unrivaled Family Support: Benefit from our inclusive parental leave policy—24 weeks of fully paid leave for primary carers and 12 weeks for supporting carers, available from your first day of employment.
  • Work-Life Integration: Enjoy Unlimited PTO (in applicable regions) and generous PTO globally, as well as a flexible hybrid work model that balances remote focus with vibrant office collaboration.
  • Continuous Growth: Elevate your skills through our 70-20-10 learning framework, mentorship programs, and access to a dedicated learning platform.
  • Holistic Well-being: Prioritize your health with subsidized Wellhub memberships, mental health counseling, and dedicated "Wellness Weeks" that prioritize work/life balance.
  • Drive Sustainability: Participate in annual Impact Days, where you receive paid time off to volunteer for community and environmental causes with your local office, or virtually.
  • Global Inclusion & Belonging: Find community through our Inclusion Think Tank and participate in our annual Inclusion Days, ensuring every voice is heard and valued.
  • Value-Driven Impact: Join a mission-led organization where our core values—Live for Customer Value, The Best Team Wins, We Own It, and Earth Is Our Future—drive every decision.

About Us:

Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI, empowering organizations to analyze, design, and operate AI-driven processes. The Celonis Platform is powered by the Celonis Context Model, which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence to create a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can understand — turning AI’s operational blind spots into operational clarity. Industry-leading companies around the world trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. Celonis is headquartered in Munich, Germany, and New York City, USA, with more than 20 offices worldwide.

Get familiar with the Celonis Process Intelligence Platform by watching this video.

Celonis Inclusion Statement:

At Celonis, we believe our people make us who we are and that “The Best Team Wins”. We know that the best teams are made up of people who bring different perspectives to the table. And when everyone feels included, able to speak up and knows their voice is heard - that's when creativity and innovation happen.

Your Privacy:

Any information you submit to Celonis as part of your application will be processed in accordance with Celonis’ Accessibility and Candidate Notices

By submitting this application, you confirm that you agree to the storing and processing of your personal data by Celonis as described in our Privacy Notice for the Application and Hiring Process.

Use of Artificial Intelligence Tools

We rely on an artificial intelligence tool to match the information from your resume to the relevant Celonis job descriptions. This processing is limited to the information provided in your resume or in your candidate profile. The tool produces a match score per candidate for a role, suggests preliminary ranking, and provides recommendations.

The tool is only used for support in parts of the job application process, including to facilitate the identification of the relevant Celonis Jobs for candidates and recruiters. All final decisions are made by hiring managers and the Celonis talent acquisition team. Hiring managers and HR specialists use this tool responsibly, are aware of the risk of potential bias, and are equipped to mitigate it.

Please be aware of common job offer scams, impersonators and frauds. Learn more here.

title: Account Executive Data & AI
descriptionHtml:
Een strategische dealmaker die organisaties helpt grenzen te verleggen met Data en AI

Organisaties in het Corporate en Enterprise domein staan voor complexe digitale transformaties waarin Data en AI niet langer bijzaak zijn, maar de kern vormen van toekomstig concurrentievermogen. Als Account Executive (Data & AI) ben jij de commerciële en strategische sparringpartner die bij beslissers op CIO- en businessniveau de juiste deuren opent. Je doorgrondt zakelijke uitdagingen, ziet kansen waar anderen obstakels ervaren en vertaalt complexe vraagstukken naar concrete IT-oplossingen.

De uitdaging: Vernieuwing en groei gedreven door Data & AI

In deze rol speel je een sleutelrol in het uitbreiden van ons klantennetwerk binnen de Nederlandse Corporate en Enterprise markt. Als Account Executive (Data & AI) focus je op het scherp positioneren van onze Data- en AI-proposities, aangevuld met onze expertise op het gebied van Business Automation, IT Modernization en Staffing Solutions. Je bent intern bij LINKIT verantwoordelijk voor het gehele traject van acquisitie tot deal-closing en werkt hierin nauw samen met onze expertiseteams en marketing (ABM). Je taken omvatten onder meer:

  • Initiëren van ingangen en genereren van hoogwaardige leads via gerichte acquisitie op named accounts.

  • Opbouwen en beheren van een solide salespijplijn door duurzame relaties te ontwikkelen op C-level en businessniveau.

  • Optreden als consultative selling partner die strategische vraagstukken vertaalt naar haalbare digitale oplossingen.

  • Regie voeren over het commerciële proces en het binnenhalen van nieuwe, toonaangevende opdrachtgevers.

  • Nauw samenwerken met onze Business Consultants, Project Office en expertiseteams om proposities naadloos aan te laten sluiten bij de klantbehoefte.

Je plek

Je maakt deel uit van het commerciële team binnen LINKIT en werkt intensief samen met de Data Engineering en Business Consultancy squads. Onze Explorers delen voortdurend kennis om elkaar én onze klanten naar een hoger niveau te tillen. Om de week op vrijdag komen we met het hele bedrijf samen op ons hoofdkantoor in De Meern voor de clubdag: een vaste dag die in het teken staat van kennisdeling, persoonlijke ontwikkeling en verbinding.


Wat we vragen

  • Minimaal 3 jaar bewezen saleservaring binnen specifiek Data- en/of AI-proposities in IT of zakelijke dienstverlening.

  • Afgeronde hbo- of wo-opleiding met een sterk analytisch en commercieel denkniveau.

  • Aantoonbare ervaring met consultative selling en zakendoen op C-level/CIO-niveau binnen het Corporate en Enterprise segment.

  • Zelfstartend, resultaatgericht en commercieel gedreven met sterke netwerkkwaliteiten.

  • Uitstekende beheersing van de Nederlandse en Engelse taal in woord en geschrift.

Voldoe je niet aan elk punt, maar wel nieuwsgierig? Dan komen we alsnog graag met je in contact.

Wat je krijgt

  • OTE tot €120k per jaar (o.b.v. 40 uur, afhankelijk van kennis & ervaring) + 8% vakantiegeld.

  • Jaarlijkse winstdeling en pensioenregeling.

  • Hybride werken: op ons hoofdkantoor in De Meern, bij de klant of vanuit huis.

  • 25 vakantiedagen en de mogelijkheid om tijdelijk vanuit het buitenland te werken.

  • Elektrische leaseauto of mobiliteitsvergoeding.

  • Netto thuiswerkvergoeding, een goed ingerichte thuiswerkplek en een laptop en telefoon, die je ook privé kunt gebruiken.

  • Om de twee weken op vrijdag komen alle collega's terug naar ons hoofdkantoor in De Meern, dan investeren wij tot 10% van jouw werktijd in kennisdeling, leren en verbinden dit noemen wij de ‘clubdag’).

  • Extra's zoals onbeperkt opleidingsbudget, dagelijkse verse lunch, jaarlijks wintersport en wellbeing-activiteiten, zoals een wijnproeverij en yoga.

Sollicitatieprocedure

We willen je leren kennen, en jij ons. Daarom houden we het persoonlijk en concreet.

  1. Kennismaking: Een eerste gesprek over wie je bent, wat je drijft en of er een match is.

  2. Verdiepende gesprekken: Twee gesprekken over je ervaring, werkwijze en hoe jij past binnen het team en LINKIT.

  3. Aanbieding: Als het klikt, volgt een concreet aanbod.

Heb je vragen vooraf? Neem gerust contact op met Michiel via

Over ons

LINKIT is opgericht in 1998 en gegroeid van IT-bemiddelaar naar kennisgedreven IT-organisatie, met ruim 250 Explorers uit meer dan 25 nationaliteiten. We werken voor grote organisaties in overheid, finance en logistiek als partner die meedenkt van vraagstuk tot oplossing.

Als Account Executive (Data & AI) geef je mede vorm aan de verdere commerciële groei en impact van onze organisatie.

Rethink it with LINKIT

title: Account Executive, France
descriptionHtml:
At OneStream, we're on a mission to empower every Finance organization and professional to exceed their potential. Our global teams span continents, cultures, and time zones, united by a shared purpose as we build the operating system for modern Finance and help organizations move with greater speed, clarity, and confidence.

That mission comes to life through our people. Behind every innovation, customer success, and milestone are talented people working together to make a difference. That's why we're looking for people who are bold enough to think big, authentic in how they lead and collaborate, curious about what's possible, and committed to delivering results.

Want a closer look before you apply? Explore our Careers site to learn more about our people, culture, and benefits.

Summary

An Account Executive is responsible for driving new business growth within a defined territory. The role focuses on identifying, developing, and closing net-new customer opportunities, with a strategic emphasis on expanding OneStream’s footprint into untapped markets and organizations. The Account Executive takes full ownership of pipeline generation and progression, leveraging a consultative, value-based sales approach to demonstrate how OneStream’s SaaS platform addresses complex business needs. This individual is responsible for engaging C-level stakeholders, navigating enterprise sales cycles, and building strong, trust-based relationships with prospective clients.

Success in the role requires a strong hunter mentality with proven ability to build pipelines from scratch through outbound prospecting, partner collaboration, and disciplined follow-up. A self-starter with a deep understanding of the financial and operational challenges facing modern enterprises, and a passion for winning new business. The Account Executive collaborates cross-functionally with Marketing, Pre-Sales, Business Development, and Strategic Alliances to maximize market reach and accelerate deal velocity. While some collaboration with existing accounts may occur, the primary focus of this role remains new logo acquisition and revenue growth. This role focuses primarily on commercial and mid-market accounts, targeting organizations with significant finance transformation needs and strong executive sponsorship.

Primary Duties & Responsibilities

  • New Business Development: Drive new logo acquisition through strategic prospecting, outbound outreach, marketing leads, and partner referrals.
  • Account Expansion: Identify upsell and cross-sell opportunities by understanding evolving customer needs and aligning them with OneStream’s solutions.
  • Pipeline Generation: Build and maintain a healthy pipeline through self-sourced efforts and collaboration with Customer Success, Business Development, Marketing, and Alliances.
  • Salesforce Hygiene: Maintain clean, accurate, and up-to-date Salesforce records to support data-driven decision making, forecast accuracy, and cross-functional alignment.
  • Sales Execution: Prepare and present tailored business cases, proposals, and SaaS agreements that align customer objectives with OneStream’s value proposition.
  • Quota Achievement: Balance new business and existing account growth to meet or exceed sales targets.
  • Customer Partnership: Serve as a consultative partner, delivering insights and value that support long-term customer success and retention.
  • Value Communication: Clearly articulate OneStream’s differentiators through compelling written, virtual, and in-person presentations.
  • Opportunity Management: Accurately track and forecast sales opportunities while ensuring timely knowledge transfer across internal teams and external stakeholders.
  • Needs Assessment: Conduct discovery sessions, research, and demos to assess and align OneStream offerings with client challenges.
  • Proposal Development: Create high-impact proposals and responses to client requests, supporting revenue growth and strategic alignment.

Required Education & Experience

  • 3–5+ years of B2B sales experience, with a strong focus on new business; high-potential candidates with less experience will also be considered.
  • Proven track record of consistently exceeding quotas through net-new customer acquisition.
  • Demonstrated success in prospecting, pipeline generation, and closing complex deals.
  • Hunter mindset with ability to drive outbound efforts and convert leads from multiple channels.
  • Skilled at articulating solution value to senior stakeholders and navigating multi-threaded sales cycles.
  • Strong command of sales methodologies such as MEDDPICC or Challenger to manage complex sales cycles.
  • Strategic thinker with business acumen to align solutions with customer pain points and goals.
  • Ability to manage multiple concurrent opportunities with speed, discipline, and strong execution across relatively short to mid-length sales cycles.
  • Strong team player who values collaboration and actively contributes to a high-performance team culture.
  • Comfortable operating independently in fast-paced, high-growth environments.
  • Experienced in collaborating with Marketing, Product, Business Development, and Pre-Sales to accelerate deal velocity.
  • Values being regularly present in the office and recognizes the importance of face-to-face collaboration in building trust, alignment, and high performance.
  • Fluent in French and English is a must.

Preferred Education & Experience

  • University Degree or College Diploma in Sales, Business Administration, Marketing or a related field.
  • Prior sales experience in the SaaS industry, especially within the CPM / EPM industry or financial software space.

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

  • Demonstrates a strategic mindset with a focus on long-term value creation.
  • Consistently driven by goals and measurable outcomes.
  • Maintains a strong customer-centric approach across all initiatives.
  • Possesses strong commercial acumen and sound business acumen to drive sustainable growth.
  • Proven ability to build and maintain trusted relationships with C-level executives and key stakeholders.
  • Adept at identifying, understanding, and proactively responding to evolving customer needs.
  • Highly flexible and adaptable, with the ability to navigate complex and changing environments.

#LI-MS1

#LI-Hybrid

Total compensation is based on experience, skills, and location using objective, job-related criteria. Additional variable compensation and benefits may apply.

Gross annual base salary€90.000—€100.000 EUR

All candidates must be legally authorized to work for any company in the country where this position is located without sponsorship.

title: Account Executive, Named - Germany
descriptionHtml:
About Team & About Role

Rubrik's sales organisation is a unified group of elite cross-functional professionals helping companies across every major industry achieve true resilience against cyberattacks, malicious insiders, and operational disruptions. As Named Account Executive in Germany, you'll own a portfolio of large enterprise accounts, driving Rubrik's continued expansion in one of Europe's most dynamic enterprise markets.

What You'll Do

  • Own and grow a portfolio of enterprise accounts across Germany, combining existing customer relationships with new business development.
  • Run full, multistakeholder sales cycles end to end — from discovery and qualification through solution design, negotiation, and close — across both net-new logo and existing-account expansion deals.
  • Build and manage a high-quality pipeline across your territory, balancing larger strategic opportunities with faster-moving transactional deals.
  • Develop executive relationships within your accounts, translating Rubrik's technical capabilities into the board-level priorities that make data security a strategic imperative.
  • Partner closely with Solutions Engineers, Channel Development, and Rubrik's partner ecosystem to extend reach across your territory and position Rubrik against the full scope of customer risk.
  • Collaborate with and learn from your regional peers — the German team works closely together on deal strategy and account coverage, so you'll grow fastest by leaning on each other.
  • Feed market intelligence back to Rubrik's leadership, including competitive signals and account trends that shape our go-to-market approach across Germany.

Experience You'll Need

  • Experience closing complex enterprise deals, with the appetite to grow into larger, multi-product opportunities — we'll help you build the rest.
  • A track record that shows both new-logo acquisition and growing existing customer relationships.
  • Fluent in German and professional in English; you engage confidently with both technical buyers and executive stakeholders in either language.
  • Understanding of enterprise buying cycles, procurement processes, and multistakeholder decision-making within large or complex organisations.
  • Comfortable working with channel partners and distributors as part of a broader go-to-market motion.
  • Willingness to travel regularly across your territory to build in-person relationships with customers.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Background in cybersecurity, data protection, backup/recovery, or adjacent infrastructure/cloud categories — candidates who understand the difference between data centre and cloud environments tend to ramp fastest.
  • Experience with MEDDPICC as a sales qualification and execution framework.
  • Existing relationships within large German enterprise or Mittelstand organisations.
  • Familiarity with Salesforce for pipeline management and forecast accuracy.

title: Accountant – Inventory & Fixed Assets Accounting (f/m/x)
descriptionHtml:
Our goal is to have a solar system on every roof, a storage unit in every house, and an electric car in every garage. Enpal makes this possible with an integrated total solution for decentralized energy—from solar systems and battery storage to wall boxes, smart meters, and heat pumps. At the heart of it all is our AI-powered platform Enpal.One+, which intelligently connects thousands of systems and efficiently optimizes electricity procurement and feed-in on the energy market.

Are you ready for solutions that are more than just a promise and bring real quality of life to thousands of households every day? What you create at Enpal will deliver clean electricity tomorrow and bring about lasting change in how we use energy.

What you’ll do

As part of our Accounting team, you will support the accounting of inventory and fixed assets across the Enpal Group. Working closely with your Team Lead and other Finance and Operations teams, you will help ensure accurate accounting records, timely closing activities and reliable financial information.

  • You support the day-to-day accounting of inventory and fixed assets for various Enpal entities, ensuring transactions are recorded accurately and on time.

  • You prepare and post accounting entries related to inventory movements, asset additions, disposals, depreciation and other relevant transactions.

  • You support monthly, quarterly and annual closing activities, including preparation of reconciliations, accounting entries and supporting schedules.

  • You perform inventory reconciliations between ERP, warehouse and accounting records, identify discrepancies and support their resolution.

  • You maintain and update fixed asset registers, including asset additions, transfers, disposals and depreciation.

  • You assist with inventory valuation and fixed asset accounting activities in accordance with applicable accounting policies.

  • You work closely with Supply Chain, Logistics, Procurement and other Finance teams to clarify accounting-related questions and resolve discrepancies.

  • You prepare supporting documentation and analyses for HGB statutory reporting, IFRS Group reporting and external audits.

  • You contribute to the improvement and standardization of accounting processes by identifying inefficiencies and suggesting practical improvements.

What you’ll bring

  • You have completed a degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, a commercial apprenticeship or a comparable qualification.

  • You have experience in Financial Accounting, General Ledger Accounting or a similar accounting function.

  • You have a basic understanding of accounting principles and closing processes.

  • Experience with inventory accounting, fixed asset accounting or account reconciliations is a plus.

  • You are comfortable working with Excel and financial data.

  • You have experience with ERP systems; knowledge of Microsoft Dynamics 365 is an advantage.

  • You communicate confidently in English; German language skills are an advantage.

Are you interested even if you don't meet all the requirements? Apply anyway! We look forward to discovering your potential, regardless of whether your experience meets every single requirement. ☀️

What we offer

  • Work at Germany's first green unicorn - Play an active role in shaping the solar energy transition.

  • The sun shines all over the world - At Enpal, you'll work with a highly motivated, diverse team of over 65 nationalities.

  • The ideal setup for your focus - We are convinced that excellent results are achieved when the conditions are right. That's why we rely on a hybrid working concept that gives you the freedom to always work in the way that best suits your tasks. Do you need new inspiration on an international level? With Workflex, we offer you the opportunity to relocate abroad for up to 30 days a year, depending on your responsibilities.

  • Grown-up business & startup spirit - In our modern office in Berlin-Friedrichshain, you'll find everything your heart desires, from height-adjustable desks and table tennis to stocked beverage fridges and barista coffee.

  • Your kick-start at Enpal - Onboarding day with a welcome bag, buddy program, and a team that really supports you.

title: AI & Data Platform Engineer (GCP) (all levels)
descriptionHtml:
Über KnowWay

KnowWay entwickelt KI-Agenten für kritische Infrastruktur: Energie, Telekommunikation und öffentlicher Sektor. Wir automatisieren Geschäftsprozesse mit autonomen Agenten, und zwar für Kunden, bei denen Compliance, Nachvollziehbarkeit und Datensouveränität Pflicht sind.

Wir begleiten unsere Kunden über den gesamten Daten- und KI-Lebenszyklus. Wir sammeln und speichern die Daten, verarbeiten sie mit und für KI, sichern ihre Qualität und integrieren die Ergebnisse in produktive Systeme.

Das Projekt

Für einen führenden Telekommunikationskonzern in Deutschland setzen wir Daten- und KI-Projekte auf der Google Cloud um. Wir kennen die gesamte Prozess- und Systemlandschaft des Kunden, arbeiten darin und bauen mehrere Plattformen, auf denen die Fachbereiche ihre Anwendungsfälle betreiben. Mehrere Anwendungsfälle laufen parallel und stehen an unterschiedlichen Punkten zwischen Discovery und Live-Betrieb.

Unser Delivery-Team deckt dabei ungewöhnlich viel ab: Business-Analyse und die Definition der eigentlichen Anforderungen, Solution Design, schnelle PoCs und die Produktivsetzung. Wo es passt, verwenden wir vorhandene Plattform-Capabilities wieder, und wo etwas fehlt, entwickeln wir es neu.

Der Stack läuft bereits produktiv. Dazu gehören LLM-Extraktionspipelines über einen gemanagten AI-Service mit vorgeschaltetem Compliance-Proxy, agentische Systeme mit Vector Search, Batch-Verarbeitung und Orchestrierung, ein zentrales Data Warehouse und containerisierte Services. Die Infrastruktur ist komplett als Code beschrieben und läuft in einer streng abgeschotteten Umgebung mit mehreren Freigabestufen. Auf der Roadmap stehen unter anderem der Umbau des Query-Layers, die Anbindung von On-Premise-Systemen an Cloud-Worker und die Integration weiterer Quellsysteme.

Die Rolle

Du arbeitest mit uns dort, wo Datenpipelines, KI-Modelle und Cloud-Infrastruktur zusammenkommen. Gemeinsam mit dem Team sorgst Du dafür, dass das Ergebnis im Produktivbetrieb zuverlässig läuft, und übernimmst dabei nach und nach mehr Verantwortung. Jeder Schritt soll nachvollziehbar, überwacht und wartbar bleiben, auch wenn sich Datenmengen, Dokumentqualität oder Anforderungen ändern.

Zwei Wege in diese Rolle

Der Stack reicht von der Infrastruktur über Datenpipelines bis zu LLM- und Agentensystemen. Niemand bringt das alles auf Expertenniveau mit, deshalb beschreiben wir zwei Profile mit jeweils anderen Entwicklungsperspektiven. Wenn Du einen Schwerpunkt und die Bereitschaft hast, auch in die andere Richtung mitzudenken, dann ist die Rolle die Richtige für Dich.

Profil A - Platform-Schwerpunkt: Deine Erfahrung liegt vor allem in GCP/Cloud-Infrastruktur, Infrastructure as Code und Deployment. Daten- und AI-Pipelines willst Du so weit verstehen, dass Du sie betreiben und debuggen kannst.

Profil B - AI & Data-Schwerpunkt: Deine Erfahrung liegt vor allem in AI Engineering, LLM- und Datenpipelines und in Datenmodellierung. Die Infrastruktur darunter willst Du so weit verstehen, dass Du selbst deployen und Probleme bis in die Plattform verfolgen kannst.

In der Rolle entwickelst Du Dich jeweils in die andere Richtung: Mit Profil A arbeitest Du Dich zunehmend in AI- und Datenthemen ein, mit Profil B in Infrastruktur und Plattform. Wir planen das bewusst ein, und Du übernimmst auf der anderen Seite nach und nach mehr Aufgaben.

Die Rolle passt auch für Junior- und Mid-Level-Engineers. Wichtiger als viele Jahre Erfahrung ist uns, dass Du in einem der beiden Bereiche schon praktisch gearbeitet hast und Lust hast, Dich in den anderen einzuarbeiten. Die Anforderungen unten "für beide Profile“ + das A oder B-Profil sind das Minimum, mit dem Du einsteigen kannst. Wer mehr mitbringt, steigt entsprechend höher ein.

Deine Aufgaben

Die Listen beschreiben das Spektrum des Teams. Wie viel davon Du am Anfang übernimmst, hängt von Deiner Erfahrung ab.

Gemeinsamer Kern:

Entwicklung und Betrieb von Datenpipelines auf GCP: Batch-Verarbeitung, Orchestrierung, Beladung der Datenplattform

Anbindung neuer Datenquellen. Jede Quelle hat ihre eigenen Eigenheiten, deshalb lässt sich eine Anbindung selten einfach auf die nächste übertragen.

Fehlersuche über die gesamte Kette, von der Quelldatei über Pipeline und Modell bis in die Anwendung

Zusammenarbeit mit den Plattform-Teams des Kunden und Begleitung der technischen Freigabeprozesse

Enge Abstimmung mit unserem Solution Architect zu Datenmodell und Architektur

Schwerpunkt Platform:

Aufbau und Pflege der Infrastruktur mit Terraform, über mehrere Umgebungen und Freigabestufen

CI/CD-Pipelines, Deployment-Automatisierung, Container-Builds und Vulnerability-Gates

Netzwerk, IAM, Secret-Management, Verschlüsselung und Zugriffskonzepte

Logging, Monitoring und Alerting für Pipelines und Anwendungen

Kostenkontrolle und Ressourcendimensionierung

Schwerpunkt AI & Data:

Entwicklung von LLM-Extraktionspipelines: Segmentierung und Klassifikation von Dokumenten, prompt-basierte Extraktion, Schema-Validierung, Upsert in die Datenplattform

Extraktionsgenauigkeit bewerten und verbessern, auf Basis belastbarer Messungen

Agentische Systeme und RAG: Multi-Agent-Architekturen, Embeddings, Vector Search, Evaluierung von Tool-Auswahl und Antwortqualität

Datenmodellierung und Migration: Schema-Design, Historisierung, Umbau des Query-Layers von BigQuery nach Postgres

Datenqualität als eigenes Arbeitsfeld

Was Du mitbringst

Für beide Profile:

Mindestens etwa ein Jahr Berufserfahrung mit Datenpipelines, Cloud-Infrastruktur oder KI-Systemen. Eine längere Werkstudententätigkeit in einem Engineering-Team zählt auch. Idealerweise lief davon schon etwas in Produktion und nicht nur in Notebooks oder Proof-of-Concepts.

Gute Python-Kenntnisse und solides SQL.

Erfahrung mit GCP oder einer anderen Cloud wie AWS oder Azure. Kommst Du nicht von GCP, traust Du Dir zu, Dein Wissen schnell zu übertragen.

Du arbeitest mit Git und Code Review und hast CI/CD schon in der Praxis genutzt.

Du bleibst an einem Problem dran, bis Du verstehst, was passiert, auch wenn die Ursache drei Systemgrenzen weiter liegt.

Deutsch und Englisch mindestens fließend. Unser Team arbeitet in beiden Sprachen, die Dokumentation der Fachbereiche ist auf Deutsch.

Profil A (Platform): In mehreren dieser Punkte hast Du schon Erfahrung:

Terraform oder ein vergleichbares IaC-Werkzeug

GCP-Kernservices oder ihre Pendants bei anderen Clouds: Cloud Run, Cloud Storage, Cloud SQL, IAM, Networking, Secret Management

CI/CD-Pipelines und Container-Builds

Logging, Monitoring und Alerting in der Cloud

Interesse an Daten- und AI-Pipelines: Du willst lernen, sie zu betreiben, zu debuggen und zu erweitern

Profil B (AI & Data): In mehreren dieser Punkte hast Du schon Erfahrung:

LLM-Anwendungen gebaut, etwa für Extraktion aus unstrukturierten Dokumenten, mit strukturierten Ausgaben, Schema-Validierung und Prompt-Design

Du kennst die Grenzen von LLMs, etwa Nicht-Determinismus, Halluzination und Datenqualität als limitierenden Faktor, und Du misst die Genauigkeit Deiner Ergebnisse.

Datenpipelines und Datenmodellierung: BigQuery oder ein vergleichbares Warehouse, Orchestrierung, Schema-Design

Interesse an der Infrastruktur darunter: Du willst lernen, selbst zu deployen und Probleme bis in die Plattform zu verfolgen

Nice-to-have:

Erfahrung mit Gemini/Vertex AI, Document AI oder vergleichbaren Cloud-AI-Diensten

Erfahrung mit Agenten-Frameworks (Google ADK, LangChain o. Ä.), Vector Search und RAG-Evaluierung

Erfahrung mit Dataflow/Apache Beam, Composer/Airflow oder Kubeflow/KFP

Erfahrung mit Data-Warehouse-Migrationen und Historisierungsmustern (SCD-2)

Erfahrung mit Django/DRF

Erfahrung mit OCR-Verarbeitung und schwankender Dokumentenqualität

Erfahrung in regulierten oder governance-lastigen Enterprise-Umgebungen, etwa mit Security-Assessments, Datenschutz-Prüfungen und Verschlüsselungskonzepten

Du setzt AI-Coding-Tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot o. Ä.) aktiv ein und hast einen eigenen Workflow, mit dem Du ihre Ergebnisse prüfst

Branchenkenntnisse in Telekommunikation, Infrastruktur oder Rechnungsprüfung

Wie wir Dich einarbeiten

Du bekommst eine feste Ansprechperson im Team und startest mit einem abgegrenzten Teil, zum Beispiel einer Pipeline oder einem Modul. Code Reviews und Pairing mit erfahrenen Kolleginnen und Kollegen sind dabei Dein wichtigster Lernweg.

So arbeiten wir mit KI

Wir versuchen, KI in jedes Asset einzubauen, an dem wir arbeiten. Dabei prüfen wir jedes Mal, wo sie hilft, ob sie überhaupt hilft, ob ihr Einsatz compliant ist und wie man sie richtig einsetzt. Das gehört bei uns zur täglichen Routine und sollte auch zu Deiner werden.

Was wir bieten

Gehalt zwischen 60.000 und 80.000 Euro brutto im Jahr, je nach Erfahrung

Erfolgsbeteiligung

Betriebliche Weiterbildung

Firmenevents und Company Offsites

Flexible Arbeitszeiten und Homeoffice

Ein Stack, der in Produktion läuft und den Du substanziell weiterentwickeln kannst, statt nur Tickets abzuarbeiten

Standort

Du arbeitest überwiegend im Homeoffice. Einmal pro Woche treffen wir uns als Team im Ruhrgebiet, im Wechsel in Duisburg und Dortmund, und einmal im Monat beim Kunden in Düsseldorf. Damit das gut machbar bleibt, sollte Dein Wohnort höchstens etwa 1,5 Stunden Fahrzeit von Dortmund oder Duisburg entfernt sein.

title: AI Engineer - Simulation Environments
descriptionHtml:
About us

We are building a global leader in physical AI, anchored in Europe’s strongest robotics heritage. Founded by entrepreneurs with backgrounds in scaling digital products and advanced robotics, the team is bolstered by senior leadership from top-tier AI research labs and industrial tech companies.

Driven by a mission to create versatile and trustworthy embodied AI for physical labor, we fuse deep engineering mastery in AI and mechatronics with a rapid-execution culture. We are addressing the labor shortage by closing the gap to production-grade deployment. This means building the trusted alternative: robots that are safe, secure, and engineered to automotive standards of scale and durability.

We are well-capitalized and now assembling our team.

Our Locations: Vesoma has two main locations: Munich, Germany and Limassol, Cyprus. This pan-European setup represents our core ambition of building a European technology leader, gives us a great talent base and a strong corporate structure.

Your mission

The role
As an AI Engineer for Simulation Environments, you enter as a key member of the early AI team. You will work directly with our AI leadership and researchers to define the simulated worlds in which our humanoid robots learn and are evaluated. You design training and evaluation environments with state-of-the-art physics engines, build and curate the asset libraries that fill them, and own the large-scale benchmarks that tell us - quickly and reliably - whether a new policy is better. Your environments sit between research, hardware and product, so how well they match reality and how useful they are directly sets how fast and how safely we can bring new capabilities to our robots. This is a full-time, permanent position.

Your profile

Key responsibilities

  • Training and Evaluation Environments: Design and build scalable simulation environments for humanoid robots with physics engines such as MjLab and Isaac Lab. Work with AI researchers to create challenging training tasks, curricula and evaluation scenarios.

  • Asset Management: Build and curate our database of robot, object and scene assets - including import, validation, collision and physics properties, metadata and versioning - so that environments can be assembled quickly and reproducibly.

  • Simulation Benchmarking: Own rigorous, large-scale simulation benchmarks and evaluation sweeps that enable fast policy evaluation cycles, with statistically sound metrics, regression tracking and clear reporting to research teams.

  • Sim-to-Real Alignment: Work with hardware and control engineers to align simulation with reality through robot modeling, actuator and sensor models, system identification and validation against real-world data.

  • Use-Case Driven Environments: Work with product teams to turn real customer use cases into simulated environments and benchmarks that measure what matters for deployment.

Who we are looking for
We seek people who embrace the empirical nature of AI research and want to accelerate our research velocity with best-in-class tools - so that we can all make breakthroughs faster, together.

  • Experience: 3+ years of hands-on experience building simulation environments for robot learning with physics engines such as MuJoCo/MjLab, MuJoCo Warp/MJX, Isaac Lab/Isaac Sim or Newton.

  • Core Skills: Deep understanding of physics simulation and large-scale evaluation infrastructure. In detail:

    • Simulation Physics: Rigid-body dynamics and contact simulation, including solver parameters, numerical stability and the trade-offs between simulation speed and fidelity.

    • Assets & Formats: Robot and scene description formats and asset pipelines - URDF, MJCF, OpenUSD, mesh processing and convex decomposition (e.g. CoACD, V-HACD) - and asset validation at scale.

    • Benchmarking Infrastructure: GPU-parallel simulation, sweep orchestration, reproducibility and statistically sound metrics.

  • Core Stack: Python, C++, PyTorch and/or JAX, and GPU programming with CUDA or NVIDIA Warp.

  • A plus: Video game development (e.g. Unreal Engine, Unity or Godot), including level design, procedural content generation and real-time rendering; sim-to-real techniques (system identification, actuator modeling, domain randomization, sensor simulation for cameras, depth, IMU and tactile); photorealistic rendering and scene reconstruction (ray tracing, Gaussian splatting, NeRFs); 3D content tooling such as Blender or Houdini and large-scale asset sources such as Objaverse; familiarity with RL and imitation learning for humanoid locomotion and manipulation

  • Mindset: You balance the agility of a startup with the professional rigor required for a global industrial player. You are a curious builder who thrives in a collaborative, fast-paced research environment, and a cross-functional collaborator who turns the different needs of research, hardware and product into environments and benchmarks everyone trusts.

Why us?

  • The Team: Work alongside leadership with a proven track record of building unicorn-scale companies and defining global robotics standards.

  • Smart Strategy: We operate as disciplined fast followers. Capital is timed to the deployment inflection point, avoiding early-mover dead ends to scale fast on proven foundations.

  • Resources: We are substantially internally funded and attract top-tier investors to avoid any capital constraints for our mission.

  • Historic Opportunity: Join at the dawn of a new industry comparable to the rise of the automobile. Help shape the European champion in this trillion-dollar market.

We are an equal opportunity employer.

title: AI Product Manager
descriptionHtml:
Le Product Management, c'est notre ADN. L'IA, c'est ce qui est en train de changer le métier.

Chez Hubvisory, tu ne te contentes pas de gérer un backlog : tu deviens la référence produit incontournable pour accompagner nos clients grands comptes dans la transformation de leurs produits digitaux et de leurs organisations. Ce poste ajoute une dimension : tu pilotes des produits dans lesquels l'IA devient une brique fonctionnelle à part entière, et tu t'en sers aussi pour accélérer ta propre pratique de PM.

Ce que tu fais concrètement :

  • Tu conduis les phases de Discovery de bout en bout. Entretiens utilisateurs, cadrage des besoins, personas et benchmarks : tu identifies les problèmes réels pour construire les solutions qui comptent. Et tu sais reconnaître, parmi ces problèmes, ceux que l'IA résout vraiment de ceux qu'elle complique.

  • Tu qualifies les cas d'usage IA avant de les construire. Faisabilité, valeur, coût, données disponibles, risque d'erreur acceptable : tu instruis le sujet avec rigueur. Tu portes la décision de ne pas faire d'IA quand elle ne se justifie pas : c'est aussi ça, la maturité sur le sujet.

  • Tu embarques l'IA dans le produit, pas à côté. Tu travailles main dans la main avec les data scientists et les AI engineers : définition de ce qu'est un « bon » résultat, seuils de confiance, stratégies de repli quand le modèle se trompe, interfaces qui rendent l'incertitude lisible pour l'utilisateur, boucles de retour pour progresser dans le temps.

  • Tu pilotes des périmètres produit complexes et interdépendants. Règles métier, états et transitions, cohérence entre plusieurs surfaces (interface interne et parcours client en ligne), contrats d'intégration avec les produits adjacents : tu tiens la vue d'ensemble et tu stabilises ce qui doit l'être, dans des écosystèmes où ton produit n'est jamais seul.

  • Tu prends la donnée en main. Tu interprètes toi-même les insights, tu structures des hypothèses, tu mesures pour décider, pas pour afficher. Une vraie maturité data, c'est ce qui distingue les PM junior des PM qui créent de la valeur, et c'est le socle sans lequel aucun produit IA ne tient.

  • Tu mesures l'impact. Tu définis et analyses les KPI et OKR pour t'assurer que le produit sert les objectifs business, tout en animant les rituels agiles pour maintenir une dynamique d'équipe exemplaire.

  • Tu participes à la vie d'Hubvisory. Tu consolides ta posture de consultant, tu partages tes retours d'expérience et tu évolues, selon tes aspirations, vers des rôles de Product Leader ou Manager Conseil.

Bonus : tu as déjà outillé ton propre quotidien de PM avec l'IA : rédaction et structuration de specs, dépouillement d'entretiens utilisateurs, exploration de données, prototypage rapide ? On aime les PM qui testent, qui gardent ce qui marche et qui savent dire ce qui ne marche pas.


👉 Pourquoi rejoindre Hubvisory ?

  • Hubvisory est le seul cabinet en France focalisé exclusivement sur le Product Management et l'IA. Pas de practice data généraliste, pas de conseil en transformation sur tous les sujets. On fait une chose, on la fait bien, on la fait avec les meilleurs clients.

  • Un parcours d'accompagnement sur-mesure. Si tu es PO aujourd'hui et que tu veux devenir PM, on te donne les moyens : mentorship, cas complexes, retours structurés. Nos rituels collectifs (Hub'Times) et nos revalorisations bi-annuelles récompensent la vraie progression, pas l'ancienneté.

  • Une communauté interne engagée : 20% des collaborateurs qui se sont volontairement engagés à travers plus de 20 projets à impact menés depuis 2022 (mécénat de compétence, organisation de maraudes, fresque du climat, etc.)

👉 Le profil que nous recherchons

  • Tu justifies d'au moins 3 ans d'expérience en tant que Product Manager sur des produits digitaux. Ou tu es Product Owner avec une vraie volonté de progresser vers une posture de Product Manager complète (discovery, stratégie, pilotage d'impact).

À défaut, tu as une appétence sérieuse et démontrable : formation spécialisée, side project, veille active que tu peux raconter concrètement.

  • Tu as une culture technique suffisante pour tenir la conversation avec des profils data et tech : tu situes ce qu'est un LLM, une approche RAG, une base de données, une API. On ne te demande pas de coder, on te demande de ne jamais être spectateur des choix techniques de ton produit.

  • Tu es à l'aise avec le pilotage de backlog, la roadmap et tu possèdes une culture data marquée. Ton orientation valeur est ton moteur au quotidien.

  • Un niveau d'anglais professionnel est indispensable : nos clients lillois pilotent des produits déployés à l'international.

  • Trois qualités qui font la différence ici : une autonomie opérationnelle réelle, une excellente communication client et une rigueur analytique à toute épreuve.

Comment se déroule le processus de recrutement ?

title: Analytics Engineer – Client Reporting
descriptionHtml:

We are looking for an Analytics Engineer dedicated to client reporting. You build and maintain the dbt models and Looker reports behind it. Over the coming year we are moving from Snowflake to Databricks, and you help bring client reporting to the new platform.

What you'll do

  • Build and maintain the dbt models behind client reporting, following our layered structure from source to report.

  • Develop Looker reporting end to end: LookML views and explores, dashboards embedded in our platform, and the client-specific logic behind them.

  • Turn client and Customer Success requests into reports, and push back when a definition or requirement is unclear.

  • Keep client reporting reliable: tests, monitoring, documentation, code review and CI as the standard.

  • Protect client data: access per client, privacy and GDPR built into every model and report.

  • Work with our data engineer on the ingestion syncs (today Fivetran) that feed client reporting.

Your team

You join the Client Reporting team, where client reporting is your full-time focus. The team includes a Product Manager, a dedicated QA engineer and another analytics engineer.

You work closely with the Product department, Customer Success and our central data team, so client reporting fits the product and answers what our customers need.


Who you are

You have 2 to 5 years of experience in analytics engineering or BI development, or grew into it from analysis or data engineering. You think in models and definitions before dashboards. You know that a number a customer sees has to be explainable, consistent and correct. If a client or a CS colleague cannot understand or trust a report, the work is not done.

Must-haves

Nice to have

Our stack

What we offer

  • A competitive salary and real influence on how client reporting is built.

The Associate Director, Medical Communications, EMEA will play a key role in executing regional medical communications initiatives across mainly Europe in alignment with the global medical and scientific strategy. Based in Europe and operating within a global matrix, this individual will partner closely with EMEA Medical Affairs, country medical teams, and cross-functional stakeholders to support the adaptation, localization, and implementation of global medical communications materials for healthcare professional (HCP) audiences. The role will support the phased expansion of our Medical Affairs Digital Resource Hub (MYO360) across Europe, beginning with Germany, execution of European congresses and medical symposia, and delivery of regionally relevant scientific communications that support the needs of EMEA Medical Affairs.
Position Responsibilities
  • Execute regional medical communications activities aligned with the Global Medical strategy, in collaboration with EMEA Medical Affairs, country medical teams, and cross-functional stakeholders.
  • Support the development and maintenance of global medical communications content, including core scientific resources that will cascade to EMEA and other regions, as business needs require.
  • Provide medical communications support for International Partner Market (IPM) initiatives, including the development, adaptation, and coordination of scientifically accurate materials aligned with global strategy and regional needs.
  • Support the adaptation and localization of existing global medical communications materials for EMEA and country-specific needs, partnering with local medical leads to ensure content is scientifically accurate, relevant, and compliant. This may include field medical resources, training materials, scientific slide decks, FAQs, and other medical content.
  • Support the European expansion of MYO360, including execution of regional and country-level adaptations, localization, stakeholder review, deployment readiness, and ongoing content updates in partnership with Global Medical Communications and local medical teams.
  • Coordinate and execute medical communications deliverables for European congresses, including encore abstract submissions, medical booth materials, scientific resources, congress-related communications, and post-congress materials, working across internal teams and external agencies.
  • Support the regional execution of Scholar Rock-sponsored medical symposia in Europe, including coordination of faculty materials, adaptation of scientific content, speaker preparation, review and approval processes, and other program deliverables.
  • Support medical training initiatives for EMEA and as needed, global audiences, including the adaptation and development of training materials, coordination of training sessions, and maintenance of onboarding and ongoing learning resources for Medical Affairs colleagues.
  • Serve as a medical communications partner to EMEA and country medical colleagues, helping identify regional and local content needs and facilitating the adaptation of existing global resources while maintaining consistency with the global scientific narrative.
  • Manage medical communications agencies and vendors supporting deliverables, including project scoping, timelines, budgets, quality review, and execution of multiple concurrent projects.
  • Coordinate regional and local review and approval of medical materials, partnering with appropriate stakeholders to ensure alignment with applicable European regulations, industry codes, company policies, and medical review processes.
  • Track project progress, timelines, risks, budgets, and key performance indicators; communicate status clearly; and proactively address executional challenges to keep deliverables on track.
  • Maintain strong working knowledge of the SMA and neuromuscular disease landscape, relevant clinical data, external scientific discourse, and regional medical education needs to support effective execution of EMEA medical communications activities.
  • Contribute to scientific excellence, collaboration, continuous improvement, and sharing of best practices across Global and EMEA Medical Affairs.

    • Candidate Requirements
    • Advanced scientific or healthcare degree (e.g., Pharm.D., Ph.D., or equivalent) preferred; a relevant master's degree with substantial medical communications experience may be considered.
    • 5+ years of experience in Medical Affairs, medical communications, scientific communications, publications, or a related biopharmaceutical industry role; rare disease or neuromuscular experience is preferred.
    • Demonstrated experience developing medical content for healthcare professional audiences and translating complex scientific information into clear, concise, and scientifically accurate communications.
    • Experience supporting regional or global congresses, medical symposia, abstract submissions, publications, and/or medical education initiatives.
    • Experience working across European markets, including content adaptation or localization and collaboration with regional and country medical teams.
    • Knowledge of relevant European pharmaceutical regulations, industry codes, compliance requirements, and medical review processes.
    • Strong project-management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities, agencies, stakeholders, budgets, and deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
    • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English; additional European language capabilities are an advantage.
    • Proven ability to collaborate effectively in a global matrix, influence without direct authority, work independently, and exercise sound scientific and business judgment.
    • Ability to travel approximately 20-30%, including occasional weekend travel based on congress and meeting schedules.

title: Associate Product Manager (UK Loans)
descriptionHtml:
About Lendable

Lendable is on a mission to build the world's best technology to help people get credit and save money.We're building one of the world’s leading fintech companies and are off to a strong start:

  • One of the UK’s most exciting unicorns with a team of over 800 people

  • Among the fastest-growing tech companies in the UK

  • Profitable since 2017

  • Backed by top investors including Balderton Capital and Goldman Sachs

  • Loved by customers with the best reviews in the market (4.9 across 10,000s of reviews on Trustpilot)

So far, we’ve rebuilt the Big Three consumer finance products from scratch: loans, credit cards and car finance. We get money into our customers’ hands in minutes instead of days.

We’re growing fast, and there’s a lot more to do: we’re going after the two biggest Western markets (UK and US) where trillions worth of financial products are held by big banks with dated systems and painful processes.

Join us if you want to

  1. Take ownership: you are trusted to make decisions that drive a material impact on the direction and success of Lendable from day 1

  2. Work in small teams of exceptional people: Lendies are relentlessly resourceful. We challenge the status quo to solve problems and find smarter solutions

  3. Build the best technology in-house: we use new data sources, machine learning and AI to make machines do the heavy lifting

About the role

We're looking for a proactive, data-driven Associate Product Manager to join our UK Loans product team. You'll play an important role in shaping the customer experience after they take out a loan: from how we engage with customers and manage payments, to how we support those who experience financial difficulty.

APMs at Lendable take ownership of their product changes, working closely with teams across Engineering, Credit, Finance and Operations to solve problems and take the business to the next level.

You'll have the opportunity to solve complex problems, scale impactful products, and help shape the future of our lending experience. If you're excited by fintech and enjoy turning data and customer insight into great products, we'd love to hear from you.

What you’ll work on

  • Improving repayment performance: Running experiments to help more customers pay on time, from choosing repayment dates to how and when we remind people to pay.

  • Personalising customer engagement: Own how we communicate across email, SMS and in-app notifications, testing new messages and improving our tooling.

  • Making loan management easier: Optimising and expanding journeys within the Zable SuperApp, particularly for those who need additional financial support.

  • Using data to drive improvements: Work with Credit and Data Science to identify opportunities and build models to improve payment and servicing outcomes. Build dashboards to track key metrics and measure the impact of what we launch.

  • Testing and learning with customers: Running customer research and testing ideas to understand what people need, how they behave and what works best.

  • Taking products from idea to launch: Working across Engineering, Data Science and Operations to understand the impact of new features, coordinate their rollout and make sure they work for both customers and the business.

  • Increasing impact with AI: Building tools and automations with AI that save time for you, the ops team and the wider business

What we're looking for

Don't worry if you don't meet every single one of the criteria. We'd love to hear from great candidates who are curious, proactive and excited to learn.

  • Experience: 1–2 years in product, or 2-3 years in strategy, analytics, consulting or similar roles, ideally with experience working closely with product or delivery teams to get things done.

  • Communication: You can clearly explain ideas and requirements to different audiences, from writing specs for engineers to training Operations teams.

  • Curiosity: You ask lots of questions and aren't satisfied until you understand why something is happening.

  • Problem-solving: You enjoy forming hypotheses and finding the quickest way to test them, even if the first version is rough around the edges.

  • Data-driven: You're comfortable working with data and can use SQL or Python to investigate problems and answer your own questions.

  • AI-native: You're already experimenting with AI tools like Claude Code, Cursor or Codex in your work or side projects, and are excited to see how far they can take you.

  • Hands-on: You're happy to roll up your sleeves and pick up the small jobs. In a lean product team, no task is beneath your attention.

  • Adaptable: You enjoy variety and like that no two days look quite the same.

  • Bonus: Experience in lending, payments, fintech or a fast-growing startup.

AI at Lendable

We want to build the most AI-forward financial services company in the world. PMs here make their own dashboards to answer questions that used to need an analyst, build their own agents and workflows to take care of repetitive work, and ship straightforward changes to production themselves. You don't need to be an expert on day one, but we'll expect you to keep pushing what one person can do.

Interview process

  • A quick chat with someone from our Product team to see if the role is a good match

  • A 15 minute cognitive assessment

  • A take home task; a practical product challenge to complete in your own time

  • Task debrief with the product team

  • Final round (in our London office) - typically with the CPO and UK Loans MD, Engineering Manager, Head of Product and hiring manager

Location

This position is a hybrid role based in London, please note we're unable to provide sponsorship for this position

Life at Lendable

  • Winning team: the opportunity to scale up one of the world’s most successful fintech companies

  • Flexible working: flexible approach tailored to each role. Hybrid roles require three days in-office weekly; fully remote roles include regular opportunities for in-person connection through socials and off-sites

  • Socials & connection: opportunities and events to come together, socialise, and get to know each other beyond the office walls

  • Health coverage: support for your physical and mental wellbeing, including private health cover

  • Retirement & savings: long-term financial wellbeing through retirement savings plans

  • Employee referral programme: earn a competitive bonus when you refer successful new team members

  • Office meals & snacks: enjoy a fully stocked kitchen, plus complimentary lunches prepared by in-house chefs on in-office days at select locations

  • Sustainable commuting: cycle-to-work and electric vehicle salary sacrifice schemes available in select locations

Please note: The availability and details of specific benefits vary by location and role. For more information, please speak to your Talent Partner.
