title: Community Lead
descriptionHtml:
Accurx is solving healthcare productivity for the NHS

At Accurx, we’ve supported thousands of healthcare organisations to deliver care for over 60 million patients. We’re used by 98% of GP practices and in 68% of NHS Trusts - that’s over 200,000 NHS staff each week.

For decades, the NHS has struggled with fragmented systems that slow everything down and leave patients waiting. We're changing that. We’re transforming how NHS staff triage and prioritise patient demand, cut the admin that eats into clinical time, and work as one team across the system.

We've spent eight years proving care doesn't always need to happen in an appointment. In the best triage practices today, 40% of patient demand is resolved without one. Now we're taking that model system-wide – using AI to automate the work that slows healthcare down, connecting every part of the NHS and building the platform on which the future of healthcare work gets done.

About the role

You’ll support and scale one of the most engaged clinical communities in the UK. Our users already talk to each other every day. They share what works, solve problems together and advocate for better ways of working. But those conversations are spread across WhatsApp groups and Facebook channels, with no platform or structure behind them. Our ambassador programme is also ready to be taken further.

As our Community Lead reporting to the Head of Marketing, you’ll shape how healthcare professionals connect, learn from one another and drive change across the NHS. You’ll turn organic momentum into a scalable community that measurably drives product adoption, peer-to-peer learning and brand trust.

The challenges you’ll take on

  • Building strategic and large-scale communities: Shaping and delivering the long-term vision for our primary and secondary care communities, with community playing a clear role in driving product adoption and brand advocacy, not just engagement. You'll be actively running community initiatives, as well as setting the strategic direction.

  • Turning unstructured clinical conversations into scalable content: Creating repeatable ways to transform high-volume community conversations into user-led content, learning assets and programmes, using strong storytelling to make Accurx's value clear and compelling across the market.

  • Scaling advocacy through ambassadors and peer influence: Owning and evolving our ambassador programme that enable clinicians to influence their peers authentically, and aligning it closely with product and marketing priorities.

  • Owning our community platform and programmes: Choosing and implementing the right long-term platform to bring our community together, and deciding when existing tools are “good enough”. You’ll help Accurx invest in the right processes and operating models for a growing, multi-product, multi-care-setting community.

You should apply if...

  • You have proven experience building and growing communities in the thousands, ideally in SaaS, tech or healthcare. This is essential for the role.

  • You've used community as a core driver of commercial growth, product adoption or brand advocacy, rather than it being primarily focused on support, account management or research.

  • You have a strong track record of designing, running or scaling ambassador programmes and super-user initiatives that drive peer-to-peer learning and influence.

  • You can point to clear examples of turning unstructured community conversations into scalable, user-led content, with strong written communication and storytelling skills.

  • You bring a data-informed and tool-savvy mindset, using signals, feedback and AI to scale insight capture and content without losing authenticity.

  • You're a strong cross-functional collaborator, comfortable partnering closely with Product, User Research, Implementation, Product Marketing and Events.

What's in it for you?

You'll be joining an established but fast-growing Tech for Good movement, where we're led by our Principles and our mission to Solve Healthcare Productivity.

  • Benefits to suit you: adjust your healthcare cover, your pension or life insurance, whatever stage you're at in life

title: Coördinator Regiosport PZC
descriptionHtml:
Middelburg- Zet jij de Zeeuwse sport elke dag op de kaart? Als Coördinator Regiosport bij de PZC geef je richting aan onze sportjournalistiek in Zeeland. Je combineert journalistieke ervaring met leiderschap en een sterke digitale visie. Je stuurt een team van sportjournalisten en freelancers aan én staat zelf met je voeten in de klei. Van het laatste nieuws over Zeeuwse voetbalclubs tot bijzondere verhalen over lokale sporters: jij weet wat er speelt, waar onze lezers op zitten te wachten en hoe je een verhaal digitaal tot leven brengt. Zo zorg je ervoor dat de PZC dé plek blijft voor regionaal sportnieuws!

Wat ga je doen?
Als Coördinator Regiosport ben je verantwoordelijk voor de dagelijkse aansturing en journalistieke koers van onze sportredactie. Je houdt overzicht, ziet kansen en zorgt ervoor dat goede ideeën daadwerkelijk worden uitgevoerd. Tegelijkertijd blijf je zelf actief als journalist en mediamaker. Je werkt midden in het dynamische ritme van de sportjournalistiek. De ene dag stuur je de verslaggeving rond een belangrijke voetbalwedstrijd aan, de volgende dag werk je aan een verdiepend verhaal, een podcast of een nieuw digitaal format.

Dit ga je onder andere doen:

  • Je geeft leiding aan een sportredactie van drie collega’s en een groep freelancers en werkt zelf actief mee binnen het team;

  • Je bepaalt samen met de redactie de journalistieke koers voor regiosport in Zeeland en bewaakt de kwaliteit van onze sportverslaggeving;

  • Je zorgt voor actuele, onderscheidende en relevante sportcontent voor onze website, app en krant;

  • Je houdt scherp in de gaten welke onderwerpen leven onder Zeeuwse sportliefhebbers en weet die te vertalen naar sterke verhalen;

  • Je ontwikkelt nieuwe digitale formats, journalistieke producties en innovatieve ideeën waarmee we onze onlinepositie verder versterken;

  • Je volgt Zeeuwse sporters, clubs en ontwikkelingen binnen de regionale, nationale en internationale sportwereld op de voet;

  • Je maakt zelf interviews, achtergrondverhalen en analyses en levert waar mogelijk een bijdrage aan podcasts;

  • Je werkt nauw samen met collega’s van de site, app en krant om grotere journalistieke producties van idee tot publicatie te realiseren;

  • Je coacht collega’s, geeft richting en stimuleert de redactie om zich journalistiek en digitaal voortdurend te ontwikkelen.

Wie zijn wij?
De PZC is hét nieuwsmedium van Zeeland en onderdeel van DPG Media. Iedere dag brengen we betrouwbaar nieuws, sterke regionale verhalen en actuele verslaggeving bij onze lezers. Dat doen we via onze krant, website en app en met verschillende digitale formats. Als Coördinator Regiosport kom je terecht op onze redactie in Middelburg. Een plek waar geen dag hetzelfde is en waar volop ruimte is voor initiatief. We geloven in goede journalistiek, maar ook in de kracht van nieuwe ideeën. Heb jij een goed plan voor een nieuw format of een andere manier om sportverhalen bij onze lezers te brengen? Dan krijg je de ruimte om het uit te proberen.

Wat maakt jou de ideale kandidaat?
Je bent een ervaren en enthousiaste journalist die energie krijgt van sport, nieuws en het maken van verhalen. Je weet wat er speelt in de regio, maar kijkt ook verder dan de traditionele sportjournalistiek. Je ziet kansen in digitalisering en weet anderen daarin mee te nemen.

Daarnaast:

  • Heb je ervaring in de sportjournalistiek en een sterke affiniteit met amateursport, met name voetbal;

  • Heb je een scherp journalistiek gevoel voor nieuws en weet je welke verhalen relevant en interessant zijn voor onze lezers;

  • Heb je ervaring met digitale journalistiek en weet je hoe je verhalen aantrekkelijk presenteert voor online doelgroepen;

  • Kun je een team inspireren, coachen en meenemen in nieuwe ideeën en ontwikkelingen;

  • Ben je communicatief sterk, overtuigend en in staat om zelfstandig beslissingen te nemen binnen de kaders van de hoofdredactie;

  • Ben je creatief, nieuwsgierig en altijd op zoek naar manieren om onze sportjournalistiek beter en vernieuwender te maken;

  • Beschik je over een rijbewijs en ben je bereid om in Zeeland te wonen of op korte termijn naar de regio te verhuizen.

Bij DPG Media staan we open voor alle talent in de maatschappij. Ongeacht je achtergrond, nodigen we je uit om te solliciteren op deze functie. Juist door de verschillen tussen collega’s ontstaan verrassende inzichten en innovatieve oplossingen. En dat past dan weer heel erg goed bij ons als organisatie. We zijn benieuwd wie jij bent en welke kwaliteiten en ervaring jij meebrengt.

Wat krijg je van ons?
Bij ons krijg je een inspirerende werkomgeving die continu in beweging is. Collega’s die denken in mogelijkheden, het glas halfvol zien en we geven jou de kans je dagelijks te ontwikkelen. Dit doen we onder andere door onze DPG Academy. Dit geeft jou alle mogelijkheid het beste uit jezelf te halen en een echte mediamaker te zijn!

  • 💰Een salaris vanaf €4.000 tot € 6.100 per maand op basis van een 38-urige werkweek (fulltime);

  • 📝Een 38-urige werkweek (4 dagen in de week is bespreekbaar);

  • 💰8 % vakantiegeld en 4% persoonlijk keuzebudget;

  • 💰Jaarlijkse winstdeling op basis van de prestaties van DPG Media;

  • 💰Een interessante bonusregeling;

  • 🎓Ruimte om je te ontwikkelen, zowel op de job als online via onze DPG Academy/ DPG Campus;

  • 🏢Een dynamische redactie in Middelburg met flexibiliteit rondom thuiswerken.

Nog meer redenen om bij DPG Media te willen werken
Bij DPG Media werken we voor meer dan 90 sterke nieuwsmerken, magazines, televisieprogramma’s, radiostations en online services zoals Qmusic, NU.nl, Tweakers, Libelle, VTM en meer. We bereiken maandelijks ruim 90% van de Nederlanders en 8 op de 10 Vlamingen. We bieden je een professionele werkomgeving waarin we vrijheid enorm belangrijk vinden. We geven je alle ruimte om aan je toekomst te werken door het aanbieden van workshops en trainingen. Voel je vrij om bij ons ondernemer, leerling en teamspeler te zijn, en vooral om jezelf te zijn. Bij DPG Media is iedereen welkom. Dus solliciteer, wat je achtergrond ook is. Er staan ruim 5.500 slimme collega’s te popelen om je op te nemen in een team, of dat nou een projectteam, een pubquiz team of een sportteam is. Ontdek wat wij je te bieden hebben. En, als je toch bezig bent, vind je ons ook op Instagram, LinkedIn en X.

Solliciteren, en dan?
Heb je direct zin om aan de slag te gaan? Solliciteer dan direct! Je ontvangt dan zo snel mogelijk een terugkoppeling. title: Copy Editor English
descriptionHtml:
Hi, we’re AMBOSS and we’re searching for a Copy Editor to join our team of English language experts for 14-18 months and help shape the language that medical professionals around the world rely on.

About AMBOSS

AMBOSS is the copilot for medical professionals, empowering them to provide the best possible care through our learning and clinical decision support tool. Our team brings together care, innovative thinking, and cutting-edge AI medical technology. Our founders launched AMBOSS in 2012 with the goal of creating a tool they wished they had during medical school and clinical practice. Since then, we’ve grown to over 600 employees and are active in over 180 countries - primarily in Germany and the US. Our offices are located in Berlin, Cologne, New York, Cagliari and Cape Town.

Want to learn more about our culture? Watch our video to explore what makes us unique.

Why can this position be exciting for you?

Your work will shape the language that medical students, clinicians, and educators rely on, from exam prep to the point of care. You’ll edit articles and Qbanks for different markets and work side by side with our medical editors. Together, you’ll keep our content clear, correct, and consistent as it grows. You’ll also build and test AI tools and prompts that raise the language quality of everything we publish. If you love both the art of language and the language of medicine, we’d be delighted to meet you.

You will:

  • Copyedit AMBOSS articles following our in-house style guide (based on the AMA Manual of Style), keeping content clear, correct, concise, and consistent

  • Edit Qbanks tailored to specific markets around the world

  • Work closely with our medical editors to discuss language issues, streamline content, and reach compromises when views differ

  • Collaborate with the multimedia, user experience, paid courses, and marketing teams to ensure high-quality output and consistency across the brand

  • Create, test, and refine AI tools and prompts that improve the language quality of our content

  • Critically evaluate and refine AI-assisted content to ensure linguistic accuracy, clarity, consistency, and adherence to editorial standards

  • Support medical editors with language questions and explain our conventions and the reasoning behind them, both day-to-day and through workshops and other teaching formats

  • Help shape the language of our products and keep up to date with the latest developments in medical language

  • Maintain our in-house guides, flag when a new convention is needed, and refine editorial processes to work more efficiently

You bring:

  • Fluency in English (C2 level) and a deep interest in its intricacies

  • Substantial editing experience (scientific or medical editing is a plus) and a good grasp of medical terminology

  • Experience editing according to a style guide, with accuracy and attention to detail

  • Strong research skills, using reliable sources to check terminology and decide how best to convey information to users

  • Outstanding communication skills, a passion for explaining language conventions, and the ability to give and receive constructive feedback

  • Hands-on experience using LLMs, ideally in an editorial process, and awareness of their limitations (hallucinations, biases, outdated sources) and of legal and ethical considerations around data use and copyright

  • Structured work approach to manage multiple projects, adapt to changing weekly priorities, plan around dependencies, and keep teams informed

You enjoy:

  • Working with people from all over the world

  • Learning about every aspect of a company, from engineering to user research

  • Exploring evolving technologies and tools

  • Keeping up with the latest developments in medical language

  • Sharing ideas about language with a close-knit team

Benefits:

AMBOSSians tell us that innovative work keeps them energized and employee benefits help them to feel appreciated and empowered. We invest in every AMBOSSian with our employee benefits package, crafted to support financial, physical, and mental health, and work-life harmony.

  • 🧠 Learning & Development (Internal & external trainings, workshops & hackathons, AI cross-talks & seminars, Blinkist access, and more…)

  • ☀️ Work From Somewhere Sunny (Access to our offices in Cagliari and Cape Town, visit the HQs, Berlin in summer)

Check out the full list of benefits below:

https://go.amboss.com/the-amboss-prescription-de

https://go.amboss.com/the-amboss-prescription-remote

We believe that diversity is a powerful driver of innovation and progress. That’s why we are committed to fostering an inclusive, respectful, and supportive environment where everyone—regardless of gender, age, ethnic or cultural background, religion, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity—is valued and given equal opportunity to thrive. We warmly welcome people of all backgrounds to help us fulfil our mission: empowering all medical professionals to provide the best possible care 🩺

Even if you don’t meet every single point in the job description, we still encourage you to apply. We’d love to hear from you!

AMBOSS operates across multiple international markets and diverse verticals. If this specific role doesn’t feel like the perfect match, we encourage you to browse our other open positions in Editorial and beyond to find where you can make the biggest impact.

title: Creative Strategist
descriptionHtml:
Leads Power, c’est quoi ?

Une agence dont le cœur de métier est la lead gen, avec un pôle e-commerce en plein développement. On gère de gros budgets d’investissement publicitaire, et l’entreprise est portée par des équipes talentueuses.

Sur les Social Ads, la créa fait énormément. On cherche la personne qui va alimenter notre pipeline de concepts et qui ne sera jamais à court d’idées.

Ton rôle

Tu es la machine à idées de l’équipe. Tu trouves les concepts et les angles qui font scaler les comptes, tu les fais produire, puis tu analyses ce que ça donne.

Ce poste est stratégique, pas opérationnel : tu imagines et tu pilotes, le studio exécute.

Ce que tu fais au quotidien

  • Tu épluches les ads des concurrents et des top spenders pour dénicher les concepts forts : ce qui tourne, depuis combien de temps, pourquoi ça marche

  • Tu suis les tendances organiques (TikTok, Reels, formats, codes, sons) et tu les transformes en pubs qui convertissent

  • Tu es force de proposition en continu : chaque semaine, de nouveaux concepts et de nouveaux angles à tester

  • Tu alimentes le pipeline pour que les comptes ne tombent jamais en fatigue créative

  • Tu analyses les résultats des créas que tu as fait pousser : ce qui marche, ce qui flop, et pourquoi

  • Tu réinjectes ces learnings dans la prochaine vague de concepts

Avec qui tu bosses

  • Les Performance Managers : ils pilotent les comptes, te donnent les chiffres et les contraintes, tu leur apportes les idées. Vous construisez ensemble la roadmap de tests et vous vous challengez.

  • Le studio créa (designers, monteurs, motion designers) : tu les briefes et tu les supervises pour que ce que tu as dans la tête sorte exactement comme tu l’avais imaginé. Tu valides avant lancement et tu leur fais un retour sur la performance.

Ton profil

  • Tu es hyper curieux : tu regardes de la pub par réflexe, tu scrolles avec un œil de stratège

  • Tu as 1000 idées à la minute et tu sais les transformer en brief clair

  • Tu as de l’expérience sur les créas Social Ads (Meta en priorité, TikTok et Snap en plus)

  • Tu lis les chiffres (CPL, CPA, ROAS, hook rate, hold rate, CTR) et tu en tires des idées

  • Tu as le sens du copywriting et de la réponse directe

  • Tu sais briefer, challenger et donner du feedback

  • Tu as des exemples concrets de créas que tu as conçues et de leurs résultats

Ce poste n’est pas pour toi si

  • Tu veux faire du design ou du montage toi-même

  • Tu attends qu’on te dise quoi chercher

  • Tu n’as aucune réalisation concrète à montrer

Ce qu’on te propose

  • 100 % télétravail : tu bosses d’où ça te chante

  • Un vrai impact : tes concepts font scaler des comptes avec de gros budgets

  • Du terrain de jeu : plusieurs verticales, beaucoup de choses à tester

  • Une équipe derrière toi : performance managers, studio, automatisation

  • De l’autonomie pour proposer, tester et structurer le pôle créatif

  • Une évolution liée à tes résultats

title: Curriculum Manager - AI Engineeering
descriptionHtml:
About DataCamp

Data and AI skills are critical for thriving today, and DataCamp is the platform that empowers everyone to learn them. We help individuals and Fortune 1000 companies close the data and AI skills gap through world-class learning, hands-on training, and a global community of expert instructors.

In this role, you’ll combine AI skills, technical expertise, and passion for great didactic experiences to usher in the next generation of education. 

About the role

This is an individual contributor role. You will collaborate with subject matter experts and leverage in-house-built cutting-edge AI tooling to scale high-quality course creation across AI engineering: building applications with large language models (LLMs), prompt and context engineering, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), AI agents, and related topics such as evaluation, fine-tuning, guardrails, and LLMOps. Here's what your day-to-day will look like:

  • Manage the entire content development lifecycle and deadlines.
  • Source and recruit top-tier subject-matter experts as instructors.
  • Collaborate with instructors to create engaging content.
  • Consistently leverage AI tools like Claude Code, Cursor, and more to drive high-quality content production at scale.
  • Design, review, and create content on LLM application development, prompt and context engineering, RAG and vector databases, agents and tool use, evaluation, deployment, and monitoring of AI systems, and related topics. You will review content from a learner perspective, ensuring it is technically accurate, reflects current AI engineering best practices in a fast-moving field, and is pedagogically effective.
  • Continuously assess course performance using learner feedback and engagement data to drive improvements.
  • Identify and prioritize existing curriculum gaps or new topics in DataCamp's AI engineering curriculum.

We’re excited about you because you have the following:

  • A solid hands-on background building and shipping production AI applications as an AI engineer, machine learning engineer, or software engineer. Experience taking LLM-powered systems from prototype to production (e.g. evaluation, monitoring, cost and latency optimization) is a strong plus.
  • Broad AI engineering fluency spanning LLM fundamentals, prompt and context engineering, RAG, agents, and evaluation, with additional depth in at least one area such as agentic systems, retrieval and search, fine-tuning, or LLMOps.
  • A solid technical background in Python, with comfort working with LLM APIs (e.g. OpenAI, Anthropic), open-source models and frameworks (e.g. Hugging Face, LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex), agentic systems, vector databases, Git, and the command line.
  • Intuitive understanding of instructional design, with proven ability to structure and teach technical concepts clearly.
  • Graduate degree (Master's or PhD) in Computer Science, AI, Machine Learning, or a related STEM field—or equivalent industry experience.
  • Strong experience with agentic coding systems, including Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, or Replit. You consider yourself a sophisticated user of these tools.

Bonus if you have the following:

  • A deep understanding of the DataCamp course format—you have an intuitive understanding of what makes a great DataCamp course.
  • An existing network of potential subject matter experts who can become DataCamp instructors.
  • An extensive track record of teaching AI engineering to technical audiences.

title: Customer and Client Support Specialist
descriptionHtml:
About Us

Hozah is a tech-led, award-winning company driving change in the parking industry and reimagining urban mobility. Our mission is simple but powerful: to transform parking into a seamless, automated experience, paving the way for smarter, more sustainable cities.

We run camera-based parking for landowners and operators, from hotels and colleges to shopping centres, across England, Scotland and Wales. With recent recognition as PayTech Company of the Year, a place among Deloitte’s Top 50 Fastest Growing Tech Companies in the UK, and significant VC/PE investment, we’re one of the fastest scaling companies in the country.

Role Overview

We’re looking for a Customer and Client Support Specialist to join our support team in Croydon. You’ll help two groups of people: the drivers who park at our sites, and the landowners and asset managers we work with. Most of the job is email, through Zendesk.

This isn’t answering from an FAQ. A good reply means reading the message properly, working out what’s actually being asked, checking the facts across our systems, and writing an answer that solves the problem without creating a new one. Some drivers will be angry, and some will be wrong but loud. We need someone who stays calm, gets it right, and follows up until it’s fixed.

It’s a role for a “learn-it-all” who cares about getting small things right, ticket after ticket. Almost everything is teachable in your first couple of months, and there’s plenty of room to grow as the company does.

Key Responsibilities

  • Respond to driver and client enquiries by email, clearly, accurately and on time.

  • Investigate each case properly before replying, checking details such as references, tariffs and permit lists.

  • Keep accurate records of every interaction.

  • Work with TechOps, Client Success and other teams on the trickier cases, and chase until they’re resolved.

  • Spot issues that keep coming up and flag them to the team, rather than just closing your own ticket.

  • Help build out and improve our processes as the team grows.

Who we’re looking for

You’ll need:

  • Experience in a customer support or service role.

  • Excellent written English: clear, polite, accurate and free of typos, with the right tone for the situation.

  • A real eye for detail. You read carefully, check before you reply and notice when something doesn’t add up.

  • Calm under pressure, including with rude or unfair customers.

  • The ability to manage a busy queue and several priorities at once.

  • Ownership: you close loops, chase what’s stuck and ask when there’s no clear answer.

  • Openness to feedback and a willingness to learn.

  • The ability to work independently and as part of a team.

Nice to have:

  • Experience with Zendesk and Jira.

  • Experience in parking, mobility, utilities or another high-volume consumer service.

What We Offer

  • Hybrid working: 3 days in the office, 2 days from home.

  • Room to grow with the business, with training, mentorship and exposure to technical operations.

  • 20 days’ annual leave plus bank holidays.

  • Company pension scheme.

  • A fully refurbished, modern office right next to East Croydon Station, with a fully stocked kitchen offering free breakfast, lunch and drinks (and two office dogs!).

  • Laptop and tech provided.

  • Employee Assistance Programme, BrightHR Exchange discounts and regular company events.

The details

  • Location: Croydon, next to East Croydon Station. Hybrid: 3 days in the office, 2 from home.

  • Hours: Monday to Friday, 9:00am to 6:00pm.

  • Salary: £26,000 - £28,000 (Negotiable)

  • Reports to: Customer Support Manager.

  • Team: Customer and Client Support (CS/DS).

Compensation: £26K – £28K

title: Data Center Warehouse Specialist
descriptionHtml:
About Nebius:

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

The role

JDC Warehouse Specialist
Position Overview
The Warehouse Specialist runs day-to-day warehouse operations at a Nebius data center site. The role receives, stores and issues high-value hardware (GPU racks, servers, network equipment, spare parts), keeps stock and asset records accurate, and provides equipment to data center engineers on time.
The specialist is the site's hands-on link to the wider logistics function: Transportation and Transport Coordination for arrivals and pickups, Logistics Planning and 3PL Planning for schedules, Back Office for system records, and the Project Office for new processes and tools.
Key Responsibilities
1. Receiving & Dispatch
•    Receive inbound shipments per the delivery schedule; check seals, packaging and contents against ASN, packing list and PO.
•    Record damage and discrepancies with photos on arrival and hand them to Transport Coordination for insurance cases.
•    Prepare outbound shipments and RMA returns: picking, packing, labelling, documents; hand over to carriers at the agreed pickup time.
•    Follow handling standards for heavy, fragile and high-value equipment.
2. Provisioning to Data Center Operations
•    Issue equipment and spare parts to DC engineers on time, according to requests and project priorities.
•    Stage and kit hardware for rack deployments as agreed with ITDC and Project Managers.
•    Keep a clear view of what is available on site and flag shortages to the Team Lead and Logistics Planning.
3. Inventory & Asset Control
•    Post receipts, issues and transfers in ERP/WMS on the same day as the physical movement.
•    Create inventory and asset records for received equipment, including serial numbers.
•    Carry out cycle counts and annual stock takes; investigate and report discrepancies to Back Office.
•    Keep the warehouse tidy, labelled and organized by location.
4. Security, Safety & Compliance
•    Follow site security procedures for deliveries, access control and storage of high-value items.
•    Apply safety rules for handling equipment and operating material handling equipment.
•    Keep records complete and audit-ready (SOX, internal and external audits).
5. Process & Continuous Improvement
•    Work according to global SOPs and site-specific instructions.
•    Suggest improvements and report recurring issues to the Team Lead and the Project Office.
•    Take part in pilots and rollouts of new processes and tools (WMS/TMS, automations) at the site.
6. Local Expertise
•    Provide site-specific knowledge (access rules, dock limits, local carriers and customs specifics) to Transport, Planning and 3PL teams.
•    Identify local operational risks and propose practical mitigation.
7. Add-on Roles (when assigned)
•    + RMA: own RMA flows at the site — intake, documentation, return shipment, status tracking.
•    + Key User (IRG / NetSuite / Project44): first-line support and training for colleagues on the system, test changes, collect feedback for the Project Office.
Expectations
Autonomy: Independently runs daily warehouse tasks at the site within SOPs; escalates discrepancies, damage and security issues to the Team Lead.
Impact: Keeps DC engineers supplied with the right hardware on time and keeps site stock accurate.
Communication: Clear, timely updates to the Team Lead, DC engineers and logistics teams.
Travel: Occasional support to other sites during launches or peaks.
Work Mode: On site; remote work not expected.

Benefits & Perks:

  • Competitive compensation
  • Career growth and learning opportunities
  • Flexibility and ownership
  • Collaborative and innovative culture
  • Opportunity to work on impactful AI projects
  • International environment and talented teams

What's it like to work at Nebius:

Fast moving - Bold thinking - Constant growth - Meaningful impact - Trust and real ownership - Opportunity to shape the future of AI

title: Data Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Studytube maakt professionele ontwikkeling toegankelijk. Achter het platform zit een groeiende stroom leerdata. Die moet klanten, de business en de AI-features die we bouwen écht verder helpen. Daar zoeken we een Data Engineer voor die de datalaag bezit.

De rol

Je komt in een klein datateam binnen Product & Tech en rapporteert aan de Head of Engineering. Je werk bedient twee takken. Business: rapportages voor commerce, management en investeerders. Product: de inzichten die klanten in het platform zien, zoals voortgang en budget. Collega’s bouwen de dashboards, jij zorgt dat de data eronder klopt en meebeweegt met het product.

Je werkt dagelijks samen met een businessanalist en een productanalist, die ook met Looker en dbt werkt. Er komt nog een analist bij. Een ervaren data engineer sluit één dag per week aan en een Data Lead staat op de planning.

Wat je doet

  • Je bent eigenaar van het Snowflake-platform: rollen en rechten, warehouse sizing en provisioning, tasks en kosten.

  • Je beheert GitHub voor het dataplatform: branches, environments en automatisering met GitHub Actions.

  • Je neemt Databricks, opgezet voor een high-security omgeving, over van een externe partij en bereidt de migratie van Snowflake naar Databricks voor, gepland voor volgend jaar.

  • Je bouwt pipelines die incrementeel, idempotent, getest en gedocumenteerd zijn, en ontsluit bronnen via Fivetran of custom connectors.

  • Je zorgt dat dbt Cloud betrouwbaar draait: afhankelijkheden, scheduling en failure handling.

  • Je bewaakt freshness, volume en schema drift, en zoekt de root cause als iets breekt.

  • Je ruimt de architectuur op, maakt het platform uitbreidbaar en bouwt GDPR-bewust: toegang, retentie en verwijdering zitten in het ontwerp.

  • Je legt het fundament voor metrics waar sales, marketing en product op sturen, in plaats van handmatige Excels.


Wie je bent

Je hebt 3 tot 6 jaar productie-ervaring als data engineer. Je hebt de valkuilen al eens gezien en levert zonder platformteam achter je een geteste, gemonitorde oplossing op.

Je bent proactief en signaleert zelf wat beter moet. Je bent op je plek in een scale-up: je kunt tegen wat chaos en je brengt structuur aan. Je legt trade-offs helder uit aan niet-technische collega’s.

Je maakt analytics engineers en analisten productief. Kunnen zij een tabel niet vinden, begrijpen of vertrouwen, of lopen ze vast op tooling of toegang, dan is het werk niet af.

Must-haves

  • Databricks in productie (Delta Lake, Unity Catalog), bij voorkeur op Azure.

  • Diepgaande ervaring met dbt (Cloud) in productie: Jinja, geautomatiseerd testen, deployment pipelines en environments.

  • Ervaring met het opzetten en structureren van een Git-workflow: branchingstrategie, pull requests en code review.

  • Terraform of andere infrastructure-as-code.

  • Snowflake of een vergelijkbaar warehouse.

  • Python en ingestie via Fivetran of custom connectors.

  • Data tests als standaard, oog voor cloudkosten.

  • Engels op professioneel niveau, schriftelijk en mondeling.

  • Bereid tot een Nederlandse veiligheidsscreening (VGB).

Mooi meegenomen: een warehouse-migratie, Looker of data contracts, gereguleerde of publieke omgevingen, B2B SaaS.

Stack

Snowflake (huidig warehouse), Databricks (Azure), Fivetran, dbt, GitHub, Metabase, Looker.

Wat we bieden

  • Een competitief salaris en de ruimte om data engineering bij Studytube neer te zetten.

  • Hybride werken: 3 dagen op kantoor in de Houthavens, 2 dagen thuis.

  • 25 vakantiedagen plus een vrije dag op je verjaardag.

  • 3% pensioen via a.s.r., volledig betaald door Studytube.

  • € 1.000 leerbudget per jaar, waarvan de helft voor welzijn of je thuiswerkplek.

  • LevelUp Academy, Studygym, MacBook Air en € 10 telefoonvergoeding.

  • Verzorgde lunches tegen een kleine bijdrage, kwartaaluitjes en een jaarlijks bedrijfsfeest.

Studytube is het all-in-one leerplatform voor meer dan 600 organisaties, onder wie Bol.com, a.s.r., CZ, Manpower en VolkerWessels. Met 200+ collega’s willen we het nummer 1-platform voor professionele ontwikkeling in Europa worden. De datalaag is nu de bottleneck. Wie die recht trekt, maakt de ambities op AI en klantwaarde mogelijk.

Solliciteer via deze vacature. Vragen: .

descriptionHtml:
Who we’re looking for 

Fieldwire is looking for a Data Intelligence Manager to join our Data & Operations team based in Manchester, England. You will be the operational owner of reporting and analytics for a core business function (G&A, R&D, or GTM), turning raw data into accurate, timely, and trusted intelligence that drive decisions at the executive and departmental level. You will work closely with our Data Engineers, DIM Team Lead, and business partners to build dashboards, define KPIs, and maintain rigorous data quality. What you’ll be doing

  • Build, maintain, and continuously improve dashboards and BI products (Power BI or equivalent), ensuring they are always live, accurate, and clearly documented 
  • Define and govern KPIs and performance metrics for your business area, ensuring consistent definitions across teams and regions 
  • Act as the primary business partner for stakeholders in your assigned function — translating business questions into analytical requirements and delivering clear, decision-ready intelligence 
  • Conduct extensive QA on all data outputs: validate inputs, test transformations, reconcile outputs against source systems, and prevent conflicting or duplicate reporting 
  • Maintain a single source of truth for your reporting area, ensuring consistency across all dashboards and outputs 
  • Manage a release and change control process for dashboard updates — including testing, versioning, and stakeholder communication before any changes go live 
  • Monitor data quality continuously; detect and escalate anomalies, breaks, or integrity issues early 
  • Document all metrics, logic, and definitions clearly so that any stakeholder can understand what the data means and how it is calculated 
  • Contribute to cross-training within the DIM team to ensure coverage and reduce single points of failure 
  • Support the DIM Team Lead and Director of Operations in roadmap planning and continuous improvement of the reporting landscape 

At Fieldwire, we’re looking for our next Data Intelligence Manager to have the following skills and experiences: 

  • 3-5 years of experience in a data analytics, business intelligence, or data intelligence role 
  • Strong proficiency in SQL and hands-on experience building dashboards in Power BI 
  • Experience working with large datasets across multiple systems and understanding how to combine them into coherent reporting 
  • Demonstrated ability to conduct rigorous QA on data outputs and maintain high standards of accuracy 
  • Strong analytical and critical thinking skills — able to identify inconsistencies and root-cause data issues independently

  • Experience working with dbt, Snowflake, or similar modern data stack components  
  • Exposure to data governance frameworks and metric catalogues  
  • Prior experience supporting executive-level reporting or board-level dashboards  
  • Background in construction technology or field operations analytics is a plus 

Why Fieldwire?

As part of the Hilti Group, Fieldwire combines deep construction expertise with modern digital innovation to deliver better outcomes on every job. Learn more at Fieldwire.com.

Als Digitalisierungslotse/-lotsin gestaltest du die digitale Entwicklung im ländlichen Raum aktiv mit. Dabei stehen nicht die Technologien, sondern die Menschen und ihre Ideen im Mittelpunkt.

  • Menschen vernetzen: Du bringst Unternehmen, Selbstständige, Vereine, Kommunen, Bildungseinrichtungen und kreative Köpfe zusammen und förderst neue Kooperationen.

  • Digitalisierung greifbar machen: Du vermittelst digitale Möglichkeiten verständlich, baust Berührungsängste ab und unterstützt Menschen dabei, eigene Lösungen zu finden – auf Augenhöhe statt durch klassische Beratung.

  • Eigene Projekte gestalten: Du entwickelst Workshops, Veranstaltungen, Netzwerkformate und Kooperationen und setzt eigene Schwerpunkte innerhalb des Projektrahmens.

  • KI aktiv nutzen und vermitteln: Du probierst KI-Anwendungen selbst aus, integrierst sie in deinen Arbeitsalltag, bildest dich weiter und gibst dein Wissen praxisnah weiter.

  • Regionale Potenziale stärken: Du erkennst Chancen, greifst Ideen auf und verbindest Menschen und Ressourcen, um die Digitalisierung auf Rügen und in Vorpommern voranzubringen.

Was diese Position besonders macht

  • Gestaltungsfreiheit und Eigenverantwortung: Du kannst eigene Ideen einbringen, Themen entdecken und Projekte weitgehend selbstbestimmt entwickeln.

  • Flexibles Arbeiten, das gelebt wird: Flexible Arbeitszeiten, unterschiedliche Arbeitsorte und eigenverantwortliche Arbeitsgestaltung gehören zur Unternehmenskultur. Vertrauen und Ergebnisse stehen im Vordergrund.

  • KI und Weiterbildung ausdrücklich erwünscht: Der Arbeitgeber unterstützt dich aktiv dabei, neue Technologien und insbesondere KI kennenzulernen, auszuprobieren und sinnvoll einzusetzen. Lernen und Experimentieren sind ausdrücklich Teil deiner Arbeit.

  • Ein vielfältiges regionales Netzwerk: Du arbeitest mit spannenden Menschen und Partnern aus Wirtschaft, Tourismus, Bildung, Kultur, Verwaltung und Zivilgesellschaft zusammen – auf Rügen, in Vorpommern und darüber hinaus.

  • Abwechslungsreiche Arbeit mit Sinn: Kein Tag ist wie der andere. Du bist Impulsgeber:in, Netzwerker:in und Möglichmacher:in und kannst unmittelbar erleben, wie aus Begegnungen neue Ideen und Projekte entstehen.

Was du mitbringen solltest

Neugier auf digitale Entwicklungen, Freude an der Arbeit mit Menschen, Eigeninitiative, Kreativität und Lust, Neues auszuprobieren. Du musst nicht alles wissen – entscheidend ist die Bereitschaft, gemeinsam mit anderen zu lernen und Lösungen zu entwickeln.

Das Besondere

Du arbeitest nicht einfach Digitalisierungsmaßnahmen ab. Du hast die Freiheit, Menschen, Ideen und Technologien miteinander zu verbinden und die digitale Zukunft einer ganzen Region aktiv mitzugestalten.

Neugierig? Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung!

title: Director, Global Partner Enablement
descriptionHtml:
Role Summary

The Director of Global Partner Enablement is responsible for defining and scaling a global enablement strategy that drives partner preference, pipeline growth, and customer security outcomes across Sophos’ go-to-market model. This role ensures that partners—including VARs, MSPs, MSSPs, and distributors—are fully enabled to sell, deploy, manage, and expand Sophos solutions globally.

This leader combines deep channel expertise, practical AI fluency, modern learning approaches, and strong field execution. They will translate Sophos’ cybersecurity strategy into role-based, lifecycle-driven enablement that accelerates partner time-to-value and long-term commercial success.

The ability to use AI tools in a builder capacity will be critical to success in this role. This leader will use AI to scale partner curriculum and content production and establish repeatable processes for sourcing accurate technical content.

As part of the Global Go-to-Market Enablement team, this leader will partner closely with Global Channel, Regional Partner Leaders, Sales, and Marketing leadership to embed enablement into field execution. The role will also be accountable for delivering against specific AI-related OKRs established for the position.


What You Will Do

  • Execute a Partner-First GTM Enablement Strategy

  • Define and execute a global partner enablement strategy aligned to Sophos’ GTM model, partner program tiers, and regional growth priorities.

  • Ensure enablement supports key Sophos motions, including MSP/MSSP managed security services, solution selling, renewals, and expansion.

  • Lead change management initiatives that evolve partner behaviors in support of new GTM motions, platform adoption, and services-led selling.

  • Deliver Role-Based Partner Learning and Readiness Programs

  • Design and scale role-specific partner learning journeys across sales, technical pre-sales, implementation, managed services, customer success, and renewals.

  • Guide partners from onboarding through advanced competency and specialization, aligned to Sophos certifications, accreditations, and partner program requirements.

  • Apply adult learning principles, instructional design best practices, and skills-based frameworks to ensure learning drives behavior change and performance.

  • Maintain content lifecycle governance to ensure enablement stays current with product releases, platform evolution, and threat landscape changes.

  • Support MSP / MSSP Enablement and Field Execution

  • Ensure enablement directly supports MSP and MSSP business models, including recurring revenue motions, operational efficiency, and service differentiation.

  • Establish global enablement standards, frameworks, and governance while enabling regional flexibility based on market needs.

  • Collaborate with Regional Enablement and Field teams to support GTM launches, sales plays, campaigns, and priority partners.

  • Coordinate delivery of enablement such as workshops, simulations, solution playbooks, and technical labs that reinforce real-world execution.

  • Act as an executive escalation point for strategic partner enablement needs.

  • Define and Track Enablement Success Metrics

  • Ensure success metrics are tied to Sophos business outcomes, including partner ramp time, certification attainment, pipeline contribution, deal velocity, adoption, renewal rates, and expansion.

  • Leverage CRM, partner performance data, and field insights to identify skill gaps and optimize enablement investments.

  • Provide executive-ready reporting that demonstrates enablement impact on partner success and revenue growth.

  • Drive Content Strategy with Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Oversee the global partner enablement content strategy, including onboarding programs, solution and security playbooks, labs, partner toolkits, and just-in-time resources.

  • Serve as a cross-functional leader working closely with Product Marketing, Product Management, Partner Programs, Sales, and Channel to ensure alignment and consistency.

  • Build, mentor, and lead a high-performing global partner enablement team (direct and/or dotted-line), operating effectively in a matrixed environment.

  • Lead AI-Powered Partner Enablement

  • Use generative AI and prompt-driven workflows to scale partner curriculum, technical content, playbooks, labs, and self-service resources while maintaining appropriate human review.

  • Establish repeatable processes for sourcing, reviewing, governing, and publishing accurate technical content from Sales Engineers, Product, Product Marketing, and other SMEs.

  • Use platform data and partner feedback to improve content quality, production speed, adoption, and partner readiness.

What You Will Bring

  • 10+ years of experience in partner enablement, channel sales, customer success enablement, or learning and development within cybersecurity or enterprise SaaS.

  • Deep hands-on experience enabling global channel partners across Americas, EMEA, and APJ, with strong understanding of MSP, MSSP, VAR, and distributor models.

  • Proven success designing and executing role-based, GTM-aligned learning programs that drive measurable partner performance.

  • Experience working closely with Sales, Channel, and Customer Success leaders in a partner-first organization.

  • Data-driven mindset with the ability to define KPIs, analyze performance, and demonstrate enablement ROI.

  • Exceptional executive communication, facilitation, and stakeholder influence skills.

  • Practical AI fluency, including generative AI, prompt design, content transformation, and quality-review workflows.

  • Experience building AI-assisted enablement and technical content processes that balance speed, accuracy, governance, source traceability, and human judgment.

  • Experience supporting or scaling MSP/MSSP-centric GTM motions.

  • Familiarity with Sophos-style partner programs, certifications, and security solutions.

  • Experience with enablement platforms, LMS/LXP systems, partner portals, CRM (e.g., Salesforce), and content authoring tools.

  • Experience applying AI-driven learning and enablement tools to accelerate partner readiness, adoption & performance at scale.

  • Foundational understanding of instructional design, adult learning theory, and skills-based enablement frameworks.

  • Advanced degree in business, learning, or a related field.

title: Director, Investment, Global Client Solutions
descriptionHtml:
About WPP Media

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth. 

WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.

For more information, visit wppmedia.com.

3912 - Director, Investment, Global Client Solutions

Role Summary and Impact

About the Client

DoorDash is a global commerce platform empowering local economies by connecting consumers to their neighbourhoods. In EMEA, DoorDash operates through two brands: Deliveroo (across 7 markets: UK, Ireland, France, Belgium, Italy, the UAE, and Kuwait) and Wolt (across 31 markets across Europe and Central Asia).

We have expanded our remit on Doordash Group to global, building on WPP Media’s long-standing US partnership with DoorDash, we are launching Open Atlas—a dedicated WPP Media team delivering the best of the network to drive growth for the brands.  We officially start working with the client from 1 January 2027, so this role offers a rare, opportunity to help shape our team culture, operating model, and client processes from day one.

The Role

Sitting within the EMEA hub, this role focuses on [Deliveroo / Deliveroo & Wolt]. The role of the Hub is to drive the cross-market agenda across strategy, planning, measurement, and data—collaborating closely with both the US global team and local market teams to deliver best-in-class solutions to deliver their growth ambitions.

Our scope covers brand activation, both online and offline, though the expectation of the client is that we work closely at the centre, and have a point of view, across all functions within their marketing mix (across paid, owned, shared and earned).

Behaviours and Attitudes that Deliveroo expect all people who work on the account to show are:

Natural Collaboration & Proactivity

  • Key trait: "Lean-in" attitude and cross-functional teamwork.
  • Description: Team members need to be innate team players who proactively step up, support one another, and connect seamlessly across agency networks, international offices, and in-house teams.

Pragmatism & Simplicity

  • Key trait: Cutting through complexity.
  • Description: Ability to simplify strategies and execution without overcomplicating or overthinking. Focus on clarity, practicality, and actionable outcomes when time is limited.

Agility & High-Pace Execution

  • Key trait: Bias for speed and action ("Pace of Delivery").
  • Description: Comfort working at a fast speed using an 80/20 principle—making quick, effective decisions and delivering results rapidly rather than striving for perfect but delayed outcomes.

Adaptability & Drive for Change

  • Key trait: Opportunistic and forward-thinking mindset.
  • Description: Readiness to embrace change, spot tactical opportunities quickly (especially in paid media), and adjust direction swiftly in response to competitive ad pressure and market dynamics.

Brand Immersion & Cultural Sensitivity

  • Key trait: "Living and breathing Deliveroo."
  • Description: Deep passion for the brand coupled with a keen awareness of pop culture, social trends, and earned media relevance to ensure campaigns hit the right cultural note.

Hands-On Ownership & Initiative

  • Key trait: Practicality and accountability.
  • Description: A blend of deep domain knowledge and a willingness to roll up their sleeves, take direct responsibility, and see execution through end-to-end.

Creative Problem-Solving & Resourcefulness

  • Key trait: Solution-oriented mindset under constraints.
  • Description: Ability to navigate complex structural setups (e.g., hybrid agency/in-house models, flexible 80/20 budget allocations), continuously question competitive pressure, and find efficient solutions to spend budgets effectively without leftovers.

What You Will Be Accountable For

  • Global and EMEA investment agenda: Shape priorities with Global Investment, Partnerships and commercial counterparts; define relevant EMEA applications in consultation with client and market leads; and establish regional principles, guardrails and escalation thresholds.
  • Opportunity and partnership development: Maintain a forward-looking view of investment, technology, commerce, partner and Ads opportunities. Assess them with Strategy, Planning, specialist and market leads, then develop the strongest into propositions, frameworks or tests.
  • Global partnerships, JBPs and value: Translate DoorDash and WPP relationships into usable EMEA value across commercials, data, insight, innovation, technology, access, testing, service and thought leadership.
  • Strategy, planning and investment recommendations: Contribute investment conditions, partner capabilities and activation realities to Strategy, Growth Audience, Data Strategy and Planning. Working from agreed audiences, integrated plans, channel roles and allocation rationale, recommend where investment should be maintained, increased, redirected, reduced or tested.
  • Investment and value governance: Make pricing, quality, commitments, proprietary solutions, trade-offs and risks visible. Consult Trading, Partnerships and Media Solutions on methodology, negotiations, commercial mechanics and evidence, escalating material concerns early.
  • Activation direction and market enablement: Set regional investment and activation standards, guardrails and escalation routes with Planning, Operations, channel specialists and markets. Protect investment intent through execution while Trading, local and specialist teams retain detailed negotiation, buying, activation and optimisation.
  • Ads ecosystem growth: Contribute EMEA demand and market intelligence to the Global DoorDash Ads agenda. Identify WPP-client opportunities through the relevant client leaders and help Global Ads, commercial, measurement and market teams shape use cases and approved pilots.
  • Measurement, learning and transformation: Define investment, partnership and activation questions with Analytics & Measurement, which owns methodology, KPIs, reporting outcomes, incrementality and test design. Interpret learning for investment, partner and activation guardrails, while Planning owns the integrated PCA narrative and resulting planning and optimisation actions. Apply WPP Open and approved AI-enabled workflows to improve investment intelligence and transparency, becoming proficient within an agreed onboarding period.

Core Deliverables

  • EMEA investment and partnership agenda, investment principles, market guardrails and activation standards.
  • Quarterly investment recommendations and prioritised partner, innovation and Ads opportunity pipeline.
  • Partner opportunity cases, JBP application plans and value, commitment and risk scorecards.
  • Investment and activation readiness input, PCA learning and EMEA Ads growth opportunities.

How You Will Work

  • Natural collaboration and proactivity: Connect Global, Regional, specialist and market teams around clear priorities and decisions.
  • Commercial curiosity: Look beyond immediate briefs to identify emerging investment, partnership and advertiser opportunities.
  • Pragmatism and simplicity: Turn complex commercial and investment information into clear client choices.
  • Agility and decisive leadership: Act early when value, commitments, objectivity or activation quality are at risk.
  • Transparency and objectivity: Make trade-offs, approvals, proprietary solutions and risks visible.
  • Market sensitivity: Balance global scale and regional opportunity with local-market realities.
  • Hands-on ownership: Stay close enough to challenge confidently and see opportunities through to measurable value.

Skills and Experience

You will be a commercially astute, proactive and influential investment leader who can help shape a Global agenda, define its EMEA application and mobilise complex teams to deliver measurable value. You will combine strong investment judgement with partnership fluency, curiosity and senior-client leadership.

Essential

  • Proven experience across media investment, partnerships, trading, activation or integrated media, including complex multi-market clients.
  • Strong understanding of offline, direct-digital and biddable investment and activation models.
  • Experience shaping Global investment or partnership agendas and translating them into regional priorities, market guardrails and evidence-based recommendations.
  • Ability to identify emerging opportunities and turn them into strategically and commercially credible propositions.
  • Experience applying Global JBPs and partner agreements to create regional and local value.
  • Strong commercial judgement across pricing, commitments, data, insight, innovation, access, service and proprietary-media safeguards.
  • Experience balancing global and regional scale with local buying, activation and regulatory realities.
  • Strong senior-client leadership, negotiation, influencing and escalation skills across Global, Regional and Local teams.
  • Measurement literacy connecting investment, partnership and Ads opportunities to outcomes.
  • Demonstrable experience using AI-enabled tools, agentic workflows or comparable investment, intelligence or workflow platforms in a professional environment. Prior WPP Open experience is not required, but proficiency in relevant capabilities must be developed within an agreed onboarding period; fluency in English.

Advantageous

  • Marketplace, delivery, commerce, technology or platform experience.
  • Retail-media, commerce-media, advertising-monetisation or Ads-ecosystem experience.
  • Experience across large strategic and smaller long-tail markets, distributed activation or offshore Ad Operations; additional European languages.
  • Prior experience with WPP Open or comparable investment, intelligence or workflow platforms.

Life at WPP Media & Benefits

Our passion for shaping the next era of media is powered by our commitment to Be Extraordinary, investing in our employees to inspire transformational creativity. We also Lead Optimistically, firmly believing in and Championing Growth and Development for every individual. This commitment allows WPP Media employees to leverage the extensive global WPP Media & WPP networks to pursue their passions, build vital professional connections, and learn at the cutting edge of marketing and advertising. 

We Create an Open environment built on trust and respect, where everyone feels they belong and has opportunities to progress. This inclusive culture is fostered through a variety of employee resource groups and frequent in-office events showcasing team wins, sharing thought leadership, and celebrating holidays and milestone events. Our comprehensive benefits package reflects this commitment, including competitive medical, group retirement plans, vision, and dental insurance, significant paid time off, preferential partner discounts, and employee mental health awareness days. 

WPP Media is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to characteristics. We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection in this open and supportive environment. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.  Please note that while our philosophy is the same across WPP, benefits may vary by office/country.

Please note this is a UK based role and requires individuals to have the right to work in this location

descriptionHtml:

descriptionHtml:

Our role at SIE is to create and nurture the experiences under the PlayStation brand, a name synonymous with entertainment excellence and creativity.

Job Title: Director of Product Management 

Location: Remote 

Company: PlayStation Studios 

As the Director of Product Management, you will work as part of the central Live Services team, reporting to the Head of Product Management for Live Service games at PlayStation Studios. Your primary responsibility is to work as a subject matter expert, leading a small central team collaborating with European game studios and other partners (analytics, marketing, etc.) to help build, launch, and manage successful live service games, while helping studios to build out top-notch embedded capabilities. 

Responsibilities

  • Work across multiple live and upcoming titles from PlayStation Studios, partnering closely with game studios and other partners to build capabilities and successfully launch and manage live service titles. 
  • Engage with game teams on everything from high-level product and commercial strategy to evaluating design specs and mockups, with a focus on product prioritization and roadmaps. 
  • Identify opportunities for product performance growth for various titles, influence key stakeholders, and drive initiatives to a successful outcome through strong relationships. 
  • Develop and share best practices to help game studios stand up and evolve their processes and capabilities. 
  • Define product strategy frameworks and standards for live service titles, tailoring approaches to the needs of individual games and studios. 
  • Define and evolve core KPIs in partnership with other publishing resources (analytics, research, marketing, etc), ensuring consistent measurement and actionable insights across titles. 
  • Establish and evolve live service operating rhythms (goal setting, performance reviews, experimentation, roadmap planning, decision trees) across titles. 
  • Partner with finance and forecasting teams to refine revenue models, ensuring assumptions align with product strategy and core KPIs. 
  • Manage, develop, and grow a small team of product management and live service design talent, leading and inspiring a highly skilled team. 
  • Connect development teams across PlayStation studios to the latest competitive research, analyze industry trends, and define best practices. 
  • Function as a conduit between multiple studios to foster knowledge sharing and deeper collaboration. 
  • Help define the processes and methodologies used centrally to level up our product management craft and improve the way we build and operate live service games. 

Qualifications & Skills

  • Strong experience in product management and/or live service design focused on feature development and live operations. 
  • Proven track record working in complex, matrixed development/publishing organizations to deliver outsized results on successful live games. 
  • Seasoned people leader with an ability to manage, lead and inspire a highly skilled team. 
  • Demonstrated track record of success driving initiatives that positively impact core KPIs. 
  • Expert data fluency and track record of partnering with analytics, research, and insights groups. 
  • Experience with game economy and/or monetization modeling and experience with analytical tools (e.g. Looker, Tableau, etc.). 
  • Diverse development experience spanning different types of games, genres, and business models (F2P, paid, cosmetic economy, etc.). 
  • Expert ability to connect creative vision, analytics, and business goals – turning data into actionable product and design decisions. 
  • Deep understanding of industry trends and the competitive landscape, including player motivations and audience segments across genres. 
  • Ability to understand, conceptualize, and improve the design of game systems, features, and mechanics, providing recommendations to shape the direction of the product. 
  • Experience working across products at different development stages (incubation, live operations, etc.). 
  • Strong business and financial acumen, with experience driving revenue forecasting and KPI frameworks for live service products. 
  • Experience working with publishing partners (marketing, release management, store, etc.). 
  • Experience partnering with leadership/executives at a studio and publishing level.

title: Electrical & Electronics Engineering Manager - Semiconductor Metrology
descriptionHtml:
Lead Electrical & Electronics Engineering for Next-Generation Semiconductor Metrology

£65,000 - £83,000 + EMI Share Options + Private Healthcare + 3x Death in Service + Hybrid Working

Would you enjoy leading the electrical and electronics engineering capability behind technology that is helping semiconductor manufacturers push the limits of what is physically possible?

Infinitesima develops world-leading metrology solutions used by some of the most advanced semiconductor organisations in the world. Supported by Applied Ventures and backed by a growing global customer base, we're scaling rapidly and investing heavily in our engineering capability.

We're looking for an experienced Electrical & Electronics Engineering Manager to lead a team responsible for the electrical systems, power distribution, electronics and signal acquisition at the heart of our products, along with the electrical safety and compliance of our platforms.

This is a rare opportunity to combine:

  • Technical leadership
  • People leadership
  • Semiconductor technology
  • Electrical and electronics engineering
  • Hands-on engineering

You'll influence both engineering strategy and product direction while remaining close enough to the technology to solve complex technical challenges when needed.

Why Join Infinitesima?

You'll be working on technology that matters

Our products enable the development of next-generation semiconductor devices, supporting advances in computing, communications, AI and high-performance electronics.

You'll have genuine influence

This is not a maintenance management role. You'll help shape the future direction of our electrical and electronics platforms, engineering standards and technical roadmap.

You'll lead talented engineers

You'll support, mentor and develop a highly capable electrical and electronics team, building their ability to work through hard problems themselves rather than solving everything yourself, whilst helping attract the next generation of engineering talent.

You'll grow with us

We're already over 150 employees and continuing to scale as demand for our technology increases globally.

You'll split your time between the bench and the business

Expect a genuine mix: time in the office and, when your team needs it, hands-on at the lab bench working through difficult PCB, wiring or EMC problems alongside them. Equally, you'll spend time away from the bench in meetings, planning and shaping where the team goes next.

What You'll Be Doing

Leading and developing a high-performing electrical and electronics team

  • Coaching, mentoring and supporting engineers through regular development discussions
  • Building technical capability and encouraging engineering excellence
  • Creating an environment where people can do their best work
  • Providing supervisory oversight of the controls engineering function, ensuring close alignment with electrical and electronics priorities

Providing deep technical leadership on the hardest problems

  • Acting as the team's escalation point for complex PCB, electrical wiring and EMC issues, working through root cause and resolution with authority
  • Coaching engineers to build their own problem-solving capability, rather than solving every issue yourself
  • Bringing low-level design expertise to bear on system-level and architectural decisions

Driving electrical and electronics engineering strategy

  • Defining electrical system architecture, power distribution and electronics capability
  • Influencing future product development and technology roadmaps
  • Establishing engineering standards and best practice
  • Assessing the scope of new and unfamiliar projects and proposing solutions at an architectural level
  • Championing new ways of working, including the practical adoption of AI and other emerging engineering tools
  • Engaging with the competence management framework and advocating for improvements that strengthen the team's capability

Owning electrical safety and compliance

  • Taking responsibility for electrical cabinet design and power distribution across our platforms
  • Ensuring electrical safety and compliance throughout the product lifecycle, including CE marking and SEMI safety standards (e.g. SEMI S2)
  • Leading electrical risk assessments and supporting certification activities

Delivering robust electronics and measurement performance

  • Designing and reviewing electronics and power systems, with instrumentation and precision measurement forming part of the wider remit
  • Ensuring signal integrity across complex electrical and electronics platforms
  • Optimising power delivery, grounding and noise performance

Collaborating across engineering disciplines

  • Working closely with optics, controls, software, systems and mechanical engineering teams
  • Supporting successful project delivery from concept through to production
  • Driving technical decision-making across multidisciplinary programmes

What We're Looking For

You'll likely have gained experience in environments such as:

  • Semiconductor equipment
  • Semiconductor metrology
  • Electrical and electronics capital equipment
  • Precision measurement systems
  • Test and measurement
  • Advanced manufacturing equipment
  • Capital equipment development

Essential Experience

Candidates new to a formal people management role are welcome to apply, provided they can demonstrate a strong track record of delivering complex electronics designs.

  • Leadership of electrical or electronics engineering teams
  • Analogue and mixed-signal electronics design
  • PCB design and signal integrity
  • Hands-on, low-level troubleshooting of complex PCB, wiring and EMC issues, with the credibility to guide others through them
  • Electrical cabinet design and power distribution within complex systems
  • Electrical safety and compliance, including CE marking and SEMI standards
  • Low-noise amplifier design and selection
  • ADC and DAC architecture and implementation
  • Signal generation, conditioning and acquisition
  • Power distribution and grounding within sensitive systems
  • Product lifecycle management and engineering change control
  • Cross-functional engineering leadership

Highly Desirable

  • Semiconductor metrology systems
  • Semiconductor capital equipment
  • Precision positioning systems
  • Piezo drive systems
  • EMC and environmental considerations
  • Instrumentation and precision measurement system experience
  • Frequency domain analysis
  • Electrical/electronics simulation and PCB design tools
  • NPI and manufacturing support
  • Experience applying AI or other emerging tools to engineering workflows
  • Experience with competence management frameworks or structured engineering development programmes

A bit about us: 

Infinitesima is a privately owned company founded in 2001, as a spin-out of the University of Bristol, by CTO Professor Andrew Humphris. Our dynamic team of scientists and engineers is focussed on enabling the next generation of semiconductor devices through delivery of innovative products to customers around the world. 

Our strength lies in the varied perspectives that come from different cultures, experiences, and identities. We believe that true innovation is fuelled by collaboration, locally and globally. We strive to foster an environment where everyone can contribute meaningfully and thrive. If you require adjustments to take part in the recruitment process, please let us know, we’ll do our best to support you.

Your recruitment journey:

We will interview you: Monday to Friday UK Time 9am to 4.30pm and we'll be as flexible as we can with Global Scheduling

1st stage: (45 minute) Remote meeting to evaluate your experience and technical ability

2nd stage: (2.5 hours) Face to face onsite evaluating technical, presentation and communication skills along with your ways of working and your opportunity to to know more about us

If you're not comfortable with eye contact, let us know at the start of your interview and if REMOTE, once we've said hello, feel free to turn your camera off until the end.

Informal dress is absolutely fine for onsite interviews, we want you to feel comfortable when you meet us and if there's anything else we can do to support your journey, just let us know. 

A note on how we use AI:
We use AI only to transcribe our interviews so we can focus fully on you instead of scribbling notes. The AI does not take part in any decision making at any stage. All hiring decisions are made by real humans based on the conversation we have with you.

Location and working pattern:
We recognise the value of flexibility and offer a hybrid working model wherever possible. Most employees work onsite three days per week, although some positions require a greater onsite presence due to the nature of the work and business need

Recruitment agencies: Infinitesima Ltd only works with approved agencies and does not accept unsolicited agency CVs. Please do not submit candidate details in response to this advert or solicit any Infinitesima Ltd employees. Infinitesima Ltd is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited CVs.

title: Elektroplaner Smart Home als Content Creator (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:

„Smart Home oder konventionell?“ Die Frage landet immer bei dir, weil du dich sehr gut auskennst und auch gut erklären kannst? Dann komm zu uns und mach genau das zu deinem Job!

JETPLAN entwickelt die Zukunft der Elektroplanung – für Elektrohandwerk, Planer und Bauwirtschaft.

Wir suchen eine Person, die echte Planungspraxis aus dem Wohnbau mitbringt und daraus Videos, Musterplanungen und How-tos für YouTube und Social Media macht. Du bist das Gesicht, das zeigt, wie moderne und zunehmend KI-gestützte Elektroplanung mit JETPLAN funktioniert.

Dein Fachwissen ist dabei der Kern: Nur wer selbst plant, kann komplexe Themen so erklären, dass Elektriker und Bauherren wirklich etwas davon haben.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Du produzierst How-to-Videos, Tutorials und Kurzformate für YouTube, LinkedIn, Instagram & Co. Dabei erklärst du, wie typische Kundenwünsche in JETPLAN planerisch dargestellt werden.

  • Du erstellst normkonforme Musterplanungen für typische Wohnbauprojekte – vom Einfamilienhaus bis zur Wohnung, konventionell und Smart Home.

  • Du zeigst Systeme wie KNX, Loxone und DALI im Planungsalltag: Wann passt was, worauf kommt es an?

  • Du entwickelst Themen- und Formatideen mit und greifst Fragen aus der Community auf.

  • Mit deiner Planungserfahrung bringst du wertvolle Impulse in die Produktentwicklung ein.

Dein Publikum: Elektriker, Planer und planungsinteressierte Bauherren.

Wohin die Rolle wachsen kann

Im Kern geht es ums Planen, Erklären und Beraten vor der Kamera. Wenn du Lust und Erfahrung mitbringst, kann die Rolle deutlich strategischer werden: Du gestaltest die Content-Ausrichtung mit – welche Zielgruppen, welche Themen, wo Longform, wo Shortform –, spielst Inhalte gezielt über YouTube, Suche und Social Ads aus und wertest aus, welche Inhalte wirklich Anfragen bringen. Wie weit das geht, entscheiden wir gemeinsam – je nachdem, was du mitbringst.

Das bringst du mit

Du musst nicht aus einem Planungsbüro kommen: Quereinsteiger mit elektrotechnischer Ausbildung sind herzlich willkommen, vor allem aus dem Elektrohandwerk.

Das ist uns wichtig

  • Mindestens 5 Jahre Erfahrung in der Planung von Elektroinstallationen, konventionell und Smart Home, mit Schwerpunkt Wohnbau (komplexe Anlagen, Zweckbau oder Industrie musst du nicht beherrschen)

  • Sichere Kenntnisse gängiger Systeme wie KNX, Loxone, DALI etc.

  • Du kannst gut beraten und Zusammenhänge einfach erklären

  • Du stehst gern vor der Kamera, nimmst dich ohne Scheu beim Planen auf und hast eine natürliche Präsenz

  • Echte Freude an Elektroplanung und Smart Home

  • Fließendes Deutsch (zwingend)

Schön, aber kein Muss

  • Kenntnisse in der Lichtplanung

  • Gute Englischkenntnisse

  • Erfahrung mit Videoaufnahme und Videoschnitt

  • Eigene Kanäle oder erste Content-Erfahrung auf YouTube oder Social Media

  • Erfahrung mit Content-Strategie, SEO oder Performance-Marketing

Das bieten wir

  • 100 % remote: Du arbeitest von dort, wo du am besten planst und aufnimmst.

  • 4-Tage-Woche möglich: Mehr Zeit für dich – bei gleichem Anspruch an deine Arbeit.

  • Gehalt: 50.000–80.000 € brutto pro Jahr bei 100 %, je nach Qualifikation

  • Gestaltungsspielraum: Du prägst Formate und Inhalte von Anfang an mit – und wenn du willst, auch die gesamte Content-Ausrichtung.

  • Kurze Wege: Du arbeitest direkt mit dem Gründerteam, Entscheidungen fallen schnell – ohne Politik, allein danach, was unseren Kunden wirklich hilft.

  • KI-Planung von Anfang an: Du arbeitest mit den neuesten Planungswerkzeugen und prägst, wie sie im Alltag funktionieren.

Bewirb dich – gern mit Video

Du brennst für Elektroplanung? Wir freuen uns auf dich! Nutze den Bewerben-Button auf dieser Seite, um uns deinen Lebenslauf, deine Gehaltsvorstellung und deinen frühesten Starttermin zu senden.

Statt eines Anschreibens freuen wir uns über ein kurzes Video (freiwillig, 1–3 Minuten, Handy reicht): Stell dich vor und erklär uns ein Smart-Home-Thema deiner Wahl – zum Beispiel, wann du KNX und wann Loxone empfiehlst. Falls vorhanden, verlinke gern Arbeitsproben oder eigene Kanäle.
