This role is responsible for designing and delivering experiences that support repeatable adoption frameworks, drive sustained activation, expand the breadth and depth of usage, and produce measurable value for government organizations.

This role sits at the intersection of enablement, education, adoption, community, content, and customer experience. It blends strong product fluency, instructional design, customer advisory, and a deep understanding of public service. You will lead live workshops, deliver enablement programs, and design adoption interventions for audiences ranging from front-line public servants and technical practitioners to senior government leaders.

You will be a trusted guide to government customers, helping them learn, share, teach, celebrate successes, and use AI confidently in their day-to-day work. You will help organizations understand not only what OpenAI’s products can do, but how to apply them safely and effectively while respecting their missions, operating environments, workforce needs, and responsibilities to the public.

Success in this role means accelerating customer confidence, increasing product adoption, supporting successful launches and deployments, and helping government organizations translate product capabilities into tangible mission outcomes. You will own outcomes related to activation and sustained usage while helping shape how OpenAI enables and supports public-sector customers at scale.

This role is based in London. We use a hybrid work model of three days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees. Travel and regular work from government customer sites are required.

In this role, you will:

  • Own the enablement of OpenAI products, including ChatGPT Enterprise and Agents, helping define effective patterns for responsible adoption across government organizations.

  • Lead government customers through the full enablement lifecycle, from initial onboarding and activation through expansion, optimization, and long-term adoption.

  • Define and manage structured enablement and deployment programs with clear goals, milestones, owners, and measures of success.

  • Design and deliver high-impact engagements—including onboarding sessions, advanced capability training, executive briefings, academies, hackathons, listening sessions, and hands-on mission or workflow labs—for audiences ranging from senior leaders to front-line staff.

  • Guide government leaders, champions, technical teams, and working teams through organizational change by building confidence, establishing effective habits, and translating product capabilities into practical workflows and mission outcomes.

  • Serve as a subject matter expert for designated products, roles, or government mission areas, building deep expertise and identifying emerging public-sector use cases for new product capabilities.

  • Develop government-specific learning journeys, training materials, playbooks, FAQs, demonstrations, use cases, customer impact stories, and communications that enable high-quality adoption programs to scale.

  • Provide timely education for product launches, new features, and capability rollouts, translating product updates into clear and practical relevance for government users.

  • Advise government customers on workforce communications and engagement strategies that build awareness, confidence, participation, and sustained use.

  • Build trusted relationships with government leaders, program owners, technical teams, champions, and front-line public servants, creating experiences that reflect an understanding of their constraints, motivations, and responsibilities to the public.

  • Support government customer communities, events, and peer-learning experiences by keeping resources, discussions, updates, and thought leadership useful and current.

  • Identify and amplify government champions, creative use cases, and meaningful customer outcomes that encourage responsible experimentation, recognize public servants’ contributions, and help other organizations learn.

  • Partner closely with Sales, Customer Success, Solutions Engineering, Solutions Architecture, Delivery, Product, Global Affairs, Communications, Marketing, Readiness, and other teams to deliver cohesive experiences for public-sector customers.

  • Gather and synthesize government customer feedback, adoption signals, participation data, and engagement outcomes to improve enablement programs and bring the voice of public servants back to Product and other internal stakeholders.

  • Identify patterns across government customers and translate them into scalable programs, content, playbooks, and best practices without losing the human connection required to support public servants effectively.

You might thrive in this role if you:

  • Have 6+ years of experience in customer-facing, enablement, instructional, adoption, or transformation roles, engaging executive, business, and technical audiences in government or similarly complex enterprise environments.

  • Understand and value public service and can build credibility with government leaders, program owners, technical teams, and front-line public servants.

  • Possess exceptional presentation, facilitation, and communication skills, particularly when translating complex AI capabilities into clear, accurate, and practical value for audiences with different levels of technical fluency.

  • Have experience designing learning journeys and leading workshops, training programs, executive engagements, customer events, or scaled adoption initiatives.

  • Bring strong practical fluency and enthusiasm across ChatGPT, Agents, and the broader OpenAI product ecosystem, with an understanding of how AI can be applied to real-world government workflows.

  • Are a versatile writer and storyteller who can turn complex information into useful and compelling training materials, presentations, demonstrations, communications, and customer stories.

  • Can connect product capabilities and enablement activities to measurable outcomes such as activation, sustained usage, improved quality, faster delivery, reduced administrative burden, better decision-making, risk reduction, customer satisfaction, or mission impact.

  • Can identify patterns across government customers and convert them into scalable systems, programs, content, and best practices.

  • Are highly organized and comfortable managing multiple workstreams, adapting in live customer environments, and bringing clarity and momentum to ambiguous situations.

  • Bring humility, empathy, curiosity, and a genuine desire to help public servants and colleagues succeed.

  • Are personally committed to fostering the safe and responsible evolution of AI.

About OpenAI

OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity.

title: Engineering Manager - Design System (x/f/m)
descriptionHtml:

As Engineering Manager of the Design System team, you will lead the engineering efforts behind Oxygen, Doctolib's design system. Oxygen goes far beyond a component library: it is the infrastructure that ensures design quality at scale and delivers our brand identity consistently across an AI-first development environment. With over 50 designers and several hundred engineers building across multiple markets and product surfaces, your work directly shapes the experience of every user who interacts with Doctolib.

Working at the intersection of Design and Engineering, you will partner with designers, product managers, and engineers to turn our Design System vision into scalable technical solutions that power consistent, high-quality user interfaces across all Doctolib products.

title: Engineering Manager - Platform and Data Intelligence
descriptionHtml:
Engineering Manager - Platform and Data Intelligence

  

About trawa

 

European energy costs are 2x compared to US and China. Electricity demand is expected to double by 2050. Market price volatility & complexity are here to stay. The backbone of Europe's industrial economy is at risk and companies need to act now.

trawa is building the solution: the first integrated B2B energy platform that orchestrates procurement, energy management, and flexibility steering in one product. Supply, Manage, and Flex combined. That integration unlocks up to 30% in recurring electricity cost savings, all while helping companies switch to renewable energy.

We're the fastest-growing B2B energy platform in Europe. Active in Germany and Austria now, and expanding operations to a third market in 2027. We're on the road to European scale and move fast, the market window is open and we intend to own it.

trawa is a scale-up based in Berlin with ~100 FTE, ~30 of whom work in Product & Tech. We've raised over €35M to date, including a €24M Series A in May 2025, backed by Balderton, Headline, Speedinvest, AENU, Magnetic, and Tiny VC. All three founders are on board and 100% committed to build the utility of the future.

   

About the Role

 

We’re looking for an experienced Engineering Manager to lead two teams that form the foundation everything at trawa runs on: Data Intelligence and Platform.

Data is the heartbeat of trawa. It turns the complexity of energy markets into savings and sustainability for our customers. Underneath it sits the cloud infrastructure powering our services and the IT and security practices that keep our systems and data safe. You’ll own the technical direction for all of it, from metering data management and billing to AWS infrastructure and internal IT.

You’ll shape a team culture grounded in trust, collaboration, and continuous learning, where engineers thrive and do their best work. You’ll report to the Director of Engineering and lead an established, growing group of engineers across two closely related teams.

At trawa, our culture is “office-first with flexibility”: most of us are in our Berlin office the majority of the week, with room to work from home when needed. The Tech team follows a more hybrid rhythm, with a minimum of 3 days a week in the office.

  

What You'll Do

 

Own the roadmap for our central data warehouse and the data platform our products are built on

  • Build a scalable data backend for the core processes of an energy provider, including timeseries data management, invoicing, and billing

  • Lead the design and operation of critical data pipelines, data quality standards, and observability practices

  • Run scalable, secure, highly available infrastructure on AWS for our mission-critical services

  • Drive great developer experience through CI/CD, observability tooling, and internal platforms that help teams ship faster and with confidence

  • Own IT operations and security: the tools, processes, and policies that keep trawa’s systems and data safe

Our tech stack

  • AWS, Terraform, Docker, GitHub Actions

  • Postgres, ClickHouse, dbt, Metabase

  • Python (pandas, polars), TypeScript

  • Dash0, Sentry, incident.io

  • Primo

   

Your First 90 Days

 

First 6 weeks (onboarding)

  • Build strong relationships with your direct reports, peers, and stakeholders

  • Understand each team’s current OKRs and how they impact the company

  • Get a solid understanding of our data architecture, infrastructure, and security posture

By month 3 (ramp-up)

  • Review operational health and tech debt across both teams, and present a prioritized plan for improvements in observability, data health, and scalability

  • Define and share a clear vision and roadmap for Data Intelligence and Platform, including how we improve developer experience

  • Assess our IT operations and security practices, and plan how they scale with trawa’s growth

  • Align next quarter’s roadmap with stakeholders and company OKRs, and communicate it broadly

 

What We're Looking For

  • 3+ years in a technical leadership role with people management responsibilities, ideally in a fast-moving startup. You’ve led across multiple teams and know how to balance competing priorities.

  • Deep hands-on background in data platform/data engineering or platform engineering/SRE/DevOps, and solid working knowledge of the other

  • Strong AWS experience: infrastructure as code, cloud-native patterns, containerized systems, with a good grasp of security, reliability, observability, and cost efficiency

  • Clear communicator who builds trust across teams and with non-technical stakeholders

  • Inclusive leader who creates an environment where engineers of diverse backgrounds can thrive

Don’t meet every single requirement? We still encourage you to apply!

At trawa, we’re dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace. If you’re excited about this role but your experience doesn’t align perfectly, we encourage you to apply – you may be the right fit for this or another opportunity.

   

Why Join Us

 

🌍 Real impact - At trawa, you will be part of a team that is dedicated to making a positive impact on the world. We value creativity, collaboration, and diverse perspectives.

 

🚀 Early ownership - We empower our team members to take ownership of their work and drive results, regardless of background or experience level.

 

🤝 Mentorship that matters - Regular leadership sessions, cross-functional exposure, and engineers who are genuinely invested in your growth.

 

📚 Learning culture - We provide an annual budget and dedicated time for professional development. You’ll have opportunities for mentorship, learning, and career progression.

 

🌐 Inclusive by design - We’re an equal opportunity employer, and our team reflects that. Our tech organisation brings together over 15 nationalities, contributing a variety of languages, experiences, and perspectives. At trawa, we’re family-friendly with parents across all levels, and our diversity is represented throughout the company, including leadership. We’re committed to an inclusive environment where everyone can do their best work.

 

🎁 Solid benefits - We offer a competitive compensation package including salary and stock options, 30 days of vacation, and a range of benefits including subsidies for home internet and lunches, a Sports Club membership, a productivity budget for work essentials (e.g., headphones, monitor), dedicated learning days with an annual learning budget, plus a weekly team lunch and regular team events.

title: Executive Assistant
descriptionHtml:
Our Mission:

Omnea is the agentic operating system for procurement.

Procurement touches every pound a business spends, yet requests still stall for weeks and approvals get lost in inboxes. Our AI-first platform changes that: our agents capture requests, route approvals, onboard suppliers, flag risk and track every renewal, while anyone in the business can ask a question and get an answer grounded in their own company’s data. Buying becomes painless for everyone, procurement gets a seat at the table, and our customers have saved more than 100,000 hours of manual work so far.

Companies like Spotify, PayPal, T. Rowe Price, JustEat, Adyen and S&P Global run procurement on Omnea. We’re backed by $75M from Khosla Ventures, Insight Partners and Accel, and we’ve been named the UK’s number one startup in the Startups 100, ranked 11th on Sifted’s 2026 list of Europe’s fastest-growing companies, and recognised as one of Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies.

Talent density matters more to us than almost anything else. We keep the bar high in every team, so everyone here has real ownership and real impact. Our team is full of former founders and operators who’ve scaled unicorns, and we’re looking for people who want to do the best work of their careers alongside them.

Find out more about the team and life at Omnea here.

What we're looking for

We’re looking for a highly organised & proactive Executive Assistant for our Executives. You will be the backbone of Omnea’s executive office, ensuring efficiency and seamless operations. Your focus will be on managing key personal & professional priorities, and providing administrative and strategic support—allowing our execs to focus on scaling the business through the next phase of growth!

You’ll be joining us at a pivotal time as we’re scaling fast and building the category-defining agentic operating system for procurement. And we are looking for the best Executive Assistant out there to help us turn procurement into a true competitive advantage!

What Can You Expect?

As the backbone of Omnea’s executive office, you’ll proactively coordinate, manage and keep track of your assigned Exec's schedules, projects and commitments. You will work closely with the Omnea leadership team and act as the primary point of contact for key stakeholders on all matters related to our execs. You are someone who acts like an owner, can craft at speed and loves working in a fast-paced environment with significant impact.

You’ll provide strategic and executive support, by managing our executives' complex calendars, ensuring seamless scheduling across multiple time zones. You’ll own email and communication filtering as well as prioritising, drafting, and responding as necessary.

You’ll act as a gatekeeper, ensuring our executives’ time is spent on high-impact activities. You will manage conflicting priorities and prioritise different demands, you’ll focus on solutions, and are comfortable navigating change and removing blockers.

You’ll plan, schedule and coordinate internal and external meetings and ensure agendas are well prepped, action items tracked, minutes taken and follow-ups done in a timely manner. You’ll also assist with board materials, investor updates, and briefing notes.

You’ll organise and book all travel, including flights, hotels, transfers and visas. You’ll prepare detailed travel itineraries and handle last-minute changes seamlessly.

You’ll own all operational and administrative tasks, such as expenses, invoices, and budget tracking related to our executives' activities.

You’ll act as the first point of contact for all key stakeholders, including prospects and customers on behalf of our executives. You’ll manage confidential information with the highest level of discretion. You’ll also proactively solve problems and anticipate potential issues before they arise.

You’ll own systems & processes that improve productivity, such as identifying and implementing tools or processes that reduce admin workload and help outsource and delegate non-essential tasks effectively.

About You

  • You have a 3-5 years of work experience, this can be as an EA, PA, Chief of Staff or Founders Associate ideally in a high-growth startup or tech environment.

    • You may not have the exact experience necessary for this role but you will have excelled at something incredibly challenging that demonstrates your ability to work hard under pressure in a fast-paced, stressful environment. For example, you may be a career changer who did well in a different sector or role but similarly intense & difficult.

  • You are London-based, with 3 days in the office per week and flexibility for occasional travels with the CEO in the future.

  • You are highly organised, with meticulous attention to detail, and exceptional at multitasking. You have flexibility to provide support during off-hours in an environment with increasingly different timezones (Europe & US).

  • You are tech-savvy, with experience using modern productivity tools (e.g., Slack, Notion, Google Suite). You can provide structure within the entrepreneurial and dynamic environment of a company in hyper-scale.

  • You’re able to ruthlessly prioritise, are highly organised and focused on outputs > inputs. You are proactive, a strategic thinker, efficient & autonomous and don’t compromise on quality (i.e. you have taste).

  • You’re an outstanding communicator; verbal, written, and when presenting. You’re exceptionally articulate, concise and clear in all forms of communication and have the ability to build rapport, influence people & drive change, whether it’s with a distinguished exec, technical expert or a junior operator. You handle confidential matters with discretion and professionalism.

  • You’re outcomes-focused, and balance the ability to think strategically with a heavy bias to action, always focused on “so what’s the next step?”.

  • You are proactive & crave accountability, proactively pushing initiatives forward and making the best use of the resources available to you.

  • You’re just a really good human. You’re empathetic and reliable. You build trust with people you work with and are highly collaborative. You have minimal ego, seek feedback to continuously hone your craft and try to bring out the best in everyone around you.

descriptionHtml:
Ingénieur DATA sénior / Senior DATA Engineer (H/F)

CDI

Rejoignez le Groupe INTESCIA, leader de la Business Intelligence en Europe !

Qui sommes-nous ?

EXPLORE, filiale d’INTESCIA GROUP, est un acteur leader dans le développement de solutions de data intelligence BtoB. Nous produisons des données à forte valeur ajoutée pour accompagner le développement commercial des entreprises, faciliter leurs analyses de marchés et optimiser leur connaissance clients. Nous comptons aujourd’hui plus de 1 500 clients et près de 35 000 utilisateurs dans les univers de l’Immobilier, la Construction, l’Énergie, l’Environnement et des Services à l’entreprise.

Nos atouts ?

  • Un groupe en pleine expansion, reconnu pour son expertise et ses solutions à forte valeur ajoutée.

  • Une culture d’innovation, où la créativité et l’amélioration continue sont au cœur de notre ADN.

  • Des équipes passionnées et engagées, évoluant dans un environnement stimulant et collaboratif.

Votre mission :

Vous intégrerez l'équipe Data Engineer qui joue un rôle central chez Intescia : ingérer, structurer, fiabiliser et valoriser la donnée vendue aux clients. Vous intégrerez une entreprise en pleine transformation data : migration de la donnée dans Databricks.

En tant que Senior Data Engineer vous aurez un rôle clé dans la mise en place de cette transformation : conception et développement des pipelines de données, mise en place et diffusion des bonnes pratiques de développement et optimisation des performances.

Un des axes majeurs de la donnée traitée par Intescia est l’axe géographique. Vous prenez le relais de notre géomaticien qui évolue vers une autre équipe : vous avez de l’appétence et de l’expérience dans le traitement de la donnée géographique.

Vos activités :

Construire et industrialiser les pipelines de données

· Concevoir, développer et maintenir les pipelines d'ingestion et de transformation de données.

· Garantir la fiabilité, la fraîcheur, la qualité et la traçabilité des données produites.

· Mettre en place le monitoring, les tests, l'alerting et la documentation associée.

Porter la migration vers Databricks

· Contribuer activement à la conception de la cible : organisation du DataLakehouse, Unity Catalog, gouvernance, modèle de données.

· Migrer les traitements existants et poser les standards (structuration des jobs, CI/CD, conventions, revue de code).

· Diffuser les bonnes pratiques Spark / Delta au sein de l'équipe et accompagner sa montée en compétences.

Prendre en charge la dimension géographique

· Industrialiser les traitements géospatiaux : géocodage, appariement d'adresses, jointures spatiales, agrégations par mailles administratives, gestion des projections et des référentiels.

· Être le point de contact de l'équipe sur les référentiels géographiques et leurs évolutions.

Assumer un rôle de leadership technique

· Être garant·e de la cohérence technique des solutions produites par l'équipe.

· Animer les choix d'architecture, arbitrer et documenter les décisions.

· Accompagner et faire monter en compétences les autres membres de l'équipe (revues de code, pair programming).

Stack technique

· Environnement : Databricks

· Langages : Python, SQL

· Framework : Spark

· Databases : ElasticSearch, Postgres

· DevOps : Github Action (CI/CD), Docker

· Monitoring : Grafana, Prometheus

  • La rémunération annuelle fixe sur ce poste sera entre 55K€ et 60K€ en fonction du profil que nous recruterons.

Le profil que nous recherchons :

Vos compétences :

  • L’usage de DATABRICKS sera un critère fortement apprécié

  • Capacité à porter techniquement un sujet de bout en bout et à embarquer les autres.

  • Clarté et transparence dans la communication

  • Leadership, référent au sein d'une équipe.

Expérience :

  • 5 ans et plus d'expérience en data engineering, sur des pipelines en production.

  • Très bonne maîtrise de Python et de SQL.

  • Très bonne maitrise du traitement de données distribué : Spark (PySpark).

  • Solide expérience de développement de pipelines de données sur Databricks

  • Pratique des standards d'ingénierie logicielle : Git, CI/CD, tests automatisés, revue de code, performance.

  • Expérience de l'orchestration (Airflow, Databricks Workflows ou équivalent).

  • Appétence réelle pour la donnée géographique : vous en avez déjà manipulé.

  • Compréhension des systèmes de projection (WGS84, Lambert 93) et des formats géospatiaux (GeoJSON, Shapefile, WFS etc).

  • Connaissance de PostGis (SQL Spatial) et QGIS.

Ce que nous vous offrons :

title: Head of Global Operations
descriptionHtml:
Benetics AI helps construction teams spend more time building and less time on documentation. Our voice assistant works in 100+ languages. Over 500 companies across 10+ countries already use it. We are bootstrapped, cash-flow positive, and growing in triple digits.

Our next phase takes us further across Europe and into the US. We are looking for a hands-on operations leader to build how the company runs: turn strategy into operating and financial plans, give teams clear priorities, and make sure we deliver as we grow internationally.

We run a human-augmented company where details are key. Once we identify and understand problems, we automate and steer. Work with a world-class team to become a global player.

Tasks

Reporting to the CEO, you own how Benetics plans, operates, and executes. You connect the founders and team leads, turn priorities into funded plans with clear responsibilities, and stay close to the work. You build the processes, team, and financial visibility we need to make decisions and follow through.

Build the way we run the company

  • Turn company strategy into an annual operating plan with clear priorities, targets, owners, and quarterly milestones.

  • Run weekly execution reviews and monthly business reviews. Track performance, resolve cross-team bottlenecks, and follow through until decisions turn into results.

  • Own the annual budget and rolling forecasts for revenue, costs, and cash. Connect the financial plan to hiring, capacity, and international expansion.

  • Build and lead the operations function. Set clear responsibilities, hire and develop people, and decide where specialist partners can help us scale.

  • Get into the work yourself: fix broken things, improve internal processes, and automate repetitive tasks. Build systems the team can use without relying on the founders for every decision.

Internationalisation

  • Turn market-entry decisions into launch plans with owners, milestones, budgets and clear criteria for readiness.

  • Get on the ground in priority markets. Meet customers and partners, understand local workflows and resolve the practical barriers to adoption.

  • Coordinate local hiring, service providers, operating arrangements such as reseller contracts and entity setup. Make sure each market can deliver what we sell.

  • Build repeatable operational GTM playbooks while adapting to how customers actually work in each country.

Business foundations

  • Manage operating spend, purchasing and provider performance against the agreed plan. Make sure external partners deliver and spending decisions have clear owners.

  • Coordinate the fiduciary, payroll providers and legal counsel so financial reporting, employment administration and compliance keep pace with expansion.

  • Ensure finance and legal work has clear owners and deadlines. Accounting, tax filings and complex legal advice sit with qualified specialists; your responsibility is to make the overall operation work.

Requirements

  • Experience owning an operations function or substantial business unit as Head of Operations, Director of Operations, General Manager or in a comparable role.

  • A track record of turning strategy into operating plans, building practical processes and improving execution as a business grows, ideally across countries.

  • A record of leading people and cross-functional execution, with personal accountability for results.

  • Comfort switching between a market expansion plan and the practical work needed to deliver it: visiting a customer, fixing a handover, selecting a provider or coaching a new hire.

  • Experience owning budgets, financial forecasts and business performance reviews. You can connect operational choices to cash and unit economics, and use the numbers to guide hiring, spending and growth.

  • Fluent in German and English, and willing to travel regularly across Europe and to the US as the business requires.

  • Experience with building

Nice to have

  • Experience in B2B software, frontline workforces, or construction.

  • A Chief of Staff, consulting or founder background with direct responsibility for implementation, teams and measurable operating outcomes.

This is a hands-on leadership role. You build the plan, work through the numbers, and solve operational problems yourself. You also develop the people and systems that let the company run well across markets as it grows.

Benefits

  • A direct partnership with the CEO and responsibility for how Benetics runs, allocates resources, and scales internationally.

  • The scope to build a global operations function and see the effect of your work with customers and colleagues.

  • Freedom to choose practical tools, providers and ways of working.

  • A Zürich base, on site Monday to Thursday when not traveling, with flexible hours and holiday planning.

  • Salary plus a meaningful piece of the company.

How we hire

  1. Introduction, 15-minute video call

  2. Conversation with one of the founders, 30 minutes, about the company, the numbers and the role

  3. A practical case with the team, remote or in Zürich. We work through our real model and one open question together. There is no homework to hand in.

  4. Final conversation and decision. We decide quickly and tell you why.

Don't you meet every requirement? Apply anyway. Tell us in two paragraphs about the messiest finance or legal situation you have sorted out. You don't need a cover letter.

Reporting to the CFO, you will work closely with Finance stakeholders and Voodoo's central Data team, combining data engineering, business understanding, and product thinking to turn complex Finance needs into reliable and maintainable solutions.

Profile

title: Finance Director
descriptionHtml:
About Codat

Codat is an advisory intelligence solution purpose-built for modern commercial banking. Through rich, specialized data, forward-looking insights, and integrated workflows, Codat empowers banking teams to deepen their relationships, grow their revenue, and simplify their day-to-day work.

Founded in 2017 and backed by JPMorgan, PayPal, Amex, Plaid, and Shopify, Codat has successfully powered over 350,000 connections to business customers’ financial systems — and is trusted by industry leaders to turn scattered information into actionable, strategic advantages in real time, every time.

The Role

We're looking for a Finance Director to lead our finance team at Codat. You'll own the numbers from start to finish: the plan, the monthly close, the board pack and the conversations with our investors.

This is both a hands-on role and a senior role. You'll have one direct report and still do plenty yourself: one day you'll be taking the board through the forecast, and the next you'll be sorting out a payroll query or approving expenses. You'll report to the Chief Legal and Business Officer and work closely with the leadership team on where we spend money and why, and you'll be the person who tells us when the numbers don't support a plan.

What You'll Work On

  • Budgeting, forecasting and cash. You'll build the annual and longer-range plan with budget holders across the business, keep the forecast current and track how we're doing against it. You’ll also own cash flow forecasting and runway, plus headcount planning with the people team.

  • Board and investor reporting. You'll prepare the board pack, covering ARR, unit economics and customer metrics, and the analysis investors and advisers need.

  • The month-end close, management accounts and statutory consolidation across our UK and US entities, including intercompany. You'll also run the annual audit to sign-off and own our technical accounting positions, such as revenue recognition and share-based payments.

  • Group tax and compliance across the UK and US, and our relationships with auditors, tax advisers, lawyers and banks.

  • ARR and revenue modelling. You’ll partner with the team to ensure our commercial reporting keeps pace as the business evolves, covering the impact of product and pricing changes, and the bridge from ARR to recognised revenue. You’ll also work with the commercial team on pricing and contract terms, and what they mean for revenue recognition and billing.

  • Day-to-day finance operations: You’ll work alongside our Senior Finance Manager on AP, AR, billing, payroll and expenses, and share the operational load rather than just overseeing it. , The finance systems stack. We want finance to need less manual work every quarter, and automation and AI tools are part of how we'll get there.

  • A small finance team. You'll set their priorities and help them grow.

You'll Probably Have

  • A professional accounting qualification: ACA, ACCA, CIMA or equivalent.

  • Held a senior finance role at a fast-growing, VC-backed tech or SaaS business, ideally across more than one entity and country. You've sat in board meetings and answered investors' questions yourself.

  • Experience in international tax compliance or managing tax advisers across jurisdictions.

  • A good grasp of SaaS metrics and revenue recognition, and the ability to explain them to people outside finance.

  • Stayed close to the detailed work as you got more senior. You're as comfortable building a model as you are closing the books.

  • The confidence to challenge senior people when the numbers call for it. If the data says a plan won't work, you'll say so.

  • Experience managing a small team and helping them grow.

  • AI is already built into how you work. You’ve used automation and AI to change how a finance function runs, not just to speed up the odd task. You can show us a process or system you’ve rebuilt and what it changed for the team.

How We Work

We're a small team with plenty to do. Things move fast: we'd rather make a sound decision quickly and adjust it than wait for perfect information. What you own is yours from start to finish.

We operate hybrid working but without strict mandates on how many days. We trust you to be around when the team needs you and to deliver what you said you would.

Compensation: £90K – £115K • Offers Equity

title: Fleet Operations Trainer
descriptionHtml:
Before the detail, here's the challenge you'd help us solve.

We build the embodied intelligence that moves real vehicles safely, and the ecosystem a billion machines will run on in the future. Very few people in AI can say this. Every role here, whatever the team, plugs into that.

Here’s what this particular role covers.

🛠️ About our Fleet Operations Team

 

Our Fleet Operations Team ensures that our vehicles and staff continuously meet the highest standards in safety, performance, and regulatory compliance. Working collaboratively across various functions, the team plays a key role in developing and delivering training, maintaining operating standards, and supporting the professional growth of our people within a fast-paced and innovative environment.

 

🧠 Your day-to-day

 

  • Monitor and evaluate the effectiveness of training programs, making recommendations for improvements.

  • Maintain up-to-date training records and ensure compliance with company policies and legal requirements.

  • Conduct regular assessments of operating standards across teams and individuals to uphold our quality objectives.

  • Develop and maintain training materials, including manuals, presentations, and online resources.

  • Work closely with subject matter experts to identify areas for improvement in training content, delivery, and operating standards.

  • Monitor and analyse training metrics to identify trends and suggest opportunities for improvement.

  • Develop and oversee implementation of quality assurance processes for both training programs and operating standards.

  • Support staff professional development and course completion, in conjunction with Team Leads.

  • Collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders to understand and anticipate training needs related to the growth of commercial operations.

 

🧩 What you’ll be working on

 

  • Building, evaluating, and improving training programs for fleet operations.

  • Upholding and enhancing the effectiveness and compliance of all operating standards across teams.

  • Creating and updating a library of high-quality training materials.

  • Implementing and tracking quality assurance processes for all training and operational exercises.

  • Supporting the development and progression of Wayve’s staff through tailored training and development initiatives.

  • Analysing data to ensure continuous improvement of both training content and delivery methods.

 

🙌 You should apply if

 

  • You hold a full clean DE driving licence and have at least 8 years' driving experience (mainly in DE).

  • You have no blameworthy insurance claims within the past three years.

  • You remain calm and controlled in pressured situations.

  • You’re receptive to feedback, eager to learn from mistakes, and have a growth mindset.

  • You enjoy working closely with people in a team environment.

  • You can manage your wellbeing (including fatigue/stress) and have proven personal strategies for doing so.

  • You have proven experience as a team coordinator or in a similar role.

  • You demonstrate strong leadership and communication skills—both one-to-one, within your team, and when engaging other stakeholders.

  • You can work under pressure and manage multiple priorities effectively.

  • You have excellent problem-solving skills, attention to detail, time management, and organisational ability.

  • You are proficient in Google Workspace or Microsoft Office suite.

  • You have excellent written and verbal English communication skills.

 

Desirable:

  • Recognised Assessor qualification.

  • Qualified Vehicle Safety Operator with a current qualification.

  • Recognised Quality Assurance qualification.

 

Additional Requirements:

  • Available to work full-time onsite (Leonberg office), 5 days a week.

  • Must disclose any second job as part of the application process.

  • All applicants will be subject to a health check before/after employment.

  • Employment is contingent upon passing training, pre-employment checks, and ongoing drug/alcohol testing in line with company policy. Testing will occur during your onsite interview.

 

🌱 Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! If you’re passionate about autonomy and keen to learn, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every requirement.

 

More about Wayve:

 

🚀 Wayve is building the leading AI platform for autonomous driving. We are pioneering an end to end AI approach that enables vehicles to learn directly from real world experience, developing the ability to adapt, generalise and improve at scale. Instead of relying on hand coded rules or pre mapped environments, our AI Driver learns to drive by understanding the world around it. The result is technology that navigates complex urban environments with intelligence, precision and natural flow, unlocking meaningful advances in both safety and efficiency. We believe autonomy represents a once in a generation transformation in how people and goods move, comparable to the shift from horses to cars, and from human driven vehicles to intelligent machines.

 

Our ambition is to make autonomy universal. Wayve’s mapless and hardware agnostic AI platform integrates with global OEM partners, enabling continuous software evolution and unlocking advanced levels of automation from L2 plus through to L4 as our core AI model scales. In a race increasingly defined by intelligence and real world learning, Wayve is taking a distinct approach, building a generalisable driving intelligence that can power any vehicle, anywhere. By combining embodied AI with scalable deployment, we are creating technology that can be shaped to each OEM brand and driver experience, accelerating the transition to a safer, more intelligent future of mobility.

 

How we work 💻- Locations & Flexible Working:

 

Our main hubs are in London, Sunnyvale, Yokohama, Herzliya, Vancouver and Leonberg. We operate a hybrid working model that combines in-person collaboration in our dedicated office spaces with focused time working remotely. This gives our teams the connection and energy of working together, alongside the flexibility to do their best work in a way that fits their lives.

 

🔍 The Interview Process:

Our process is clear and respectful of your time:

 

  • Initial call / recruiter screen (30 mins)

  • Competency Interviews (Team Fit & Stakeholder Management; 2 hours total)

  • Deep-dive technical interviews (Training, Quality Assurance, and Fleet Operations; 3 hours total)

  • Final interview: mission & values alignment (1 hour)

 

We’ll always explain the format and work around your availability.

 

What’s in it for you (Location dependent):

 

💰 Salaries benchmarked against the market annually
📈 Meaningful equity, sharing in the ownership and long term success of Wayve
📚 Learning and development budgets with support for training, conferences and growth
🩺 Comprehensive benefits including health insurance, dental, enhanced maternity and paternity leave, retirement or pension where applicable, access to therapists, wellbeing partnerships, team socials and more

A quick, honest note before you apply.

Wayve is not a mature, fully-structured place with the playbook already written. Much of how we work is still being written, and if you join, you’ll help write it. That suits people who want real ownership more than people who need a settled structure from day one.

If that sounds like the kind of problem you want to spend your time on, we’d really like to hear from you.

At Wayve we're committed to creating a diverse, fair and respectful culture that is inclusive of everyone based on their unique skills and perspectives, and regardless of sex, race, religion or belief, ethnic or national origin, disability, age, citizenship, marital, domestic or civil partnership status, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, pregnancy or related condition (including breastfeeding) or any other basis as protected by applicable law.

For more information visit Careers at Wayve. To learn more about what drives us, visit Values at Wayve

descriptionHtml:
Banyan Software is the best permanent home for software businesses that serve specialized industries, their employees, and their customers. With a buy-grow-and-hold-for-life approach and a permanent capital base, Banyan acquires and grows companies worldwide, honoring founder legacies and helping portfolio companies modernize through shared AI expertise and operational discipline. Founded in 2016, Banyan operates more than 120 portfolio companies across North and South America, Europe, and APAC, and has appeared on the Inc. 5000 list for six consecutive years. The Banyan Software Foundation, endowed with $100 million in Banyan stock, leverages technology to build a greener and more equitable world.

Overview

We are looking for an exceptional full-stack software engineer who will act as a Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) to serve as the critical interface between the central AI Application Modernization Factory and our application teams. The FDE will be temporarily embedded within delivery teams to directly drive the modernization of key applications, ensuring technical success, accelerated adoption of AI-assisted SDLC practices, and lasting upskilling of team members. This is a high-impact, hybrid role requiring advanced software engineering skills, deep knowledge of cloud-native patterns, and proven expertise in consultation, change management, and building strong rapport with diverse teams.

Key Responsibilities

  • Application Modernization Execution: Embed with application teams to provide hands-on technical leadership, driving the design, development, and delivery of modernization efforts (re-platforming, microservices adoption) to AWS cloud-native architectures.
  • AI-First SDLC Adoption & Upskilling: Act as the subject matter expert on the AI Modernization Factory's tools and processes (e.g., Cursor, Claude Code). Drive the adoption and change management necessary to embed AI-assisted software development practices into the team’s daily workflow.
  • Consultative Engineering & Change Management: Build trust and rapport with new, diverse teams quickly. Identify team-specific technical and process bottlenecks, recommending and implementing solutions, and effectively managing the people/process side of technical change.
  • Hands-on Software Development: Make significant code contributions, focusing on setting up architectural scaffolding, CI/CD pipelines, IaC (Terraform), and solving complex, blocking integration challenges for the embedded team.
  • Feedback Loop: Serve as the primary feedback channel, relaying practical challenges, tool deficiencies, and necessary process adjustments back to the central Principal Engineer and Architect to continuously improve the factory's capabilities.
  • Standards & Quality: Ensure embedded teams adhere to the central factory's engineering standards, including Twelve-Factor App principles, DevSecOps practices, and high-quality coding standards.

Required Qualifications & Experience

  • Experience: 5+ years of progressive experience in Software Engineering, with a focus on enterprise applications and application modernization.
  • Full Stack Proficiency: Strong hands-on experience across the full application stack (front-end, back-end, database, infrastructure). Expert proficiency in one or more modern technology languages (e.g., Python, TypeScript, C#, Java).
  • Cloud Native & IaC: Deep practical experience building and deploying scalable applications on AWS. Strong proficiency with Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC), specifically Terraform.
  • Consulting & Change Management: Proven ability to onboard rapidly, assess team dynamics and technical landscapes, influence technical direction without formal authority, and drive organizational/process change within established engineering teams.
  • DevSecOps & CI/CD: Hands-on mastery of setting up and optimizing CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI) and integrating DevSecOps best practices.
  • Architectural Understanding: Solid understanding of modern architectural patterns (microservices, serverless, event-driven architecture) and the principles of Domain-Driven Design (DDD).
  • Communication & Interpersonal Skills: Exceptional communication, presentation, and listening skills. Ability to articulate complex technical issues and solutions to both technical and non-technical stakeholders effectively.

Preferred Skills (A Plus)

  • Prior experience in a consulting, Staff Engineer, or Forward Deployed role, specifically focused on technical adoption or modernization.
  • Direct experience training or mentoring other software engineers in new technologies or methodologies.
  • Hands-on experience with modern UI frameworks like React, NextJS, or similar.
  • Experience utilizing AI-assisted coding tools (Cursor, Claude Code) in a professional development environment.
  • Familiarity with containerization (Docker/Kubernetes) and serverless architectures (AWS Lambda).

title: Forward Deployed Engineer (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Wer wir sind

Die Mayflower GmbH baut Individualsoftware mit Fokus auf Generative AI – seit 1998 inhabergeführt.

Wir bringen komplette AI-Infrastrukturen in Produktion: Model-Serving, Agent-Gateways, Chat und Voice – direkt in der Umgebung des Kunden. Bei uns erwartet dich ein agiles Arbeitsumfeld mit Verantwortung auf Augenhöhe - ohne Hierarchien.

Für unseren Bereich Forward Deployed Engineering suchen wir dich – jemanden, der AI-Systeme nicht empfiehlt, sondern baut, deployt und in Produktion verantwortet.

Was dich erwartet

Forward Deployed heißt bei uns: Du bist Beobachter, Architekt und Entwickler in einer Person. Dieselbe Person, die das Problem beim Kunden versteht, schreibt den Code, der es löst - und bleibt, bis es produktiv läuft.

  • End-to-End-Ownership: Du verantwortest Deployments von der Discovery über technisches Scoping, Architektur und Build bis zum Produktions-Rollout in der Infrastruktur des Kunden - eingebettet in dessen Engineering- und Fachteams.
  • Full-Stack, wörtlich gemeint: Du arbeitest über alle Schichten - Model-Serving (vLLM, eigene GPU-Cluster), Agent-Gateways und Runtimes, RAG-/GraphRAG-Pipelines, spezialisierte Agenten, Integration in ERP, CRM, DMS und Legacy-Systeme.
  • Auf erprobtem Fundament: Du deployst und erweiterst unsere Produkt-Stacks (mAIstack, VoiceAI, Amicable) beim Kunden, statt jedes Projekt bei null zu beginnen – mit LLMs wie GPT, Gemini, Claude oder Nemotron, Agent-Frameworks und agentischen Harnesses. Vector-Datenbanken und RAG sind dabei Handwerkszeug; als Senior sorgst du dafür, dass die Systeme im Betrieb messbar und beherrschbar bleiben – über Dataset-basierte Evaluations, Logging/Tracing und Observability.
  • Der Rückfluss ist Teil des Jobs: Was sich im Feld als wiederkehrendes Muster erweist, kodifizierst du mit deinem Team in unseren Produkten, Skills und Playbooks. Dein Projektwissen bleibt nicht beim Kunden liegen - es macht das nächste Deployment schneller.
  • Kunde auf Augenhöhe: Du entwickelst in Workshops ein gemeinsames Bild von Problem, Chancen und Lösung, triffst Trade-off-Entscheidungen zwischen Scope, Tempo und Qualität - und sprichst auch an, was der Kunde nicht hören will, wenn es das Ergebnis schützt.
  • Sichtbarkeit: Du bringst deine Erfahrungen in Whitepaper, Talks und unsere AI-Produkte ein - mit Unterstützung unserer technischen Redaktion.

Das solltest du mitbringen

  • Mindestens 10 Jahre in der Softwareentwicklung, idealerweise bei einem Individual-Software-Dienstleister oder in der IT-Beratung.
  • Du hast LLM-Systeme in Produktion gebracht - nicht nur prototypisiert: RAG-Implementierungen, Vector Databases, Agent-Frameworks (LangGraph, OpenAI Agent SDK o. ä.), Evals und MLOps.
  • Erfahrung mit der Integration von AI-Systemen in bestehende, gewachsene Enterprise-Architekturen - inklusive der unbequemen Teile (Auth, Legacy, Compliance).
  • Von Vorteil: Erfahrung mit Inference-Infrastruktur (vLLM, GPU-Serving), Kubernetes und On-Prem-/Private-Cloud-Deployments.
  • Die Kompetenz, AI-Konzepte Fachbereichen und C-Level anschaulich zu vermitteln - und die Standfestigkeit, Ownership für Entscheidungen zu übernehmen.
  • Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse auf C1-Niveau.
  • Bereitschaft, phasenweise beim Kunden vor Ort zu arbeiten (projektabhängig, remote-embedded als Regelfall), plus Workshops und Konferenzen 1–2× im Monat innerhalb Deutschlands.

Das haben wir zu bieten

  • Kompetitive Vergütung: Je nach Erfahrung und Kompetenz vergüten wir die Stelle mit einem Bruttojahresgehalt von 80.000 € bis 90.000 € bei 40 Wochenstunden.
  • Echte Produktionsverantwortung: Deine Systeme laufen produktiv bei großen Unternehmensgruppen - nicht in der Demo-Umgebung.
  • Gute Software bauen: Hier wird echter Wert auf Code- und Softwarequalität gelegt.
  • Kein 08/15: Abwechslung durch unterschiedliche Branchen, Use Cases und Technologien - vom GPU-Cluster bis zum Voice-Agenten.
  • Kundenbeziehung auf Augenhöhe: Wir pflegen eine ehrliche und vertrauensvolle Zusammenarbeit mit unseren Kunden.
  • Mache einen Unterschied: Viel Verantwortung, großer Gestaltungsspielraum - in einem Mittelständler, in dem dein Beitrag den wirtschaftlichen Erfolg direkt beeinflusst.
  • Lerne immer dazu: Weiterbildung (intern und extern), Training-on-the-job und regelmäßige Weiterentwicklungs- und Gehaltsgespräche.
  • Wie arbeiten selbstorganisiert: Wir geben dir den Freiraum, den Rahmen für gute Arbeit selbst mitzugestalten – im Team wie beim Kunden.
  • Werde berühmt: Eine technische Redaktion unterstützt dich beim Schreiben und Publizieren, sodass du als Experte nach außen sichtbar wirst.
  • Du musst nicht die klügste Person im Raum sein: Echte Sparring-Partner, die deine Ideen gemeinsam mit dir auf die Probe stellen und weiterentwickeln.
  • Schalte einfach ab: Niemand erwartet Erreichbarkeit nach Feierabend, im Urlaub oder trotz Krankmeldung. Viele Überstunden sind bei uns nicht üblich.
  • Gut für die Psyche: Ersthelfer psychische Gesundheit, Employee Assistance Programm und ein offener Umgang mit mentaler Gesundheit.
  • Freiraum für dein Privatleben: Flexible Arbeitszeiten, bis zu vier Tage Homeoffice die Woche, spontan einen Tag frei, Arbeiten aus dem EU-Ausland, Sabbatical oder 4 Wochen Urlaub am Stück.
  • Bring dein +1 mit: Brave Bürohunde oder Kinder an schulfreien Werktagen sind herzlich willkommen.
  • Finanzielle Benefits: Regelmäßige Teamevents, Wellpass, 30 Tage Urlaub, Kindergartenzuschuss, Deutsche Dienstrad.

Der Kontakt zu uns

title: Founder & CEO — AI-Native Captive in a Box
descriptionHtml:
Founder & CEO — AI-Native Captive in a Box

Self-insurance for everyone. Self-insurance is no longer just for the Microsofts of the world. Give everyone the option to get cover without paying an insurance company.

Location: London

Start date: ASAP

About Founders Factory:

Founders Factory builds and funds startups together with exceptional entrepreneurs and the world's leading companies. Created by IPO-exited founders, we offer founders capital, operational support from a team of hands-on experts, and unrivalled access to a coalition of industry-leading corporate partners. Since 2015, Founders Factory's 450+ portfolio companies have secured 500+ pilots and commercial contracts with our partners.

Our Studio partners with entrepreneurs at day one, developing new ideas, technologies and business models into high-growth companies. In partnership with Aviva, one of the UK's leading insurers, we are building a new portfolio of ventures out of London.

About the Venture:

Large companies have long cut their insurance costs by setting up a captive: their own insurance company, holding capital aside to cover risks like employee injury or health, and keeping the margin when claims are low. Global captive premium is around $240bn, about a tenth of worldwide P&C. But captives are complex to set up: feasibility studies, actuarial work, legal structuring and ongoing management fees keep almost every company below the very largest out. Loss data arrives as messy spreadsheets, and UK firms have had to go offshore because there's no UK captive regime.

We are building a captive that any company can set up in days, not months. AI agents take in loss runs and policies, model the retention options and draft the feasibility study. The platform then runs the captive (reserving, board packs, filings and claims data) with qualified actuaries signing off. Fronting and reinsurance partners, starting with Aviva, carry the paper. The venture holds no balance-sheet risk: it earns a feasibility fee, then an annual platform fee per captive.

Jobs to be Done:

As Founder & CEO, you will be responsible for turning a strong thesis into a scaled, defensible business.

  • Size the market. Work out which UK mid-market firms have the capital and loss profile for a captive once costs come down, and which lines of risk to start with.

  • Build the platform. Take the AI feasibility and captive management product from concept to something brokers, CFOs and regulators trust, with actuaries in the loop.

  • Line up the paper. Agree fronting and reinsurance terms with Aviva and other partners so small captives can be written.

  • Win the first captives. Land the first mid-market clients and broker partners, and be ready for the UK regime when it opens in 2027.

  • Build the company. Hire the initial team, raise capital, and establish the venture as the default way mid-sized companies self-insure, then expand into group captives, cells, Europe and the US.

Your Ideal Experience

We are not looking for a pure actuary or a pure software founder. The ideal candidate understands how insurance works and wants to rebuild it with AI.

  • A background in financial services or insurance: commercial insurance, broking, captives, reinsurance, actuarial or risk management.

  • Somewhat technical and building with AI: you can design agentic workflows and work closely with engineers, even if you're not writing all the code.

  • B2B commercial instinct: you can sell to CFOs and brokers and navigate long, considered buying decisions.

  • Comfort with regulation: you can work with the PRA, FCA and fronting partners and turn compliance into a product feature.

  • Comfortable operating in ambiguity: making irreversible calls with incomplete data.

  • Credibility with a large corporate partner and with forward-looking venture investors.

This is your company. We're here to help.

title: Full Stack Software Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Why Faculty?


We established Faculty in 2014 because we thought that AI would be the most important technology of our time. Since then, we’ve worked with over 350 global customers to transform their performance through human-centric AI. You can read about our real-world impact here.

We don’t chase hype cycles. We innovate, build and deploy responsible AI which moves the needle - and we know a thing or two about doing it well. We bring an unparalleled depth of technical, product and delivery expertise to our clients who span government, finance, retail, energy, life sciences and defence.

Our business, and reputation, is growing fast and we’re always on the lookout for individuals who share our intellectual curiosity and desire to build a positive legacy through technology.

AI is an epoch-defining technology, join a company where you’ll be empowered to envision its most powerful applications, and to make them happen.

About the team

 

Our Public Services Business Unit is committed to leveraging AI for the benefit of individual citizens and the public good.

From our work informing strategic government decisions, to optimising our NHS, through to reducing bureaucratic backlogs - we know that AI offers opportunities to drive improvements at every level of Government and we are proud to lead on some of the most impactful work happening in the sector.

Because of the nature of the work we do with our Government clients, you may need to be eligible for UK Security Clearance (SC) and willing to work on site with these clients from time to time.

 

About the role

 

As a Full Stack Software Engineer, you will collaborate with cross-functional teams to build and scale AI-powered systems that solve unique challenges for global clients.

 

This is an opportunity to take ownership of the entire stack, turning sophisticated machine learning outputs into high-impact, production-ready solutions that drive real-world transformation.

#LI-PRIO

 

What you'll be doing:

 

  • Working in cross-functional teams, alongside Data Scientists and Product Managers, to deploy technically sophisticated, high-impact software.

  • Building reliable, and scalable frontend and backend architectures to enable the seamless delivery of advanced AI systems.

  • Building data pipelines and cloud infrastructure as part of wider AI systems.

  • Providing deep technical expertise to customers, helping them navigate complex requirements.

 

Who we're looking for:

 

  • You possess solid backend development skills in Python frameworks (such as FastAPI) and are comfortable managing the full application lifecycle.

  • You have full-stack experience and exposure to TypeScript and modern frontend frameworks like React or Vue

  • You have experience deploying software within cloud environments like AWS, Azure, or GCP, ideally using containerisation tools like Docker.

  • You demonstrate a scientific and pragmatic mindset, testing assumptions and balancing big-picture vision with the technical details required for execution.

  • You know how to maintain a balance between rapid prototyping and long-term maintainability.

  • You thrive in autonomous, fast-paced environments where you can take full ownership of problems.

  • You are a compelling communicator who enjoys working in a team-oriented culture and has a relentless drive to learn and apply novel technologies.

 

Our Interview Process

 

  1. Talent Team Screen (30 minutes)

  2. Pair Programming Interview (90 minutes)

  3. System Design Interview (90 minutes)

  4. Commercial Interview (60 minutes)

Our Recruitment Ethos

We aim to grow the best team - not the most similar one. We know that diversity of individuals fosters diversity of thought, and that strengthens our principle of seeking truth. And we know from experience that diverse teams deliver better work, relevant to the world in which we live. We’re united by a deep intellectual curiosity and desire to use our abilities for measurable positive impact. We strongly encourage applications from people of all backgrounds, ethnicities, genders, religions and sexual orientations.

If you don’t feel you meet all the requirements, but are excited by the role and know you bring some key strengths, please don't hesitate in applying as you might be right for this role, or other roles. We are open to conversations about part-time hours.

A note on AI: we're happy for you to use it for research and interview prep, but please don't use it to generate answers during live interviews. We also use an AI note-taker (Metaview) in interviews so interviewers can stay present (which you can opt out of just let us know,) and every application is reviewed by a human, never decided by AI.

  • Führen: Du führst unsere Heads, setzt klare Prioritäten, hinterfragst den Status quo und gibst ehrliches Feedback zu den Themen.

Nice-to-have

  • Du warst Gründer:in oder Geschäftsführer:in einer Agentur, eines Coaching- oder Beratungsunternehmens oder eines Online-Dienstleisters.

Was wir dir bieten

  • Führungsverantwortung ab Tag eins: vier direkte Reports, Budgetverantwortung, direkter Draht zu Sebastian und Gavin, kurze Entscheidungswege.
  • Gestaltungsfreiheit statt Gremien: Nach deiner Einarbeitung entscheidest du operative Themen eigenständig und wirst am Ergebnis gemessen, nicht am Prozess. Strategie, Pricing und große Richtungsentscheidungen bereitest du mit vor und entscheidest sie gemeinsam im Führungsteam.

  2. Fachgespräch (45 Min, digital): deine Erfahrung und dein Vorgehen. Vorab bitten wir dich wahrscheinlich um einen Persönlichkeitstest – als zusätzliche Perspektive für beide Seiten, nicht als Ausschlusskriterium.

title: Graduate Quantitative Researcher 2028 – Expression of Interest

As a Graduate Quantitative Researcher, you’ll work across the full research process, from framing the question and choosing the data to building, testing and deploying models. Machine Learning is central to the work, whether you’re extracting signals, forecasting prices or modelling relationships. Our data, compute and production infrastructure let you test ideas quickly, understand where they fail and decide what to investigate next.

Our researchers believe in academic discourse and invite fellow researchers, traders and engineers to challenge each hypothesis. Different perspectives help improve the question, the model and how it performs in production. Depending on the team you join, you'll own the research end to end. That could include:

  • Building models for pricing, forecasting and signal discovery, choosing the statistical, mathematical or Machine Learning methods that best fit the problem.

  • Monitoring models in production and using live behavior to refine your assumptions and decide what to investigate next.
  • Using deep learning and AI-enabled workflows to shorten the loop from hypothesis to evidence.
  • Working directly with researchers, traders and engineers to shape problems and understand how system constraints affect performance.

WHO YOU ARE

We're looking for aspiring Quantitative Researchers who are versatile and creative in innovating and suggesting new solutions. In return, we'll give you the freedom to pursue your ideas and implement them right into our production systems. 

In terms of skills and qualifications, we're looking for:

WHAT YOU’LL GET

You’ll join a culture of collaboration and excellence, where you’ll be surrounded by curious thinkers and creative problem solvers. Motivated by a passion for continuous improvement, you’ll thrive in a supportive, high-performing environment alongside talent colleagues, working collaboratively to tackle the toughest problems in the financial markets.

In addition, you’ll receive:

  • 25 paid vacation days in your first year, increasing to 30 from your second year onwards
  • Training opportunities, discounts on health benefits, and fully paid first-class commuting expenses
  • Extensive office perks, including breakfast, lunch and dinner, world-class barista coffee, bi-weekly chair massages, Friday afternoon drinks, a bicycle to explore Amsterdam and much more

title: Growth Engineer
descriptionHtml:
About Peec AI

AI search is changing how brands are discovered and chosen. People now ask ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude and Google’s AI answers what they used to search for, and AI assistants increasingly shape the journey from discovery to purchase. Winning customers now means winning over the AI systems that influence their decisions.

Peec AI is an AI search platform that helps marketing teams understand and improve how their brands are discovered, represented, and recommended. We show them where they stand, what’s shaping it, and where to act. Since launching in January 2025, Peec AI has passed $20M ARR and 4,000 paying customers. We’re a Series A company backed by 20VC and Singular, with 100+ people across our Berlin HQ and our New York office.

About the role

We are hiring a Fullstack Engineer for our Growth team. You will run experiments across the whole self-serve journey: from the moment someone first hears of Peec AI to the day they renew, refer a friend or leave. That covers the website, signup, pricing and checkout, the trial and onboarding. It also covers the moments in the product where we ask people to do something, like connect a tool, invite a teammate or upgrade. You can work on any of these, and we decide together where the focus goes each month or quarter.

You come up with the hypothesis, design the experiment and discuss it with the team. Then you run the rest of the loop yourself: build it, instrument it, ship it behind a flag, read the result and write down what happened.

You report to the VP of Growth and work with our Growth PM, our growth engineer, and the marketing and design teams.

What you'll do

  • Go after big swings. We size every idea first and look for changes that could move a funnel step by 30 to 40 percentage points. It is fine if most of them fail.

  • Build and improve the experimentation infrastructure. Feature flags, assignment at the account level, exposure logged when someone becomes eligible, outcomes recorded on the server, and holdouts we read.

  • Keep conversion data accurate. Event design, funnel definitions and readouts the team can rely on.

  • Own what you ship after launch. You watch it, read the result on the date you set, and decide whether we keep it, change it or remove it.

  • Build internal tools that let the team run more experiments with less manual work.

What we're looking for

  • You have run growth experiments end to end. You formed the hypothesis, designed the test, built it and read the result. Not advised on them, not analysed someone else's.

  • You write production code today. Strong React and TypeScript on the frontend, comfortable in Node.js and databases on the backend. Our stack is React, Node.js and Next.js.

  • You know what your volume can detect. You can size a test, say how long it needs to run, and tell us when a result is not readable.

  • SQL and analytics fluency. Funnels, cohorts, event design.

  • B2B SaaS experience.

  • You ship with Claude Code, Cursor or equivalent.

  • Product judgement. You can tell which changes need a test, which can ship without one, and which are not worth building.

  • Product taste. You care about how the things you ship look and feel. You can turn an idea into a screen that belongs in our product, and you know when to bring in our design team.

Bonus points

  • You set up an experimentation practice from scratch and grew it into a regular part of how the team works.

  • Product-led growth experience. Onboarding, activation, paywalls, pricing, checkout.

  • Acquisition experience. Website and signup experiments, SEO or paid funnels.

  • Experiments on low-volume B2B funnels, where only big changes are readable.

  • Experimentation platforms and feature flags. Statsig, GrowthBook, PostHog, or your own.
