title: IT-Systemspezialist für Medizintechnik (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
für die Doceins Lungenklinik Neustadt GmbH
Kennziffer: LKN-02

Unsere Doceins Lungenklinik Neustadt im Südharz ist eine der größten Lungenfachkliniken in Thüringen. Unser Haus ist hochmodern ausgestattet und als spezialisiertes Kompetenz- und Leistungszentrum für Pneumologie anerkannt. Das Krankenhaus verfügt über 80 aufgestellte Betten auf 4 Stationen, davon 20 Intensivbetten. Als spezialisierte Akutklinik für Lungen- und Atemwegserkrankungen liegt der diagnostische und therapeutische Schwerpunkt unseres Hauses im Bereich der Pneumologie, der Beatmungs- und Intensivmedizin sowie der Schlafmedizin. Wir sind ein nach DGP zertifiziertes Weaningzentrum und Zentrum für außerklinische Beatmung.

Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams suchen wir zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt eine/n rückenbauer/in zwischen IT und Medizintechnik. Sie sind der technische Allrounder an der Nahtstelle von klinischer IT-Infrastruktur und Medizingeräten. In dieser strategisch wichtigen Position verbinden Sie Anwendungswissen in Krankenhausinformationssystemen (KIS) mit technischem Know-how zu Medizingeräten – und sorgen so für sichere, effiziente und konforme Prozesse in unserem Krankenhaus. Ihre Arbeit ermöglicht es, dass medizinische Geräte nahtlos in digitale Workflows integriert werden, Daten sicher fließen und Systeme zuverlässig laufen – zum Wohl unserer Patient:innen und Mitarbeiter:innen.

Aufgaben

  • Netzwerkintegration von Medizingeräten:
    Planung, Konfiguration und Einbindung von medizinischen Geräten (z. B.
    Bildgebung, Monitoringsysteme, Laborgeräte) in die klinische
    IT-Infrastruktur (KIS, PACS, RIS etc.).
  • Schnittstellenanalyse und -optimierung:
    Zusammenarbeit mit Herstellern, IT-Abteilung und Medizintechnik, um
    Datenflüsse (HL7, DICOM, FHIR etc.) zu sichern und Interoperabilität zu
    gewährleisten.
  • Fehleranalyse und Störungsmanagement: Identifikation und Behebung von technischen Problemen an der Schnittstelle zwischen Geräten und IT-Systemen.
  • Organisation von Ausfallsicherheit und Hochverfügbarkeit: Redundanzkonzepte, Backups, Notfallpläne etc.
  • Compliance: Unterstützung bei der Sicherstellung der Einhaltung von externen und internen Vorgaben für Medizintechnik und IT-Systeme
  • Lebenszyklusmanagement von Medizingeräten: Installation, Konfiguration, Wartung und Deinstallation
  • Pflege der technischen Dokumentation: z. B. Medizinproduktebuch, Inventarlisten, Wartungsprotokolle, Softwareversionen, Netzwerkkonfigurationen
  • Update- und Patch-Management: Koordination von Software-Updates für Medizingeräte unter Berücksichtigung von Klinikbetriebs- und Sicherheitsanforderungen.
  • Ersatzbeschaffung: Begleitung von Ausschreibungen, Evaluierungen und Migrationen neuer Systeme.
  • Beratung und Schulung: Beratung der IT- und
    Medizintechnik-Teams sowie Schulung der Anwender/innen (Ärzt/innen,
    Pflegekräfte, MTRA etc.) zu technischen Fragen

Qualifikation

  • Abgeschlossene Ausbildung im Bereich Informatik, Medizintechnik, Elektrotechnik, Ingenieurwesen oder vergleichbare Qualifikation
  • Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung in IT-Infrastruktur, Medizintechnik oder KIS-Administration
  • Erfahrung mit Krankenhausinformationssystemen (bevorzugt Nexus KIS oder vergleichbare Systeme)
  • Kenntnisse in DICOM (Bilddaten), HL7 (Nachrichtenstandard), FHIR
    (moderne Schnittstelle) oder anderen medizinischen Datenformaten.
  • Erfahrung mit medizinischen Geräten (z. B. CT, Ultraschall, Laborgeräte, Patient Monitoringsysteme, Infusionspumpen).
  • Verständnis für Medizinprodukteklassifizierung (Klasse I–III) und Regulatorien (MPG, MDR, IEC 62366)

Erfahrung mit Server- und Client-Betriebssystemen (Windows Server, Linux).

  • Routine in der Erstellung technischer Dokumentationen (z. B. Medizinproduktebuch, Netzwerkpläne).
  • Teamplayer-Mentalität mit Eigeninitiative und Verantwortungsbewusstsein
  • Analytisches Denken und problemlösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise
  • Fähigkeit technische Inhalte verständlich an die nicht-technischen Mitarbeitenden zu vermitteln
  • Belastbarkeit und Flexibilität in einem dynamischen Umfeld (z. B. Notfälle, Wartungsfenster)

Benefits

  • Abwechslungsreiche und sinnstiftende Aufgabengebiete in einem spannenden Umfeld mit breitem Diagnosespektrum
  • Verantwortungsvolle Aufgabe mit Gestaltungsspielraum innerhalb flacher Hierarchien
  • Moderne Arbeitsumgebung mit state-of-the-art Technologien inkl. Homeoffice-Option für zwei Tage/Woche
  • Regelmäßige interne und externe Fort- und Weiterbildungen, Teilnahme an Fachkonferenzen
  • Unterstützung bei der Wohnungssuche und ggf. eines Umzuges
  • Attraktive Vergütung: Aufbauend auf einem Grundgehalt nach AVR DW Mitteldeutschland bieten wir Ihnen attraktive Zusatzleistungen

Ideal wäre eine Kombination beider Bereiche. Falls Sie stark in einem

Ja! Bei nachgewiesener Affinität zu IT oder Medizintechnik (z. B. durch

We’re building the infrastructure behind the next generation of investing. Our technology already powers some of the UK’s most ambitious fintechs, banks, financial advisers and wealth firms, with close to a million investors relying on Seccl-powered platforms. And we’re now expanding into Europe.

We’ve got a proven product, strong momentum and big ambitions for what comes next: helping more household-name brands launch and scale investment propositions, entering new markets and replacing outdated investment infrastructure with technology that’s faster, simpler and built for scale.

We’re proud to be part of Octopus, one of the UK’s most successful privately held investment and technology groups. That gives us the backing and long-term perspective to build something substantial, while keeping the pace and energy of a high-growth business. Seccl and Octopus are both B Corp certified and share a belief that profit and purpose should go hand in hand.

If you want to help shape the future of investing in the UK and across Europe, you’ll be in good company.

Check out the Seccl website to see what we’re building and read more about our mission to shape the future of investments.

The role

We’re looking for a Junior IT support analyst to join our TechOps team, reporting to the Senior IT support analyst. This role will help us deliver outstanding IT support to Seccl staff as we continue to scale.

Our TechOps team sits within Engineering and underpins Seccl’s modern workplace. It’s a fast moving, collaborative environment with plenty of variety, from supporting joiners, movers and leavers, to managing the Mac device lifecycle and SaaS admin. You’ll quickly build hands on experience with the latest tech.

What you’ll own

  • Act as the first point of contact for internal IT queries, owning triage and providing first contact resolution where possible

  • Meet first response SLAs and keep colleagues updated on ticket progress through clear, friendly communication

  • Support the joiner / mover / leaver process, from equipment provisioning and account setup to access changes and deactivation, maintaining an accurate IT asset register

  • Keep endpoints compliant with our security standards in a Mac first environment

  • Use our ticketing tools (e.g., Jira Service Management) and suggest pragmatic improvements to workflows and automation

  • Be a friendly face for TechOps, especially on busy office days - helping new starters settle in and resolving day-to-day issues quickly

This role’s for you if...

  • You’re proficient with Mac and comfortable supporting colleagues in a Mac based environment (essential)

  • You have a strong interest in technology, a problem solving mindset and clear, empathetic communication (essential)

  • You’re organised, proactive, friendly and confident engaging with people across the business (essential)

  • You’re happy to work 2–3 days a week from our Edinburgh office to support colleagues in person (essential)

  • You’ve had exposure to Microsoft 365 - Azure AD, Entra, Outlook, SharePoint, OneDrive (desirable)

  • You’ve used Jamf or other endpoint management (e.g., Intune) and understand the basics (desirable)

  • You’ve used Jira Service Management or similar ticketing systems and/or the Atlassian suite (desirable)

This role isn’t for you if...

  • You’re less comfortable in people-facing roles. As the first port of call for IT issues, and one of the first faces employees meet as they join Seccl, strong people skills are essential!

  • You’re not comfortable working in a fast-paced environment. Our speed and scalability are what set us apart; you need to be able to act quickly and think on your feet

  • You struggle to follow through on ideas. We value people who do what they say they will. If you care about something, you have the freedom here to make it happen

  • You don’t like change. You’ll get on great here if you relish the ambiguity of rapid growth and are willing to embrace uncertainty

What’s in it for you

We offer a generous mix of benefits designed around the things that matter to our people:

  • 💰 £27,000 - £30,000, reviewed annually, plus a 6% employer pension contribution and life assurance

  • 🌴 27 days’ holiday plus bank holidays, your birthday off and paid dependant leave

  • 💙 Two volunteering days each year

  • 🌎 The option to work abroad for up to six weeks a year

  • 🌟 Secclbrate, our recognition programme offering flexible rewards including extra pay, additional holiday and increased learning budget

  • 🏅 One-month paid sabbatical after eight years

  • 🏥 Private medical insurance with AXA Health

  • 👪 Enhanced parental leave

  • 💻 MacBook and up to £500 towards your home office set-up

  • 📖 £750 annual learning budget

  • 🌻 Health and wellbeing support, including free therapy through Wellness Cloud and mental health support through Headspace

  • 🌱 Financial wellbeing benefits, including Octopus Money, the Octopus Share Incentive Plan and will writing through Octopus Legacy

  • 🎁 Perkbox, with flexible points and a range of discounts and perks

  • 🚲 Access to Cycle to Work and Octopus Electric Vehicle Leasing

Our culture

We put people first and try hard to create an environment where people feel trusted, heard and able to do their best work.

We value openness, curiosity and different perspectives. You’ll have the freedom to challenge how things are done, experiment with better ways of working and take real ownership of your impact.

Check out our Glassdoor page for the latest reviews or our LinkedIn for company updates and insights from the team.

Interview process

Interviewing is a two-way process. Our interviews are conversational, with plenty of time for you to get to know us and ask questions too:

  • Screening call - 20 mins initial chat with one of our Talent team

  • First stage – 45 mins competencies-based interview with the hiring manager and IT support analyst

  • Second stage – one hour technical interview or assessment with the hiring manager and the Senior TechOps manager

We review applications as they come in and may close the role once we have enough candidates to move forward. We’ll keep you updated throughout.

Everyone’s welcome

We want to build a diverse and inclusive company full of brilliant people with different skills, experiences and perspectives. All applicants will be considered without regard to age, ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, veteran status, neurodiversity or disability.

If this sounds like your kind of thing, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t tick every box. We’d love to hear from you.

Compensation: £27K – £30K

title: Junior Product Manager
descriptionHtml:
Introductie

Ben jij analytisch sterk, commercieel ingesteld en heb je affiniteit met techniek en productmanagement? Weet jij marktontwikkelingen te vertalen naar kansen voor producten en diensten? En krijg jij energie van het optimaliseren van een productportfolio en het succesvol introduceren van nieuwe producten?

Bij FAAC Technologies zoeken we een Junior Product Manager die verantwoordelijk wordt voor de positionering en ontwikkeling van ons productportfolio. In deze rol vorm je de verbindende schakel tussen Sales, Marketing, Techniek en de internationale productmanagementteams van FAAC Group. Door marktontwikkelingen te volgen en klantbehoeften te analyseren, zorg je ervoor dat onze producten aansluiten op de behoeften van de markt en de strategische doelstellingen van de organisatie.

We zoeken iemand die aan het begin van zijn of haar carrière staat en zich verder wil ontwikkelen binnen productmanagement. Of je nu net bent afgestudeerd en klaar bent voor een eerste uitdaging, of al circa 1 tot 3 jaar werkervaring hebt opgedaan: enthousiasme, analytisch vermogen, commerciële interesse en de motivatie om je te ontwikkelen vinden we minstens zo belangrijk als ruime werkervaring.

In deze veelzijdige hybride functie komen marktinzichten, commerciële analyses en technische kennis samen om onze producten en diensten continu te verbeteren. Je krijgt de ruimte om je kennis en ervaring verder uit te bouwen en te groeien in de rol. Je rapporteert rechtstreeks aan de Manager Techniek.

Wat ga je doen / Taken en verantwoordelijkheden

Als Product Manager ben je verantwoordelijk voor de positionering, ontwikkeling en optimalisatie van het productportfolio van FAAC Technologies. Marktbehoeften en productontwikkelingen vertaal je naar concrete verbeteringen. Daarnaast zorg je ervoor dat productinformatie, prijzen en communicatie actueel en consistent blijven.

  • Analyseren van marktontwikkelingen en klantbehoeften om deze te vertalen naar het productaanbod

  • Uitvoeren van prijsanalyses en afstemmen van de prijspositionering met internationale productafdelingen

  • Volgen van productontwikkelingen en vertalen van relevante innovaties naar kansen voor de organisatie

  • Afstemmen van productintroducties en de lancering van nieuwe diensten met betrokken teams binnen FAAC Group

  • Begeleiden van processen rondom productintroducties en het uitfaseren van producten

  • Analyseren en optimaliseren van het bestaande productportfolio

  • Coördineren van technische producttrainingen en in kaart brengen van de opleidingsbehoefte binnen de organisatie

  • Leveren van input voor productcommunicatie, waaronder online communicatie en marketingmateriaal

  • Bewaken van de kwaliteit, volledigheid en consistentie van productinformatie

  • Beheren en actualiseren van artikellijsten, prijslijsten en productdocumentatie

  • Zorgen voor toegankelijke en actuele productinformatie voor interne afdelingen en andere betrokkenen

  • Samenwerken met Sales, Marketing, Techniek, internationale productmanagementteams en klanten

  • Naleven van de geldende HSE-richtlijnen en bijdragen aan een veilige werkomgeving

Wat bieden wij

Bij FAAC Technologies werk je in een stabiele, internationaal opererende en technisch gedreven organisatie met een informele werksfeer en veel ruimte voor zelfstandigheid.

  • Een salaris tussen € 4.359,45 en € 6.198,54 bruto per maand, afhankelijk van ervaring

  • 40 vrije dagen (27 vakantiedagen + 13 ADV-dagen)

  • Een goede pensioenregeling via PME, het pensioenfonds voor de Metalektro

  • Een veelzijdige hybride functie op het snijvlak van techniek, commercie en productmanagement

  • De mogelijkheid om bij te dragen aan de ontwikkeling en positionering van een internationaal productportfolio

  • Intensieve samenwerking met verschillende disciplines en internationale teams

  • Een professionele werkomgeving met ruimte voor eigen initiatief en persoonlijke ontwikkeling

Over FAAC Technologie

FAAC Technologies, onderdeel van de wereldwijd opererende FAAC Group, is dé specialist in toegangsautomatisering. Van automatische deuren en poorten tot slagbomen en parkeersystemen – wij leveren innovatieve en veilige oplossingen. Bij FAAC werk je in een informele, technische en dynamische omgeving waar samenwerking en klantgerichtheid centraal staan.

De FAAC Group omvat 32 bedrijven in 24 landen, met 18 fabrieken in 15 landen en 3 business units. Dankzij deze internationale schaal ontwikkelen en implementeren wij wereldwijd oplossingen voor personen- en voertuigenverkeer, met een sterke focus op kwaliteit, veiligheid en duurzaamheid.


Wie ben jij

  • HBO werk- en denkniveau, bij voorkeur in een commerciële, technische of bedrijfskundige richting.

  • Aan het begin van de carrière, met de ambitie om verder te groeien binnen productmanagement.

  • Een starter of circa 1 tot 3 jaar relevante werkervaring, bijvoorbeeld in productmanagement, productmarketing, sales of een vergelijkbare functie.

  • Affiniteit met technische producten en commerciële vraagstukken.

  • Analytisch sterk en in staat om marktontwikkelingen en klantbehoeften te doorgronden.

  • Leergierig, initiatiefrijk en bereid om verantwoordelijkheid te nemen.

  • Sterke communicatieve vaardigheden en het vermogen om met verschillende interne en externe stakeholders samen te werken.

  • Goede beheersing van de Nederlandse en Engelse taal, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk.

Wat breng je mee

  • Een analytische en nieuwsgierige instelling.

  • Goede organisatorische en communicatieve vaardigheden.

  • Interesse in markt- en prijsanalyses en productpositionering.

  • Het vermogen om informatie te vertalen naar concrete inzichten en acties.

  • Een proactieve, resultaatgerichte en gestructureerde werkhouding.

  • Oog voor detail en een goed gevoel voor kwaliteit.

  • Het vermogen om technische informatie begrijpelijk te maken voor commerciële en niet-technische collega's.

  • Affiniteit met internationale samenwerking.

Solliciteren

Zie jij jezelf als Junior Product Manager bij FAAC Technologies en wil je bijdragen aan de verdere ontwikkeling en positionering van onze producten binnen een internationale organisatie?

Solliciteer dan via de bekende weg of neem contact met ons op voor meer informatie. We maken graag kennis met je.

title: Junior Produktmanager SaaS (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Wir suchen eine neue und engagierte Verstärkung (m/w/d) für unser Produktmanagement. Du unterstützt uns dabei, unsere Softwarelösungen für Vermessung und Baudokumentation gezielt weiterzuentwickeln, die Anforderungen unserer Kunden in klare Produktentscheidungen zu übersetzen und neue Funktionen gemeinsam mit unserer Entwicklung erfolgreich an den Markt zu bringen.

Was macht die NGN IT Solutions GmbH?

Die NGN IT Solutions GmbH aus Bad Königshofen ist ein ITK-Beratungs- und Softwareentwicklungsunternehmen mit Schwerpunkt auf GIS-Lösungen für den Glasfaserausbau sowie den Hoch- und Tiefbau. Seit 2011 entwickeln wir Software, die auf Baustellen und in Büros jeden Tag im Einsatz ist.

Mit unseren Produkten GIStance und Foto-GIS erfassen Bauunternehmen Aufmaß, Vermessung und Fotodokumentation direkt vor Ort – von der zentimetergenauen RTK-Vermessung bis zum 3D-Scan offener Gräben. Über 400 B2B-Kunden und mehr als 10.000 Nutzer arbeiten mit unseren Lösungen. Um unsere Produkte konsequent an den Bedürfnissen dieser Kunden auszurichten, suchen wir Verstärkung für unser Team.

Was sind Deine Aufgaben als Junior Produktmanager SaaS (m/w/d)?

Du sprichst regelmäßig mit Bauunternehmen, Netzbetreibern und Planungsbüros, die täglich mit unserer Software arbeiten. Deine Ansprechpartner sind in der Regel Geschäftsführer, Inhaber, Bau- oder Projektleiter sowie die Anwender auf der Baustelle.

In diesen Gesprächen findest Du heraus, vor welchen Herausforderungen die Unternehmen stehen, beispielsweise beim Aufmaß, bei der Vermessung oder bei der Dokumentation und Abrechnung von Baustellen. Aus diesen Erkenntnissen leitest Du konkrete Anforderungen ab, priorisierst sie und stimmst die Umsetzung mit unserer Entwicklung ab.

Deine Aufgabe besteht somit darin, die Brücke zwischen Kunden, Vertrieb und Entwicklung zu bilden und dafür zu sorgen, dass wir die Funktionen entwickeln, die unseren Kunden im Alltag wirklich weiterhelfen.

Noch keine Erfahrung im Bau- oder GIS-Umfeld?

Während der Einarbeitung lernst Du unsere Produkte, unsere Kunden und die Abläufe auf der Baustelle kennen. Vorkenntnisse im Bereich Bau oder GIS sind von Vorteil, aber nicht notwendig. Wichtig sind uns erste Erfahrungen im Produktmanagement oder im Umfeld von Softwareprodukten, idealerweise SaaS, sowie eine strukturierte Arbeitsweise.

Aufgabenbereiche:

  • Weiterentwicklung unserer SaaS-Produkte GIStance und Foto-GIS

  • Durchführung von Kundengesprächen und Bedarfsanalysen

  • Erstellung und Pflege der Produkt-Roadmap

  • Aufnahme, Bewertung und Priorisierung von Anforderungen

  • Formulierung verständlicher Anforderungen für unsere Entwicklung

  • Abstimmung mit Entwicklung, Vertrieb und Geschäftsleitung

  • Planung, Vorbereitung und Begleitung neuer Produkt-Releases

  • Auswertung von Kundenfeedback und Nutzungsdaten sowie Beobachtung des Marktes

Weiterentwicklungs- und Aufstiegsmöglichkeiten in den nächsten Jahren sind vorhanden.

Die Einarbeitungsphase dauert in der Regel 2-4 Monate.

Wir bieten:

  • Sicherer Arbeitsplatz: Wir möchten, dass jede Person in unserem Team langfristig mit uns arbeitet.

  • Attraktive Vergütung & Karrierechancen: Unsere Mitarbeiter erhalten ein attraktives Gehalt sowie Aufstiegs- und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten. Wir wachsen stetig und benötigen daher in Zukunft weitere Experten und/oder Führungskräfte.

  • Klare, strukturierte Einarbeitung: Du durchläufst eine klare und strukturierte Einarbeitungsphase mit festen Abläufen und Prozessen. Dadurch lernst Du unsere Produkte und unsere Kunden von der Pike auf kennen.

  • Flache Hierarchien: Direkter Zugriff zu Vorgesetzten und der Geschäftsleitung.

  • Modernes Office: Unser modernes Büro befindet sich in der Wallstraße 34 in Bad Königshofen.

  • Hochwertiges Equipment: Wir arbeiten mit moderner und hochwertiger Arbeitsausstattung.

  • Mobilitätsbudget & betriebliche Altersvorsorge: Wir unterstützen Dich mit einem Mobilitätsbudget für Deinen Weg zur Arbeit und einem hohen Zuschuss zur betrieblichen Altersvorsorge.



Was erwarten wir?

  • Erste Erfahrungen im Produktmanagement oder im Umfeld von Softwareprodukten, idealerweise SaaS

  • Fließendes technisches Englisch in Wort und Schrift – an der Schnittstelle zwischen Kunden und Entwicklung kostet jedes Missverständnis Geld

  • Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse für die Gespräche mit unseren Kunden

  • Erste Berührungspunkte mit GIS-Themen oder Baunormen sind von Vorteil, aber kein Muss

  • Technisches Verständnis und Interesse an Vermessung und Baudokumentation

  • Du übersetzt Kundenwünsche in klare, umsetzbare Anforderungen für die Entwicklung

  • Strukturierte und zuverlässige Arbeitsweise

  • Schnelle Auffassungsgabe und die Bereitschaft, Dich in neue Themen einzuarbeiten

title: Lead Brand Designer
descriptionHtml:
About Act

There are over 5 billion users using basic applications today such email, notes, tasks, calendar and they're not AI-native. Our mission is to build proactive applications for anyone in the world, who are not used to complex prompting. We aim to bring intelligence to conversations, errands, organising and workflows, with minimal to no prompting.

Our first application is an agent-first mobile communication app. We believe building applications that users use daily for communication, coordination and collaboration needs will help integrate AI into their lives. The net effect is to eliminate misinformation, achieve low coordination costs, enable high quality tasks and collaboration at scale with minimal or little prompting.

 

About the Role

Define how Act is seen by the world.

You'll create the visual identity behind our brand across product launches, website, recruiting, social media, presentations, merchandise, and marketing. You'll play a key role in building a global AI brand from the ground up.

 

What You Will Be Doing

  • Develop and evolve Act's visual identity.

  • Design launch materials, marketing assets, presentations, and social content.

What You Will Need

  • Excellent typography, layout, and visual communication skills.

  • High attention to detail.

  • Proficiency with Figma and Adobe Creative Suite.

How We Work

The best products in the world are built by small, highly capable teams. We operate with high talent density, fast execution speed, and strong ownership. We care deeply about product quality, clear thinking, and practical execution.

This is a hands-on environment. Everyone is expected to contribute directly, operate independently, and make good decisions under ambiguity. Our goal is to build products that are genuinely useful to billions of people globally.

 

Interview process

For design roles, we expect candidates to submit a portfolio as part of the application process.

If there appears to be a fit, we'll reach out to schedule 2 rounds of interviews and a design challenge.

Applications are evaluated by our team members. Interviews will be conducted via virtual meetings and/or onsite.

We value transparency and efficiency, so expect a prompt decision. If you've demonstrated the exceptional skills and mindset we're looking for, we'll extend an offer to join us. Als wachsendes Start-up in Berlin setzen wir auf Teamarbeit, Verantwortung und Mitgestaltung. Jede:r hat die Möglichkeit, aktiv zur Weiterentwicklung beizutragen und Ideen einzubringen. Gemeinsam arbeiten wir an einer nachhaltigen Zukunft. 🚀

Über die Rolle

Wenn bei uns eine PV-Anlage fertig gebaut ist, fängt ein Großteil unserer Wertschöpfung erst an: Über Mieterstrom, GGV und Onsite PPA versorgen wir ganze Häuser mit grünem Strom direkt vom eigenen Dach, Tag für Tag und Jahr für Jahr. Energy Services ist der Bereich, in dem aus Contracted ARR echter ARR wird – in der Strombelieferung, im Betrieb und in der Abrechnung. Der Bereich ist schnell gewachsen, und das Team hat mit Automatisierungen und einer zentralen Energiedatenbank starke Grundlagen gelegt. Jetzt suchen wir die Person, die Energy Services als Ganzes führt: Du berichtest direkt an unseren CEO und führst ein Team aus vier Personen.

Unser Prinzip dabei: Routinearbeit gehört in Automatisierungen – die Zeit unserer Leute gehört Urteilsvermögen, Kundenbeziehungen und Entscheidungen.

Deine Aufgaben

Steuerung, Wachstum & Führung

  • Du verantwortest Contracted ARR und ARR von Energy Services und sorgst dafür, dass neue Projekte schnell live gehen und Umsatz bringen

  • Du entwickelst das KPI-Framework für Energy Services und baust eine klare, für das ganze Team sichtbare Kette von den Zielen bis zu den Ergebnissen auf

  • Du führst und entwickelst dein Team und gibst jeder Person klare Ziele, KPIs und Raum zum Gestalten

  • Du entwickelst unsere Strategie für Mieterstrom im Bestand, etwa mit Blick auf die Kosten pro Gebäude, und steuerst die Akquise vor Ort

Prozesse, Systeme & Regulatorik

  • Du bringst die Abrechnung von der Liegenschaft bis zum Zahlungseingang auf ein neues Level: Du definierst den Prozess, standardisierst ihn und automatisierst ihn konsequent

  • Du übernimmst unsere Schnittstelle zum Energiemanagementsystem (EMS) und entwickelst sie weiter

  • Du machst EEG-Vergütung, Mieterstromzuschlag, Direktvermarktung, Marktstammdatenregister und Messstellenbetrieb zu sauberen, verlässlichen Prozessen

  • Du arbeitest eng mit Asset Management, Finance, Project Management und Sales zusammen und lieferst die Datenbasis für unser Reporting an Banken und Kund*innen

Gewünschte Qualifikationen

Das bringst du mit:

  • Abgeschlossenes Studium, z. B. in Energiewirtschaft, Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen oder BWL, oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation

  • Du konntest bereits mehrjährige Erfahrung (3+ Jahre) in der Energiewirtschaft sammeln, idealerweise in Mieterstrom, GGV, Energievertrieb oder Messwesen

  • Du hast bereits ein Team geführt und Verantwortung für Umsatzziele getragen

  • Du verfügst über ein gutes Verständnis des regulatorischen Rahmens (EEG, EnWG, MsbG) und der Marktkommunikation (z. B. MaLo, MeLo, Messstellenbetreiber)

  • Du gehst sicher mit KPIs und Dashboards um und triffst Entscheidungen datenbasiert

  • Du sprichst fließend Deutsch und gutes Englisch

  • Erfahrung mit Abrechnungs- und Energiemanagementsystemen (EMS) sowie mit Tools wie Salesforce, Airtable oder Make ist von Vorteil

  • Erfahrung in einem Start-up oder Scale-up ist wünschenswert, aber kein Muss

Zusätzlich zählen für uns folgende Kompetenzen:

  • Datenbasierte Entscheidungsfindung – Du steuerst über Kennzahlen statt über Bauchgefühl und fragst bei jedem KPI, welche Entscheidung er ermöglicht

  • Prozess- und Automatisierungskompetenz – Du schaust auf einen gewachsenen Abrechnungsprozess und erkennst, was bleibt, was du neu baust und was eine Automatisierung übernimmt

  • Führungskompetenz – In deinem Team weiß jede Person, was ihr Ziel ist und wie sie zum ARR beiträgt

  • Tech-Affinität: Du siehst neue Tools und KI als Hebel, nicht als Bedrohung

  • Unternehmerisches Denken – Du triffst Entscheidungen immer im Kontext von Wachstum, Marge und Strategie

Das erwartet dich bei uns

Mit deinen Ideen gestaltest du die Zukunft der Solarenergie in einem schnell wachsenden Start-up aktiv mit!

  • Eine Schlüsselrolle mit direktem Draht zum CEO und 100 % Verantwortung für deinen Bereich

  • Flache Hierarchien, schnelle Entscheidungen und direkte Kommunikation in einer lockeren, positiven Atmosphäre

  • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit den Gründern und eine steile Lernkurve

  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten und Home Office für eine gute Work-Life-Balance

  • Modernes Office im Zentrum Berlins mit sehr guter BVG-Anbindung (z. B. Nordbahnhof, Rosenthaler Platz)

  • Voll ausgestattete Küche mit Kaffee, Softdrinks und Snacks rund um die Uhr

  • Regelmäßige Team-Lunches und Teamevents

  • Attraktive Zuschüsse für Urban Sports Club, JobRad und den ÖPNV

title: Lead Instructor, EMEA
descriptionHtml:
Build a Safer World.

TRM Labs provides AI-powered intelligence solutions that help public and private sector agencies investigate and disrupt crime. TRM's platforms enable investigators to trace illicit activity, build cases, and construct operating pictures of threat networks. Leading agencies and businesses worldwide rely on TRM to make the world safer and more secure.

About TRM

TRM Labs is on a mission to build a safer world by fighting crime and protecting the people who investigate it. We started as a blockchain intelligence company, helping law enforcement, government agencies, financial institutions, and businesses detect, investigate, and disrupt crypto-enabled crime. Today our platform reaches well beyond the blockchain: we fuse on-chain data with cyber and open-source intelligence (OSINT) so investigators can move from a single crypto address to the full story behind a criminal network. Our blockchain intelligence and AI intelligence platforms turn fragmented signals into fast, defensible investigative leads for the teams protecting public safety and national security every day.

TRM Academy delivers training and certification for the global community of investigators, analysts, and compliance professionals who detect and prevent fraud and financial crime involving cryptocurrencies. Learners get live and virtual courses, practical exercises, and a community of the world's experts in blockchain, crypto compliance, and financial crime investigations.

About the Role

As the Lead Instructor, EMEA, you will own the design and delivery of TRM Academy training across Europe, the Middle East, and Africa, with blockchain intelligence and crypto investigations at the core of what you teach. You will turn complex on-chain concepts into practical, mission-ready skills for law enforcement, national security, and government audiences, and you will be equally comfortable teaching crypto businesses, exchanges, and financial institutions. Cyber and OSINT tradecraft is the complement: you will show investigators how to pair it with on-chain tracing to build a complete case.

EMEA is a region where we win by showing up. You will deliver in person, in the room, with customers across the UK, DACH, the Nordics and Baltics, France, and beyond, and you will work closely with our regional sales, value engineering, and customer success teams so that training drives adoption and opens the next conversation. You will join a Training Team of master instructors who can command a room, build engaging content, and speak to every level of expertise. We know how our products are used in the real world and help our customers become humble masters too.

This is also a build role. EMEA training is a growing opportunity, and you will help shape how it is scoped, packaged, and delivered as the region scales.

Please note: this role requires travel of 50-75%, primarily across EMEA.

The Impact You'll Have Here

  • Program manage and deliver live, in-person, and virtual blockchain intelligence training to law enforcement, national security, and government learners across EMEA.

  • Teach crypto fundamentals through advanced investigations on TRM's blockchain intelligence and AI intelligence platforms, helping investigators trace funds and build complete, defensible cases.

  • Develop and maintain curriculum, labs, and practical exercises that stay current with the crypto threat landscape, including fraud, scams, ransomware, hacks and exploits, terrorism finance, sanctions evasion, and money laundering typologies.

  • Adapt content for regional legal frameworks, case types, and audience maturity, from first-time crypto investigators to experienced national security analysts.

  • Pair on-chain tracing with cyber and OSINT techniques in courses and case walkthroughs, so learners can pivot from off-chain signals to blockchain activity.

  • Partner with sales, value engineering, and customer success to scope training engagements, support onboarding and enablement, and turn training into adoption and expansion.

  • Build relationships with law enforcement and industry partners across the region to grow the TRM Academy cadre and learner community.

  • Develop train-the-trainer materials and instructor guides so the Academy can scale in EMEA and coach other instructors as the team grows.

What We're Looking For

  • 3-5+ years of experience instructing courses, leading trainings, or delivering technical instruction.

  • Blockchain, cryptocurrency, or digital assets subject matter expertise (core requirement), ideally from hands-on on-chain investigations or crypto-enabled crime casework.

  • Law enforcement or government experience, or a proven track record training these audiences. Police and financial crime investigators are especially welcome.

  • Eligibility to obtain a government security clearance in the UK or another EMEA country.

  • Fluent English, written and spoken.

  • Experience building coursework, curriculum, labs, and appropriate testing.

  • Comfortable training private-sector audiences, such as crypto businesses/VASPs, exchanges, and financial institutions.

  • Excellent oral and written communication skills and the ability to command the room.

  • Willingness and ability to travel 50-75% across EMEA.

  • AI fluency (part of our performance review process and of the interview process).

Nice to Have

  • Professional fluency in German (strongly preferred, given the size of our DACH opportunity).

  • Fluency in French, or in a Nordic, Baltic, or Eastern European language.

  • An existing national security clearance.

  • Experience in or alongside a national security, intelligence, or financial intelligence unit.

  • Working knowledge of cyber investigations, OSINT, and/or cyber threat intelligence (CTI) tradecraft.

  • Relevant certifications (for example GIAC credentials such as GCTI or GOSI, or similar cyber and OSINT credentials).

  • A Nordic, Baltic, or Eastern European background in crypto, particularly with national security experience.

A Note on AI Fluency

TRM is an AI-native company. We expect our instructors to already be using AI tools in their day-to-day work to accelerate research, author and refine training content, and speed up investigative and analytical workflows. AI fluency is not awareness or interest; it is production usage. It is evaluated in our interview process and is part of our performance review process.

Why This Role Matters

Investigators and analysts across Europe are facing crypto-enabled crime at growing scale, from fraud and ransomware to sanctions evasion and terrorism finance. By teaching them to trace funds on TRM's platforms and combine that with cyber and OSINT tradecraft, you directly increase how quickly and confidently they can detect, investigate, and disrupt the threats that put people at risk. Every cohort you train turns abstract concepts into concrete skills they can apply to active cases that week, and you will help define how TRM Academy shows up across EMEA.

Application Instructions

If you’re interested in joining TRM, we encourage you to apply directly. Every application is reviewed by our Talent team.

Before applying, review the job description carefully and highlight the experience and impact that best demonstrate the required qualifications. Please also provide thoughtful and accurate answers to the application questions, as these will be used to evaluate your skills and qualifications for the role.

If you send your resume directly to someone at TRM, we can’t guarantee it will reach the appropriate hiring team. Applying directly is the best way to ensure your application will be considered.

Interviewing with TRM

Our process is designed to understand how you think, solve problems, and deliver impact, while allowing you to evaluate TRM. Most interview processes include a case study, an AI skills assessment, and a Leadership Principles interview.

  • Recruiter Intro: Qualifications, motivations, and alignment with the role.

  • Hiring Manager: Deep dive into your relevant experience, skills, and impact.

  • First Round: 1–2 interviews focused on the skills most critical to the role.

  • Final Round: Hands-on case study. This is usually a panel-style session where we go deeper into your craft, problem-solving, and alignment with TRM.

  • References: Former colleagues who can provide insight into your work and impact.

  • Offer: Congrats! Your recruiter will present the offer and compensation details.

  • Welcome to TRM: We're excited to build a safer world with you!

Your recruiter will share your specific interview plan and preparation guidance along the way.

AI Fluency at TRM

AI fluency is a baseline expectation at TRM.

We believe AI meaningfully changes how top performers operate. We expect every team member to use AI to accelerate and reimagine their craft, not just automate surface tasks.

At TRM, AI fluency means you are among the top 10 percent of operators in your function in how you apply AI to:

  • Accelerate repeatable workflows

  • Structure and solve problems

  • Improve output quality

  • Increase speed and leverage

You will be evaluated on applied AI fluency during the interview process.

Life at TRM

We are building a safer world. That promise shows up in how we work every day.

TRM moves FAST. We are a high-velocity, high-ownership team that expects clarity, follow-through, and impact. People who thrive here are energized by hard problems, experimentation, and continuous feedback. If something takes months elsewhere, it will ship here in days.

Our work sits at the intersection of AI, national security, and fighting crime. The problems are complex, the stakes are real, and the environment evolves quickly. The pace and intensity of the work reflect the importance of the mission. As a result, the way we operate requires a high level of ownership, adaptability, collaboration, and creative problem-solving.

At TRM, you should expect:

  • Priorities and targets to change quickly

  • Operating with a high degree of ambiguity

  • A high level of personal ownership and accountability

  • Close collaboration across teams and functions

  • Frequent, high-touch communication

  • Creative problem-solving and out-of-the-box thinking

  • A pace that rewards urgency, adaptability, and outcomes

This environment is energizing for people who enjoy building, solving hard problems, and making progress in situations that are not always fully defined. It also requires thriving in ambiguity, adjusting course as new information emerges, and maintaining focus and positivity in a fast-moving and intense environment.

We also recognize that this style of operating is not for everyone. If you are primarily optimizing for predictability or a consistently balanced workload, we encourage you to use the interview process to pressure-test whether this environment is truly the right fit. We want teammates who thrive here, not just survive here.

If you are excited by meaningful problems, motivated by ambitious goals, and energized by working alongside mission-driven colleagues, there is a good chance you will find TRM to be an exceptional place to grow and contribute.

Leadership Principles

We hire and grow against three leadership principles. They’re the standards for how we operate, treat each other, and make decisions.

  • Impact-Oriented Trailblazer: We put customers first and move with speed, focus, and adaptability. We treat every plan like an experiment – test, ship, measure, and iterate quickly.

  • Master Craftsperson: We care deeply about our craft. We balance speed with high standards, own outcomes end‑to‑end, and invest in getting better everyday.

  • Inspiring Colleague: We add clarity and energy, not noise. We bring humility, candor, and a one‑team mindset — giving and receiving feedback to make the team stronger.

Join our Mission

At TRM, we care deeply about our craft. We are looking for individuals who want their work to matter, who experiment with speed and rigor, and who take pride in building a safer world for billions of people. If you’re excited by TRM’s mission but don’t check every box, we encourage you to apply — we hire for slope, judgment, and the will to learn fast.

TRM is a Series C company with $220M in total funding, backed by Goldman Sachs, Bessemer, Y Combinator, Thoma Bravo, and others. Headquartered in San Francisco, TRM operates as a distributed-first company with hubs in Los Angeles, San Francisco, New York, Washington D.C., London, and Singapore.

Privacy Policy and Additional Information

By submitting your application, you agree to allow TRM Labs to process your personal information in accordance with our Privacy Policy.

We collect the information you provide (such as your resume, work history, and contact details) solely for the purpose of evaluating your candidacy for current and future roles at TRM.

Because our hiring cycles for certain positions may span 24 to 36 months, we retain your personal information for up to 36 months from the date of your application. After that period, your data is deleted unless a different retention period is required or permitted by law.

If you are located in the European Economic Area, the United Kingdom, or another jurisdiction with applicable data protection laws, you have the right to access, correct, or request deletion of your personal data at any time before that period ends. To exercise any of these rights, contact us at To notify TRM Labs that you believe this job posting is non-compliant, please submit a report through this form. No response will be provided to inquiries unrelated to job posting compliance.

The use of AI tools of any kind (including but not limited to notetakers, interview assistants, and real-time coaching tools such as Otter.ai, Fireflies, Fathom, Cluey, or similar) during TRM interviews is not permitted without prior approval from TRM. TRM uses its own internal tools for note-taking to ensure a consistent and confidential experience for all candidates.

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations to applicants with disabilities, and requests can be made via this form.

Recruitment agencies

TRM Labs does not accept unsolicited agency resumes. Please do not forward resumes to TRM employees. TRM Labs is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes and will not pay fees to any third-party agency or company without a signed agreement.

descriptionHtml:

https://www.immersivelabs.com/company/our-story

Lead Product Designer -AI Security & Agentic Experiences- UK (Remote)

We’re looking for an experienced, customer-centric and data-driven individual to join our Product team as a Lead Product Designer - AI Security & Agentic Experiences based out of the UK.

You will help shape new experiences for governing, assessing and securing AI, an emerging space where we're tackling new problems and helping organisations adopt AI with confidence.

Beyond the product, you'll help shape how we work as a design team, raising the quality of our thinking, craft and collaboration.

As an advocate for Product Design excellence within Immersive, you will shape the next generation of AI-powered and agentic experiences within our enterprise cybersecurity platform, Immersive One. You'll help design intelligent, trustworthy workflows that bring together human expertise, AI-assisted decision-making, and increasingly autonomous capabilities.


Reporting to the Director of Product Design, you’ll own product problems from early discovery and definition through to validation, detailed design, delivery and iteration. You’ll work closely with Product and Engineering, using research, data and strong product judgement to shape experiences that work for customers and the wider platform.


This is a role for someone who thinks beyond individual screens — considering end-to-end journeys, information architecture, workflows, reusable patterns and how decisions scale across a complex B2B product.


You will be instrumental in shaping the future of our products, designing flexible, intelligent frameworks rooted in object-oriented thinking and guided by customer and user feedback and research. Your product output will drive measurable business outcomes that shape the evolution of our design system to define how cyber resilience comes to life across the Immersive One platform.


Our most successful product designers here bring a potent mix of strategic vision, user empathy, and analytical rigor to their work, while constantly expanding their knowledge through cross-team collaboration. You are the sparring partner for the Product Managers and Engineering teams with a close eye for scalability and commerciality - a true consultant who brings both research and evidence to the table and is able to articulate the ‘Why’ to validate design decisions through experimentation, metrics, and real-world usage.

As the most senior individual contributor in the team, your main responsibilities will include:

  • Lead the design of thoughtful, high-quality and scalable product experiences, from defining the right approach through prototyping, validation and detailed design execution.

  • Pioneer the integration of intelligent automation and generative AI into user flows to dramatically boost efficiency, accuracy, and decision-making speed.

  • Transform complex, technical cybersecurity data into clear, intuitive user interfaces that facilitate effective investigation, analysis, and response.

  • Partner closely with research teams to synthesize qualitative and quantitative insights, grounding all design decisions in solid data.

  • Champion Object-Oriented UX (OOUX) to create reusable components and streamlined workflows aligned with core platform entities.

  • Govern the evolution of our design system to guarantee cross-product consistency, accessibility, and intelligent adaptability.

  • Leverage customer insights, behavioural analytics and success metrics to inform product priorities, guide design decisions and measure the real-world impact of our solutions.

  • Collaborate with engineering partners to ensure the thoughtful, consistent, and scalable implementation of all product features.

Sounds good? We’d love to hear from you if you have proven experience in the following areas, but don’t worry if you don’t hit each one exactly:

  • Extensive experience in product or UX design, particularly within complex SaaS enterprise, data-driven, and platform environments. Ideally, you have worked on AI-powered features, intelligent automation, agentic workflows, or AI-native products

  • Demonstrated track record designing for complex enterprise UX – ideally B2B SaaS, cybersecurity, developer tools, infrastructure, or technical platforms.

  • Experience shaping design direction across complex products, making informed design decisions, bringing others along and remaining hands-on in execution.

  • Exceptional collaboration skills to strategically partner with product, engineering, and research to align design outcomes with core business and user objectives.

  • Expertise in systems thinking, sophisticated interaction design, and establishing robust, data-connected workflows.

  • Comfortable using emerging AI tools and rapidly testing ideas with Product and Engineering.

  • Familiarity with or a strong interest in Object-Oriented UX (OOUX), advanced information architecture, and data modeling principles.

  • Ability to define, track, and analyze success metrics to measure the tangible impact and effectiveness of design solutions.

  • Excellent communication, presentation, and storytelling skills, with a proven ability to influence and align diverse, senior-level stakeholders

    We are looking for our Product Designer to be based in the UK, and we offer both remote and hybrid working options.

Immersive’s growth has been fuelled by our values that underpin everything we do, here's how they relate to this role:

  • Driven - We push the boundaries of innovation, acting swiftly to achieve ambitious outcomes. Our drive embodies a culture of ambition, where challenges are stepping stones to excellence.

  • Inclusive - Our strength lies in diversity, fostering a culture where every individual contributes to our collective strength. We champion open dialogue and empathy, ensuring a collaborative, inclusive workplace.

  • Customer Centric - We seek to develop deep relationships with our customers to help them achieve their business outcomes. We exceed our customers and partners' expectations by crafting products, services and experiences that surprise, delight and ensure they feel valued and supported every day.

  • One Team - We are a talented global team working together to achieve our vision. Central to our ethos, resilience means adapting and thriving in adversity. It guides our innovation, ensuring we and our clients are prepared for the future.

We encourage people of all different backgrounds and identities to apply. We are committed to maintaining an inclusive, supportive place for you to be you and do your very best work.

Excited by the above? We’re ready to receive your application!


As well as an inclusive, supportive place for you to be you. We offer an extensive range of benefits so you can do your very best work:

  • Time off, flexible and remote working so you can work when is best for you, includes 25 days annual leave + 2 volunteering days and birthday day off

  • Look after your family and yourself with enhanced parental leave, mindfulness groups, critical illness cover,

  • Career and learning development through the platform and our ‘Learn Anything’ fund

  • Share in the companies success with share options, sales incentives and Recognition & Rewards for doing great work and living our values and behaviours

  • Informal or formal flexible working options, e.g. flexible start and finish times, reduced hours, job share, remote working

  • We’re a sociable, tight-knit team with monthly socials, and sports clubs. Our socials have included everything from pottery painting and paper mask making, to movie nights and escape rooms

  • While this is a remote position, we do all meet in our EMEA HQ on a bi annual basis and regularly in person in region.

Find out more about life at Immersive Labs https://careers.immersivelabs.com


Cyber threats wait for no one and neither should you. Apply now!

title: Legal Engineer Manager, Paris
descriptionHtml:
Why Harvey

At Harvey, we’re transforming how legal and professional services operate. By combining frontier agentic AI, an enterprise-grade platform, and deep domain expertise, we’re reshaping how critical knowledge work gets done for decades to come.

This is a rare chance to help build a generational company at a true inflection point. We have strong product-market fit and world-class investor support. We’re scaling fast and defining a new category in real time. The work is ambitious, the bar is high, and the opportunity for growth — personal, professional, and financial — is unmatched.

Our team moves fast, takes ownership, and is deeply committed to the mission — operating with intensity, staying close to our customers, and pushing each other for excellence. We live by three values: Decisiveness, Simplicity, and Job's Not Finished. We act quickly on clear judgment over perfect information, we believe simplicity is what scales, and we're never satisfied with where we are. If you want to do the best work of your career alongside people who share that drive, we'd love to build with you.

At Harvey, the future of professional services is being written today — and we’re just getting started.

Role Overview

As Harvey scales its pre-sales function across EMEA, we are hiring a Legal Engineer Manager to lead and grow the team in Paris. This role exists to provide senior leadership and strategic direction to a team of Legal Engineers who sit at the heart of Harvey's commercial motion - bringing legal credibility, product expertise, and consultative support to law firm and in-house prospects.

Harvey’s Legal Engineers are skilled lawyers from top-tier law firms who apply their legal experience to ensure that current and prospective customers understand how Harvey’s solutions enhance specific day-to-day workflows, working alongside Harvey’s Account Executives to support all aspects of our sales strategy. Legal Engineers build consultative relationships with law firm partners and associates and in-house attorneys at private equity firms and Fortune 500 companies, becoming trusted advisors on how Harvey’s AI solutions can make them more effective.

Similar to the way Solutions Architects secure the “technical win” in the sales process, Legal Engineers secure the “legal win” by performing in-depth customer discovery and education on Harvey’s solutions through targeted meetings and demos that resonate with the customer’s day-to-day workflows specific to their legal practice area.

  • Act as the “Voice of the Customer,” using your legal perspective to help the broader sales team to develop and implement more effective strategies and synthesize customer feedback for the product team through a legal lens.

  • Travel may be required from time to time, including visits to customer office locations and company offices.


What You Have

title: Machine Learning Research Scientist
descriptionHtml:
About Boltz

Boltz is a public benefit company building the next generation of AI-powered molecular modeling tools to make biology programmable and accelerate drug discovery, while keeping frontier capabilities broadly accessible.

Boltz began as an MIT spin-out. Our founders built Boltz-1 at MIT, and it became the first fully open-source model to match AlphaFold 3's accuracy in predicting the 3D structure of biomolecular complexes.

We focus on two things:

  • Open foundation models. Boltz-1, Boltz-2, and BoltzGen are open models trusted by 100,000+ scientists across biotech and academia, and used in programs at every Top 20 pharma as well as leading agrichemical and industrial research organizations.

  • Boltz Lab. Our commercial platform runs our latest models and design agents as reliable, production-grade tools built around real chemistry and biology workflows. Teams start from a target and a hypothesis, then generate, evaluate, and rank candidate molecules, while we provide the compute, infrastructure, and collaboration layer so their scientists can move faster.

The two feed each other: open-source adoption earns scientific credibility and community insight, and Boltz Lab turns that into real impact on our partners' discovery programs.

You can read more about our mission, research and product vision in our manifesto.

About the role

As a Machine Learning Research Scientist, you will support core research on our next open foundation model, Boltz-3. The goal is state-of-the-art structure prediction among open models, especially for antibody–antigen and small-molecule complexes, and every model we build afterwards starts from it.

You will work closely with the Pre-training team's research scientists and ML engineers, Research Engineering, who own training speed and cluster tooling, our Post-training team, and domain experts in chemistry and biology.

This role is ideal for a mission-driven technical leader who wants to push the frontier of structure prediction, then see that progress used by thousands of scientists.

What you'll do

  • Drive research direction on Boltz-3: new model architectures, training objectives and data strategies for structure prediction.

  • Design and run rigorous large-scale experiments, and analyze them carefully.

  • Build the benchmarks that show state-of-the-art antibody–antigen and small-molecule structure prediction, on both mean and best-of-sample (oracle) metrics.

  • Study how performance scales with inference-time compute, and turn that into how the model is used.

  • Learn from how the open model performs for the community and our partners, and turn its failure modes into the next round of research.

About you

Minimum Requirements

  • Extensive publication record in top-tier ML or life-science venues (e.g. NeurIPS, ICLR, ICML, Nature Methods). We're hiring at Senior or Staff level.

  • Demonstrated strength in deep learning research: new architectures, rigorous experiments and careful analysis.

  • Strong hands-on PyTorch and scientific Python (NumPy, SciPy, Pandas).

  • Experience training, scaling and evaluating large models, with a high bar for engineering quality, reproducibility and testing.

  • Experience in an interdisciplinary environment, working with experts outside ML.

Preferred Requirements

  • Experience with structure prediction, protein or molecular modeling, or diffusion and generative models.

  • Familiarity with the tools, data formats and workflows of structural biology, computational biology and chemistry.

  • Experience using Boltz models, or open-source contributions.

We know great people don't always tick every box. If this role excites you and you meet most of the minimum requirements, we'd like to hear from you.

What we offer

  • Lead research on open foundation models used by 100,000+ scientists.

  • Work alongside one of the most talent-dense teams in the field.

  • Significant ownership and independence, with responsibility for driving projects from concept to deployment.

  • Highly competitive salary with meaningful equity in a public benefit company.

  • Benefits:

    • 25 days plus bank holidays a year

    • Annual team offsite trip

    • Private healthcare (BUPA), covering pre-existing conditions

    • Pension program

    • Paid parental leave

    • Wellhub gym membership

    • Free lunch every day

    • Travel expenses

How we hire

  1. Initial screen with a member of the Talent team

  2. Technical interviews

  3. Onsite in London or virtual onsite with the team

  4. Offer + Onboarding

Our commitment

Boltz is committed to building a diverse team and an inclusive workplace. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds. If you need any adjustments during the hiring process, tell us and we'll make it work.

PlanD ist die führende ERP-Lösung für Gebäudereinigungsunternehmen im DACH-Raum. Jetzt beginnt die nächste Phase: Die beste AI-ERP Lösung am Markt werden, Skalierung auf >10 Mio. ARR, Upmarket-Expansion und AI-first Company Building.

Die Rolle und worum es geht

Du entwickelst unser Marketing weiter und ownst dabei ein breites Spektrum - Content, Brand, Social, Kampagnen, Website-Inhalte und Events. Du baust die Taktung, etablierst unser Brandkonzept weiter, konzipierst Kampagnen und verantwortest Social Media. Events wie unser PlanD Werk und Messen ziehst du mit und bewertest daten-getrieben, wie effektiv welche Maßnahmen sind.

Wir sind ein schlankes Team; du hast echte Ownership und berichtest direkt ans Leadership. Vieles machst du am Anfang selbst, ein Team kann später dazukommen.

AI ist für uns dabei zentral. Content wird bei uns agentisch supported und erstellt. Du solltest Lust haben, dich hier voll reinzuhängen.

Deine Aufgaben:

  • Social-Taktung aufbauen und halten (LinkedIn, Instagram)
  • Brandkonzept weiterentwickeln und im Alltag durchziehen
  • Kampagnen konzipieren, von Print bis Digital
  • Inhalte selbst erstellen, mit Agents im Workflow, und in Umlauf bringen: Website, Landingpages, Newsletter, Kundenstimmen
  • Messen, was Inhalte und Kampagnen bringen, und darauf aufbauen
  • PlanD Werk und Messen mitorganisieren und gemeinsam mit Sales als Lead-Quelle nutzen
  • Die Marketing-Funktion from the ground up mit aufbauen

Was diese Rolle besonders macht

  • Sichtbare Marke und starkes Wachstum in einer riesigen, noch wenig digitalisierten Branche
  • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Leadership und einem effizienten, kleinen Team im schönen Office in Berlin Mitte
  • Hands-on: Gute Ideen werden direkt umgesetzt
  • AI-Spielwiese: Wir bauen Content- und Company-Prozesse AI-first um; du gestaltest mit, wie Marketing-Teams von morgen arbeiten

Was du mitbringen solltest

Must-haves

  • Taste für besondere Marken und Content, und Lust, Inhalte selbst zu machen
  • Growth-Mindset: Du misst, was deine Inhalte bringen, von Reichweite bis Anfrage, und baust darauf auf
  • AI-first: Starke Tool-Nutzung, Experimentierung, agentischer Content-Alltag
  • Verhandlungssicheres Deutsch (wichtig für unsere Kunden)

Nice-to-haves

  • 1–3 Jahre Marketing, Agency oder Startup
  • Erfahrung mit Marketing-Analytics
  • Branchenbezug zu Gebäudereinigung, Handwerk oder Field Services

Diese Rolle ist ideal, wenn du

  • Inhalte selbst machen und sehen willst, was sie bewegen
  • Taste und Tempo mitbringst und Marketing vom Boden auf mitbauen willst
  • AI-first denkst und arbeitest

title: Mechanical Engineer – Design & Simulation (f/m/d)
descriptionHtml:
About Focused Energy

Focused Energy is building the future of clean energy through laser-driven inertial fusion. Backed by our $240M Series A - the largest fully secured Series A in the global fusion industry we are scaling rapidly across multiple geographies.

Based in Germany and the US, we have brought together the top scientific and engineering minds using proven technologies to unlock fusion power at commercial scale. Focused Energy is working to realize game-changing scientific innovation that promises to deliver a clean, sustainable and abundant source of power globally.

About the Role

As a Mechanical Engineer – Design & Simulation, you’ll perform engineering analysis and simulation work across Focused Energy projects, helping design and validate complex mechanical systems before hardware is committed. You’ll provide the analytical confidence needed to make sound design decisions across structural, thermal, dynamic, and fluid-system performance.

Working closely with senior mechanical engineers, systems engineers, project teams, and other engineering disciplines, you’ll use modelling and simulation to identify design risks early, recommend mitigations, and ensure mechanical designs are technically sound, manufacturable, safe, and ready for integration. Your work will contribute to systems including vacuum chambers, laser integration, diagnostic structures, and facility infrastructure.

What You’ll Do

  • Perform structural, mechanical, and thermal analysis using FEA tools such as ANSYS, Abaqus, COMSOL, or equivalent.

  • Carry out fluid-system analysis and thermal modelling to support mechanical design decisions.

  • Assess vibration, stability, and dynamic behaviour of mechanical assemblies and identify potential design risks.

  • Validate simulation outputs against design requirements, engineering standards, and expected operating conditions.

  • Translate analysis results into practical design recommendations that improve performance, safety, manufacturability, and system compatibility.

  • Develop and maintain 3D CAD models and engineering drawings using Autodesk Inventor or a similar tool.

  • Define and execute verification activities, prepare analysis reports, and provide simulation evidence for design reviews.

  • Collaborate with mechanical, systems, and project engineering teams to define interfaces, communicate results, and support multidisciplinary design decisions.

Who You Are

  • You are an analytical and technically rigorous mechanical engineer who enjoys solving complex engineering problems through modelling and simulation.

  • You take a methodical approach to setting up analyses, checking assumptions, interpreting results, and documenting conclusions.

  • You can translate complex simulation outputs into clear, actionable engineering decisions.

  • You identify design risks early and proactively propose practical mitigation strategies.

  • You communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical stakeholders, adapting the level of detail to the audience.

  • You collaborate effectively across mechanical, systems, and project engineering disciplines.

  • You take ownership of the quality, traceability, and accuracy of your analysis work and design evidence.

  • You are detail-oriented and committed to applying sound engineering fundamentals and standards consistently.

Desirable Skills & Knowledge

  • Experience performing structural, thermal, dynamic, and fluid-system analysis in a professional mechanical engineering environment.

  • Proficiency with FEA tools such as ANSYS, Abaqus, COMSOL, or equivalent, together with experience validating and documenting simulation results.

  • Experience with 3D CAD tools, preferably Autodesk Inventor, and the ability to connect analysis outputs with practical mechanical design decisions.

  • Knowledge of CFD tools such as ANSYS Fluent or OpenFOAM, vacuum or cryogenic mechanical systems, laser or optical integration, or scientific instrumentation.

  • Familiarity with design for manufacture and assembly (DFMA), prototype build and commissioning support, verification planning, and engineering documentation in experimental or multidisciplinary environments.

What We Offer

  • Innovative Technology & Mission: Be part of a cutting-edge company working on groundbreaking research in clean energy and scientific discovery.

  • Career Development: We invest in our people. This is an opportunity to join an early, growing company at the forefront of new technology, where you’ll have the opportunity to develop and grow your career.

  • Collaborative Culture: Work with great people in a dynamic, international environment with top-tier scientists, engineers and professionals passionate about solving global challenges.

  • Ownership: Take ownership from day 1 and drive impact by making decisions, solving challenges and shaping the future of our company.

  • Your Success is our Success: We offer a competitive salary and company ownership in the form of stock options, giving you a direct stake in our success and ownership in what we build together.

  • Vacation Days: We support your work-life-balance by granting you 30 days of vacation per year.

  • Snacks and Drinks: Our office fridges are never empty. Enjoy our healthy snacks and drinks. Our Darmstadt office even offers a canteen with delicious lunch options daily.

  • Retirement Plan: If you decide for a private pension plan, we will finance 20% on top of your monthly contributions, plus loyalty incentives.

  • Equipment: We offer state-of-the-art Windows or Apple Laptops. In addition, you will receive a keyboard, mouse and headset so you are fully equipped from day 1.

  • Events: We organize regular events to foster team bonding, encourage collaboration, and build a strong, supportive company culture. Connect with colleagues across departments, share ideas, and have fun together, both in and outside of the workplace.

  • Mobility with NAVIT: We partner with NAVIT to support your flexible commuting needs whether it’s a public transportation ticket, taxi rides or car-sharing you choose what fits your lifestyle.

  • Fitness with Wellhub: We care about your health. Get access to a wide range of gyms, fitness studios and wellness services across Europe through our partnership with Wellhub.

  • Leverage your strengths and interests to work on full feature implementation from brainstorming the architecture design, all the way to the back end implementation and delivery to the customers.

  • Optimize endpoints that touch billions of rows in the database, by applying profiling to ruby code and understanding crucial performance details of ClickHouse queries.

  • Perform code reviews, and suggest improvements to tools and processes.

  • Work on challenging products like Top Apps, where each query basically analyzes the whole dataset.

  • Design API contracts that other teams can rely on, and evolve them without breaking existing consumers.

  • Be the go-to partner for front-end, product, data science and customer-facing teams building on these APIs. Understand what they need, push back when a request would make the API harder to reason about, and turn recurring questions into better docs.

Experience We Want To See

  • 3+ years of experience as a software engineer (If you have lesser years of experience but have meaningful github contributions and other coding samples, this will be taken into consideration).

  • Strong foundation in programming, algorithms, and software application design.

  • Good API design for query-heavy, data-intensive APIs.

  • You have an understanding of the basics of cloud environments, and ideally you’ve had some exposure to AWS.

  • Required: Ruby on Rails (or Python and willing to learn Ruby on Rails).

  • Nice to have: Clickhouse, MongoDB, Sidekiq.

  • A track record of independently driving projects from ambiguous requirements to release.

Our Engineering Culture

We believe that "Simplicity is a prerequisite for reliability." We are looking for engineers who align with our core values:

- Simplicity: We avoid over-engineering. We prefer the tools we already have and the most straightforward solutions over "shiny new toys."

- Quality: We write code that is a pleasure to read because we know code is written once but read many times. We don't cut corners, and we polish to a high level before shipping.

- Extreme Ownership: We don't just do the minimum. We expect you to understand the "why" behind your work and own the ultimate goal of fixing problems at their root cause, avoiding temporary band-aids.

- Prioritization: We focus relentlessly on what is important, not just what is urgent.

title: Mobile Penetration Tester
descriptionHtml:
Waracle are looking for a Mobile Penetration Tester on a permanent basis for an exciting new role joining our world-class digital technology consultancy, home to a diverse, smart, curious and ambitious community of specialists in technology-driven transformation.

We work with ambitious clients to help them solve their biggest business and customer challenges. We help our clients to innovate and create intelligent digital products and services. We thrive on complex challenges and deliver business-critical IT transformation projects, moving seamlessly from strategy, design and delivery to operations.

This is a Hybrid role, offering the flexibility to balance your professional and personal life, with 2 days a week spent connecting with colleagues in our London office oron client site.

The Role

As a Mobile Penetration Tester, you will lead hands-on offensive and defensive security testing across client mobile applications, supporting APIs, and underlying platforms. You are a technical specialist who identifies vulnerabilities before attackers do, ensuring quality, security, and compliance across high-profile projects.

This role will be pivotal in uncovering flaws and driving the security of mobile ecosystems, working closely with our full-stack mobile engineering squads to embed offensive and defensive security insights across both front-end mobile clients and back-end systems.


Key aspects of the role include:

  • Mobile Penetration Testing & Assessments: Plan, scope, and execute comprehensive grey-box and black-box penetration tests across iOS and Android applications, APIs, and cloud-connected mobile architectures.

  • Vulnerability Analysis & Reverse Engineering: Perform deep-dive static and dynamic analysis, binary reverse engineering, and runtime manipulation to identify complex security flaws.

  • Actionable Reporting & Remediation: Produce clear, well-structured technical and executive reports detailing risk ratings, proof-of-concept exploits, and practical, code-level remediation advice for engineering teams.

  • Threat Modelling & Advisory: Partner with product squads and architects during design and delivery to conduct threat modelling, review security controls, and advise on secure mobile design.

  • Client Engagement: Communicate findings clearly to both technical teams and non-technical client stakeholders, managing expectations and guiding risk-based decision-making.

  • Security Research & Continuous Improvement: Stay ahead of emerging mobile threats and bypass techniques, sharing knowledge and evolving our internal testing methodologies and tooling.


Research shows that underrepresented groups tend to only apply for roles that they believe they meet 100% of the criteria for. At Waracle, we want to buck that trend! We hire for passion, potential and mindset as much as credentials. If you think you'd be incredible in the role, then apply - even if you don't think you tick every box!


What you'll bring:

We are seeking a highly technical expert with a strong focus on mobile platform security. You should bring:

  • Hands-On Mobile Pentesting: Proven commercial experience conducting penetration tests and security assessments against iOS and Android applications (aligned with OWASP MASVS / MASTG) and associated REST/GraphQL APIs.

  • Mobile Platform Internals: Deep understanding of Android and iOS security architectures, sandboxing, IPC mechanisms, keystore/keychain storage, and common mobile vulnerability classes.

  • Dynamic & Static Analysis Tooling: Practical proficiency with mobile testing and reverse engineering tools such as Burp Suite Pro, Frida, Objection, JADX, Apktool, Ghidra, IDA Pro, Hopper, ADB, and Xcode.

  • Bypass & Exploitation Techniques: Experience bypassing client-side controls including SSL/TLS pinning, root/jailbreak detection, anti-tampering, and obfuscation mechanisms.

  • Authentication & Cryptography: Strong grasp of mobile authentication flows (OAuth2, OIDC, biometrics), session management, and cryptographic implementations, with the ability to spot flawed implementations.

Desirable knowledge & experience:

  • Certifications: Recognised offensive and defensivesecurity or mobile-specific certifications such as CREST (CRT/CPSA), OSCP, OSWE, or GIAC GMOB.

  • Code & Scripting: Familiarity with reading/writing languages such as Swift, Objective-C, Kotlin, Java, Python, or Bash to review source code and automate testing tasks.

  • Low-Level & Cloud Security: Exposure to ARM/ARM64 assembly, native C/C++ libraries, or cloud environment assessments (AWS, Azure, GCP) supporting mobile backends.

  • DevSecOps Integration: Experience integrating automated security testing (SAST/DAST) into CI/CD pipelines within Agile delivery teams.

We are an equal opportunities employer and welcome applications from all suitably qualified persons regardless of their race, gender, disability, religion/belief, sexual orientation or age.
