You’ll work in a small team that gets customers live fast. What we need from you:

  • You have 2-3 years of hands-on SAP development experience.

title: Senior Account Manager
descriptionHtml:
About the Role  

At Ogilvy Health, we work with ambitious healthcare brands to create work that makes a meaningful difference.

We’re looking for a Senior Account Manager to join us, working on an exciting global respiratory account. This is a brilliant opportunity for someone ready for real ownership. You’ll have the autonomy to run the account day to day, build a strong relationship with the client and play a leading role in where the partnership goes next.

You’ll be joining a supportive team, but there’s plenty of space to make the account your own. With a strong pipeline of work ahead and a growing client relationship, you’ll have genuine visibility and the opportunity to make an impact. 

You’ll gain further global experience, work across campaign launches and major congress activity, and have a senior team around you when you need it, while still being trusted to lead.

If you’re a Senior Account Manager looking for a role where you can step up, have a voice and genuinely make an account your own, we’d love to hear from you.

What You’ll Do 

You’ll take the lead on the day-to-day running of the account, working closely with the client and wider Ogilvy team to keep everything moving in the right direction.

There’s a great mix of work to get involved in, from taking an established US campaign and helping bring it to global markets, to developing market toolkits, promotional materials and supporting major congress activity.

You’ll be responsible for:

  • Leading the day-to-day client relationship and becoming a trusted partner
  • Taking ownership of the account and keeping priorities, projects and teams moving
  • Leading global campaign work, including adapting and rolling out campaign materials across markets
  • Overseeing the development of promotional materials and communications
  • Working closely with strategy, creative, medical and project management teams
  • Playing a leading role in major congress activity
  • Spotting opportunities to strengthen and grow the client relationship
  • Supporting and developing more junior members of the account team
  • Bringing confidence, good judgement and a collaborative approach to everything you do

What You’ll Need  

You’ll already have good experience gained at the Account Manager level within a healthcare communications agency, ideally working with prescription pharmaceutical brands and global accounts.

We’d particularly love to hear from you if you have:

  • Strong Rx/pharmaceutical healthcare communications experience
  • Experience working on global campaigns and launches
  • Confidence managing senior day-to-day client relationships
  • A good understanding of promotional work and the pharmaceutical environment
  • Experience coordinating work across different markets and stakeholders
  • The confidence to lead an account and make decisions without needing lots of direction
  • Strong commercial instincts and an interest in helping an account grow
  • A collaborative, low-ego approach to leadership

How We’ll Support You 

Ogilvy celebrates its people. Fully. Enthusiastically. Unhesitatingly. We’ll empower you with the tools you’ll need to succeed. We’ll give you the autonomy to seek out new paths and better ways of doing things. We’ll support you with colleagues who are experts in their disciplines, drawn from across the Ogilvy network. And we’ll provide opportunities for you to do work of which you’ll be proud, with people you’ll be proud to call your teammates.  

Benefits 

  • 25 days’ annual leave, increasing to 30 days with service
  • Your birthday and Christmas off, plus one volunteer day per year 
  • Flexible working, with core hours of 10am–4pm
  • Work from anywhere in the UK for up to four weeks each year
  • Bupa healthcare, including access to a virtual GP and second opinion service
  • Enhanced pension contributions
  • Mental health counselling and wider wellbeing support
  • Monthly contribution towards fitness and lifestyle
  • On-demand learning, development and professional coaching
  • Enhanced family-friendly policies
  • Life assurance and income protection

Our ambition is to attract the very best diverse talent to Ogilvy, and to be the employer of choice in the UK. We want everyone to feel welcome when they join us, and once they’re here, for them to want to stay with us, grow their career, and to feel they belong with us.

We are an equal opportunity employer and we’re committed to creating an inclusive, welcoming environment for everyone who wants to work at Ogilvy. For us, diversity, equity and inclusion is integrated into everything that we do. We believe that for creativity to flourish, everything about how we work must have diversity at its core. Your race, colour, ethnic, religion, gender, gender identity, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, have no bearing on our hiring decisions, but we encourage everyone to feel free to express their true selves in an environment we are consistently striving to make as inclusive as possible.

We aim to facilitate an accessible and positive application experience for all candidates. If you require any adjustments from us to support you through the process or expect to require any adjustments to working conditions to be able to best perform in the role, please let us know. title: Senior AI R&D Engineer – Model Training  (f/m/d)
descriptionHtml:
Our Mission

Aleph Alpha is one of the few companies in Europe doing serious foundation model pre-training like our recently released Kolibri-1 model. Our customers - in finance, manufacturing, public administration - need models that understand German, meet European regulatory requirements, and work reliably in high-stakes settings. We're building that in Heidelberg.

Team Culture

At Aleph Alpha, we foster a culture built on ownership, autonomy, and empowerment. Teams and individual contributors are trusted to take responsibility for their work and drive meaningful impact. We maintain a flat organizational structure with efficient, supportive management that enables quick decision-making, open communication, and a strong sense of shared purpose.

We believe a strong engineering culture is the key to model training success. We like Extreme Programming and favor trunk-based development. We often mob-program, which keeps us aligned and means we always learn from each other.

About the Role

As a Senior AI R&D Engineer in Model Training (f/m/d), you will join our model training team in Heidelberg or Berlin. Most of the team is based in Heidelberg. The model training team is building and improving our model training pipeline, which has been used to train Kolibri.

  • You will work across our full stack. Some weeks you might be optimizing how training loads are scheduled on our cluster and making the pipeline more robust and performant so we can iterate faster. Other weeks, you will be enabling large-scale code execution for reinforcement learning. And at other times, you might dig deep into our evaluation codebase to lift inference throughput on evals.

  • No two days are the same. Things move fast, and your ability to focus and prioritize is what lets you unblock the team day-to-day while designing the high-quality tooling and infrastructure that speeds us up long-term.

  • We're still building out our training pipeline and infrastructure. Some pieces exist, some do not, and you will have real influence on what gets built and how. Your work directly shapes how quickly we can experiment and improve our models.

  • Identifying issues and taking initiative is what drives our day-to-day work.

  • Working mode, design decisions, priorities are all done in your team together with your team mates.
    The strongest teams often use highly collaborative techniques, like mob or pair programming.

  • Due to the highly collaborative nature of our work you are expected to be on-site at least two days a week. If you are in Berlin, you should expect to travel around every second month for a few days to Heidelberg.

  • We are specifically looking to strengthen the Software Engineering in the teams which are research heavy. Major points include improving the maintainability of our code through tests and design & architecture changes.

Requirements

  • At its core, you need to be able to dive into a codebase, change the behavior as necessary, and after the change the code should be better tested and easier to understand than before.

  • As such we look for candidates for an understanding of how to design for low coupling and high cohesion paired with the ability to incrementally refactor.

  • Experience with the following technologies is likely to be helpful:

    • Test Driven Development (TDD)

    • Trunk based development

    • Continuous integration

    • Domain Driven Design

Nice-to-haves

  • Most of our code is in Python, there is also the occasional Rust codebase.

  • Large parts of our training pipeline are built on top of Kubernetes.

  • We do not hire for skills in a particular technology or language, but rather ability to learn and mindset, yet experience with these technologies is a plus.

What we offer

  • Become part of an AI revolution!

  • 30 days of paid vacation

  • Access to a variety of fitness & wellness offerings via Wellhub

  • Mental health support through nilo.health

  • Substantially subsidized company pension plan for your future security

  • Subsidized Germany-wide transportation ticket

  • Budget for additional technical equipment

  • Flexible working hours for better work-life balance and hybrid working model

  • JobRad® Bike Lease

The hospitality industry is uniquely human, and it deserves technology that’s just as inspiring as the people behind it. At Mews, we’re transforming the industry with a platform that helps hotels run smarter, move faster and create better guest experiences.

You’ll work with smart, curious people who care deeply about what they do. You’ll have autonomy and the trust to make good decisions and move quickly. And you’ll enjoy a real sense of purpose as you see the impact of what we’re building.

If you’re motivated by ownership, curiosity and meaningful impact, and are driven to deliver consistent high performance, you’ll feel at home here.

About the role

Let's get into the specifics. It’s impossible to capture every nuance of a role – especially at a rapidly growing company like Mews – but if we had to distil it into a job description (which we do because this is a job description), it would be this:

We're looking for a Senior Analytics Engineer to lead the data architecture behind our most business-critical financial work: billing, regulatory reporting (EMI), SOX compliance, financial forecasting and executive reporting. You'll design the data solutions that finance, payments and audit teams depend on, set the standards for how analytics work ships, and mentor others on the team.

This is a shape-the-team role. You'll have real influence over how we work, what we build and the pace we move at.

We expect you to use AI fluently where it adds leverage in modeling, code review and debugging, and to apply clear judgment on where it doesn't.

Responsibilities

  • Lead the architecture and development of high-impact data models in dbt.

  • Architect data solutions across business-critical financial workflows, including billing, regulatory reporting (EMI), SOX compliance, financial forecasting and executive reporting.

  • Mentor analytics engineers and review code to uphold standards across the team.

  • Find and fix performance bottlenecks across the data stack.

  • Translate business problems into clean, efficient data solutions in close partnership with stakeholders.

  • Set team-wide standards for documentation, CI/CD, observability and testing.

  • Set the team's norms for where AI belongs in our workflow, from model development to code review, and where human oversight stays non-negotiable.

Requirements

  • 5+ years in analytics engineering or a similar role, with a track record of designing data models that hold up to cross-functional use.

  • Deep, hands-on expertise with dbt, SQL and Python on a modern data platform (Databricks or equivalent).

title: Senior Applied AI Engineer
descriptionHtml:
About the role

Scale's Global Public Sector team is focused on using AI to address critical challenges facing the public sector around the world. As a Senior Applied AI Engineer, you'll own the AI behaviour of production systems our clients depend on, including the agents, evaluations, and backend integration behind them. You'll lead delivery for your workstream and act as the technical point of contact for clients on how their AI performs on live data.

What you'll do

  • Own the AI layer of production systems for public sector clients, including agents, model integration, and the backend services they run on
  • Build production agents from established architectural patterns, with reliable tool calling, guardrails, and observability
  • Select and adapt established evaluation methods, and design new evaluations for client-specific risks
  • Apply context engineering, retrieval-augmented generation, model adaptation, or inference optimisation
  • Investigate regressions in the systems you own, lead root-cause analysis, and implement preventative changes
  • Lead project planning for your workstream and manage client expectations on scope, risk, and delivery
  • Codify recurring client work into reusable tooling, evaluation components, or guidance that other engineers adopt

What we look for

  • Backend engineering experience, with a track record of taking AI/ML systems into production and keeping them reliable
  • Ownership of the AI behaviour of a production system end to end, rather than delivering a component scoped by another team
  • Hands-on evaluation design that ties model behaviour to real-world outcomes, used to catch regressions
  • Comfort working directly with clients, including explaining model behaviour and trade-offs to non-technical stakeholders
  • Practical knowledge of handling regulated or sensitive data and designing for auditability; sovereign or on-premise deployment experience is valuable

Where this role sits

Your primary accountability covers production AI behaviour, its backend integration, and the evaluation required for a specific customer. Senior Full-Stack Engineers own the complete user-facing application and its infrastructure. ML Research Engineers lead novel agent architecture and the benchmark methodology used across accounts. The roles work together on agents and evaluation, with accountability set by the scope of the problem.

title: Senior Backend Engineer - Team Atlas
descriptionHtml:
About the Role

Banks and fintechs use Taktile to automate critical decisions, like credit and risk, in real time. We're building the infrastructure that makes financial institutions truly AI-native, and the backend is where the hard problems live.

We're growing rapidly with enterprise customers across banking and insurance, and we're looking for a Senior Backend Engineer to join Team Atlas : a small, high-ownership team focused on the data infrastructure powering our feature computation platform.

You'll own critical systems end-to-end, and your decisions will shape the product.

What You'll Do

  • Build and operate backend services in Python on AWS — Lambda functions, DynamoDB, Aurora, and event-driven pipelines that handle real production traffic. You'll leverage agentic AI tools as part of your daily workflow.

  • Tackle hard backend problems — latency, reliability, and scale are everyday concerns.

  • Own your systems end-to-end: from architecture and implementation to deployment, monitoring, and incident response.

  • Make key architectural decisions — you'll have real authority over how things are built, not just what gets built.

  • Raise the bar for the team through code reviews, mentoring, and improving our development tooling and processes.

  • Work directly with Product and Design to shape what we build next.

Requirements

  • At least 7 years of professional software engineering experience, with a proven track record of leading complex projects in a senior capacity (2+ years).

  • Deep expertise building backend systems on cloud platforms, we use AWS.

  • Strong system design skills — you're comfortable making architectural trade-offs and defending them.

  • Depth in at least one of these areas: data pipelines and storage, event-driven architectures, caching and performance, or serverless systems. You don't need all of them.

  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to align technical and non-technical stakeholders on a shared vision.

  • The ability to work in a hybrid model from our Berlin HQ, the London office, or the Iasi hub. Please note that relocation assistance is not provided for this role.

Ideal, But Not Required

  • Python, FastAPI, Apache Iceberg, AWS Athena, AWS Glue, or Apache Spark

  • Streaming / real-time data pipelines (Kinesis)

  • Multi-level caching strategies (Redis, DynamoDB, in-memory)

  • Serverless at scale (Lambda, SAM, CloudFormation)

Our Offer

  • Work with colleagues that lift you up, challenge you, celebrate you and help you grow. We come from many different backgrounds, but what we have in common is the desire to operate at the very top of our fields. If you are similarly capable, caring, and driven, you'll find yourself at home here.

  • Experience a truly flat hierarchy and communicate directly with founding team members. Having an opinion and voicing your ideas is not only welcome but encouraged, especially when they challenge the status quo.

  • Learn from experienced mentors and achieve tremendous personal and professional growth. Get to know and leverage our network of leading tech investors and advisors around the globe.

  • Receive a top-of-market equity and cash compensation package.

  • Get access to a self-development budget you can use to e.g. attend conferences, buy books or take classes.

  • Receive a new Apple MacBook Pro, as well as meaningful home office set-up.

Our Stance

  • We're eager to meet talented and driven candidates regardless of whether they tick all the boxes. We're looking for someone who will add to our culture, not just fit within it. We strongly encourage individuals from groups traditionally underestimated and underrepresented in tech to apply.

  • We seek to actively recognize and combat racism, sexism, ableism and ageism. We embrace and support all gender identities and expressions, and celebrate love in its many forms. We won't inquire about how you identify or if you've experienced discrimination, but if you want to tell your story, we are all ears.

About Us

Taktile enables financial institutions to transform into AI-native organizations that are increasingly powered by autonomous agents.

With our modular Agentic Decision Platform, customers combine AI agents, rules, relevant context, and human oversight to safely automate and optimize their decisions—approving more customers, reimbursing claims instantly, stopping fraud before it spreads, and financing every business worth funding.

Founded in 2020, Taktile powers millions of decisions daily for institutions including Mercury, Monzo, Faire, and Pleo.

With offices in New York, Berlin, London, São Paulo, and Iași, the company has raised $184M from Growth Equity at Goldman Sachs Alternatives, Index Ventures, Tiger Global, Balderton Capital, and Y Combinator. Learn more at taktile.com.

Depending on the location of this role, your employment or engagement will be with Taktile LLC (US), Taktile GmbH (Germany), Taktile Ltd (UK), or Taktile SRL (Romania). title: (Senior) Bioanalytical Principal Investigator LBS / GLP Study Director (100%)
descriptionHtml:

* This is a dual-level posting. The hiring team will determine the final level and title of the role based on the skills, experience, and capabilities required for the level offered.

Main responsibilities

Study Leadership & Scientific Oversight

  • Lead and oversee GLP/GxP-compliant bioanalytical studies and method validations within the Ligand Binding Services (LBS) department.
  • Act as Study Director and/or Principal Investigator with full responsibility for assigned studies or study phases.
  • Develop and approve study plans, validation protocols, analytical reports and associated study documentation.
  • Review, evaluate and approve analytical data to ensure scientific integrity and regulatory compliance.
  • Ensure all study activities are conducted in accordance with applicable SOPs, regulatory requirements and client expectations.

Client Management

  • Serve as the primary scientific and operational contact for assigned clients.
  • Provide regular project updates and maintain strong communication throughout the study lifecycle.
  • Support client meetings, scientific discussions and audits as required.

Operational Excellence

  • Coordinate laboratory activities and ensure efficient study execution.
  • Train, mentor and support assigned laboratory personnel.
  • Contribute to process improvements and continuous enhancement of laboratory operations and quality standards.
  • Support bioanalytical data management activities and documentation review processes.

Additional Responsibilities for Senior-Level Candidates

  • Lead complex or strategic client programs.
  • Provide scientific mentoring and guidance to junior Principal Investigators and laboratory staff.
  • Act as a subject matter expert for ligand-binding and cell-based assay technologies.
  • Contribute to business development activities, client presentations and scientific initiatives.

Our requirements

  • BSc / MSc in Life Sciences, Biochemistry, Biotechnology, Immunology or related field
  • At least 2 years professional experience, at least 6 years for senior position
  • Practical experience in relevant bioanalytical techniques (e.g. LBA, cell-based), preferably in an industry setting
  • Experience working in a regulated environment (GLP, GCP, GMP and/or ISO standards)

  • Strong team player with the ability to collaborate effectively across functions
  • Excellent English (written and spoken), good German skills are advantageous
  • Previous experience as a Study Director, Principal Investigator or equivalent scientific leadership role is required for the senior position

Your chance

We provide an opportunity to assume work independently, secure long-term employment, and enjoy a competitive salary.

Additionally, you will experience the advantages of flexible working hours and experience the benefits of a medium-sized company with flat organizational structure within a dynamic and international team.

descriptionHtml:
Brief info about Vinted 

Our mission is to make second-hand the first choice, and we're looking for people who want to help us get there. Every day, we work together to help our members buy and sell pre-loved clothing and lifestyle items, giving each piece a second life – or even a third.

Founded in 2008 in Lithuania, Vinted began as a way for friends to find new homes for clothes they no longer needed. In 2019, we became Lithuania's first unicorn! Today, our headquarters remain in Vilnius, and we've grown with offices across Europe, supported by a team of over 2,000 people. 

Information about the position 

Vinted’s Marketing domain is growing - we’re on a mission to make Vinted known and loved as the go-to destination for everything second-hand. Marketing is one of the primary drivers behind our biggest strategic goals, from winning the USA market to expanding beyond fashion into a multi-vertical platform.

We’re looking for a Senior Data Scientist to join our Marketing Data Science and Analytics team to hands-on build, refine, and scale our core predictive and explanatory models. In this role, you will be the technical engine behind our Bayesian Media Mix Models (MMM), user value machine learning models, and advanced statistical frameworks. Your focus will be on engineering robust, high-performing models that transform complex data into the precise insights our domain relies on.

In this position, you’ll

title: Senior Decision Scientist, Partner Excellence
descriptionHtml:
Relay is fundamentally reshaping how goods move in an online era. Backed by Europe’s largest-ever logistics Series A ($35M) led by deep-tech investors Plural, and a recently closed Series B ($95M), Relay is scaling faster than 99% of venture-backed startups. We're assembling the most talent-dense team the logistics industry has ever seen

Relay’s Mission is to free commerce from friction. Today, high delivery costs act as a hidden tax on e-commerce, quietly shaping what can be sold online and limiting who can participate. We envision a world where more goods move more freely between more people, making the online shopping experience seamless and accessible to everyone.

THE TEAM
• ~160 people, around half in engineering, product and data
• 45+ advanced degrees across computer science, mathematics and operations research
• Thousands of data points captured, calculated, analysed and predicted for every single parcel we handle
• An intellectually vibrant culture of first‑principles thinking, tight feedback loops and relentless experimentation

Relay delivers 400,000 parcels a day through people who don't work for us: van drivers who choose their own shifts, local shops that hold parcels, and couriers who take them to the door. We went from 3,000 parcels a day in London to 400,000 across the UK in under three years.

Parcel delivery has a quality problem the industry has learned to live with. Parcels go missing between depots. Parcels get marked as delivered and never reach the customer. Most carriers treat a steady rate of loss as a cost of doing business. Relay is building the delivery company where that stops being true.

That is harder for us than for most, because nearly everyone who touches a Relay parcel is an independent partner. We can't manage them into performance. We have to build the standards, the evidence and the product that make doing the job well the natural outcome. Engineering builds the product changes you design.

Partner Excellence Highlights

  • You own decision-making, not the model: you decide which signals count, which checks become rules, and whether each fix belongs in product, policy or training. The squad lead acts on your calls.

  • Most of a parcel's journey happens between scans. How do you prove a handover happened without making the job slower for the people doing it?

  • A delivery is marked complete and the customer says it never came. How do you tell a wrong address from a handover that went wrong, and put the fix where it belongs: product, policy or training?

  • Some checks can only answer "can't tell". Which are worth making provable, and which should we stop measuring?

  • A whole area, not a slice: you decide what evidence a whole network runs on, and the result is on the street the next morning.

  • Analytics at the front, not in support: the squad's roadmap follows the analysis, in a data team of about 30 across analytics, operational research and data science.

The Opportunity

As a Senior Decision Scientist, Partner Excellence at Relay, you'll:

  • Decide which Partner Excellence problems are real and which only look real, before anyone builds a fix.

  • Design how Partner Excellence decides: which signals count, what evidence the network runs on, and what good looks like.

  • Tell the squad lead what to change and what to stop, and get a decision.

  • Build the thing that decides: data applications, monitors and alerts, not decks, using Claude and agents to ship your own tools.

  • Go and look when the data and the street disagree: the sort centre, the van, the shop.

  • Get the missing data built, and prove which fixes worked. In a year, the squad can prove every handover in the network.

We're looking for candidates who…

  • Have owned fraud, risk or trust decisions end to end: turned investigations into rules, standards or interventions, and owned their number, such as the false positive rate you were held to, rather than building the model.

  • Have run investigations in fraud, risk, financial crime or trust and safety, and decided whether a signal was real or noise.

  • Have seen their work acted on: a leader changed a plan, a team adopted your method, or engineers built what you asked for.

  • Have worked somewhere with enough volume for a false positive rate to mean something, where your rules ran live and something happened when they were wrong.

  • Have got records created by teams who didn't report to you, and know how long it takes.

  • Are hands-on and fluent in SQL, with or without AI, and would rather ship a working answer this week than a perfect one next quarter. No logistics experience needed, just the appetite to learn a physical operation fast.

Don't tick every box? If this problem excites you, we'd still love to hear from you.

Who Thrives at Relay?

  • Aim with Precision: You define problems clearly and measure your impact meticulously.

  • Play to Win: You chase bold bets, tackle the hard stuff, and view constraints as fuel, not friction.

  • 1% Better Every Day: You believe that small, consistent improvements lead to exponential growth. You move quickly, deliver results, and learn from every experience.

  • All In, All the Time: You show up and step up. You take ownership from start to finish and do what it takes to deliver when it counts.

  • People-Powered Greatness: You invest in your teammates. You give and receive feedback with care and candour. You build trust through high standards and shared success.

  • Grow the Whole Pie: You seek out win-win solutions for merchants, couriers, and our customers, because when they thrive, so do we.

    If these resonate, and you combine strong technical fundamentals with entrepreneurial drive, let’s connect.

Relay is an equal-opportunity employer committed to diversity, inclusion, and fostering a workplace where everyone thrives.

title: Senior Embedded (ARM) Engineer - Quantum Computing (f/m/d)
descriptionHtml:
eleQtron develops and operates full-stack quantum computers based on trapped-ion technology. Quantum computing is a new computing paradigm rapidly approaching commercial viability. Our unique approach combines laser-cooled trapped ions with microwave control and tailored magnetic fields. Our next-generation computing machines under development will be able to find solutions to problems that are out of reach today, thus enabling new innovative products and services for a brighter future.

We are looking for a Senior Embedded (ARM) Engineer (m/f/d) to join us in Hamburg or Siegen and own the real-time firmware that turns our control electronics into a working quantum computer. You will work on our next-generation system, where the control electronics are being integrated into a single, highly integrated chip. You sit at the heart of the machine, between the hardware that generates the pulses and the higher-level software that describes the experiments. Timing is not a detail here; it is the product. You are the person who makes sure the right signal reaches the ions at the right nanosecond, reliably, run after run.

Responsibilities:

  • Own the embedded firmware on our ARM-based control platform, from architecture through implementation to on-hardware debugging

  • Develop and maintain the real-time software layer that coordinates pulse sequencing, timing, and data flow across our highly integrated control chip

  • Write and maintain the low-level drivers and board support the hardware relies on

  • Guarantee deterministic, low-latency behaviour under hard real-time constraints

  • Lead firmware bring-up together with our electronics and physics teams, and debug at the boundary where software meets signal

  • Define the firmware architecture and engineering practices — build, test, and release processes for the embedded layer as the system matures

  • Contribute to the interfaces between the embedded layer and the rest of the stack, so experiments defined in software run correctly on the machine


Required Skills:

  • 5+ years of professional embedded software development for real-time or timing-critical systems

  • Deep command of C (and ideally C++) on ARM platforms, working close to the hardware

  • Experience with bare-metal and/or RTOS environments, and a clear understanding of when each is appropriate

  • Comfortable reading schematics and datasheets, and debugging real hardware with oscilloscopes, logic analysers, and JTAG

  • Strong grasp of real-time concepts: interrupts, DMA, timing, concurrency, and determinism

  • A track record of bringing up firmware on new hardware, not only maintaining existing systems

  • Ability to collaborate effectively with experimental physicists and engineers, and to turn imprecise physical requirements into robust firmware

  • Strong adaptability and a quick learning mindset

  • Good proficiency in English (written and spoken)

Nice to have (Bonus)

  • Experience on highly integrated SoCs, particularly ARM+FPGA platforms such as Xilinx Zynq / RFSoC

  • Working alongside FPGA/digital-electronics engineers at the software–gateware boundary

  • Rust for embedded systems

  • Embedded Linux on ARM (Cortex-A), including driver and kernel-module work

  • Signal processing or control-loop implementation on embedded targets

  • Experience with high-speed data acquisition or precision timing systems

  • Familiarity with laboratory, scientific, or measurement instrumentation

  • Prior experience with quantum computing or other deep-tech domains


What you can expect from eleQtron:

  • Competitive salary: We value our team members and therefore provide remunerations that reflect this, additionally rewarding achievements

  • Flexible working hours: We offer personal freedom through a variety of flexible work schedules

  • Team spirit: In our international and diverse team, and with our regular team events, having fun at work is simply part of the culture

  • Further development: We want to grow together and so we offer our team members needs-based, individualized further training as well as plenty of room for personal development

  • Wellness Package: We offer health-promoting benefits such as fitness programs like UrbanSportsClub to support your well-being

  • Bike Leasing: Stay Mobile and Sustainable with Our Company Bike Leasing Program

  • Moving Benefits: A warm welcome! We are happy to support employees who move for us with a bonus

  • At the forefront: Work at the forefront of technology, where academic research meets commercial applications

  • Modern workplace: We have a high-quality infrastructure with laboratory space, offices and meeting rooms

We value diversity and equal opportunities, and are committed to fostering an inclusive working environment where all qualified individuals are welcome to apply, regardless of nationality, ethnic or social origin, skin colour, religion or belief, disability, gender, sexual orientation or gender identity.

title: Senior Financial Analyst, FP&A
descriptionHtml:
Why Coda Coda is a global growth engine for commerce, connecting people, digital products, and payments through trusted monetization and distribution solutions.

With 600+ people from 57 nationalities across 23 locations, we’re a truly global team headquartered in Singapore, with offices in Amsterdam, Dubai, Bristol, Shanghai, Eindhoven, and across Southeast Asia.

We power global commerce through a dual model. Our B2B solutions, Codapay, Coda Webstore, Coda Links, Coda Distribution, and Giftcloud, enable publishers and brands to monetize and distribute digital content globally. On the consumer side, we operate a portfolio of trusted storefronts including Codashop, Recharge.com, Startselect.com, and mobiletopup.co.uk, that give customers secure and easy access to game top-ups, digital credits, vouchers, gift cards and prepaid products in over 70 markets.

Our culture is built on respect, ownership, and collaboration. We move fast, support each other, and celebrate wins together.

If you’re looking to grow your career and make a real impact in a global team, Coda is the place for you.


The Opportunity
As Senior Financial Analyst at Coda, you'll play a key role in shaping how we plan, forecast, and steer our financial performance. You'll coordinate our budgeting, forecasting, and long-range planning cycles, bringing together our B2B and B2C businesses into one clear financial outlook. You'll also take ownership of our planning and reporting processes in Aleph and manage the group's non-personnel fixed operating expenses.

Reporting to the Director of FP&A, this is a hands-on role with high visibility and real impact. Your work will directly inform decisions made by our CFO, executive team, and Board, giving you the opportunity to influence how Coda plans for the future.


What You'll Do
  • Planning: Own the annual budget, regular forecasts and long-term financial planning process across the Group.
  • Consolidation: Integrate B2B and B2C forecasts into a comprehensive Group P&L, balance sheet and cash flow outlook.
  • Quality: Own key financial assumptions, challenge business drivers and ensure consistency, accuracy and reliability across forecasts.
  • Strategic Insights: Develop financial scenarios, sensitivity analyses and product profitability insights to support executive decision-making.
  • Ownership: Lead the development of our financial planning platform, streamlining forecasting, consolidations and reporting into one efficient process.
  • Automation and AI: Identify and implement smarter ways of working to improve efficiency, accuracy and scalability across FP&A.
  • Budgeting: Own the budget for non-personnel operating expenses, set cost centre targets and oversee approvals for unbudgeted spending.
  • Reporting: Prepare and review high-quality financial analyses, Board materials, investor updates and lender reporting, including covenant calculations.
  • Partner: Work closely with the Director FP&A and step in to lead planning and reporting cycles when required.
  • Collaboration: Partner with Accounting, Treasury and Business Control teams across Amsterdam, Singapore and Jakarta to drive alignment and financial performance.

    • What You'll Bring
  • FP&A expertise: 6-8 years of experience in FP&A, corporate finance or a related field, including at least 3 years leading budgeting and forecasting cycles.
  • Planning & consolidation: Proven experience managing and consolidating forecasts across multiple entities, markets or business units.
  • Financial modelling: Strong three-statement modelling skills and a solid understanding of cash flow and working capital.
  • Systems & analytical skills: Advanced Excel or Google Sheets proficiency and hands-on experience with planning tools such as Aleph, Anaplan, Adaptive, Pigment or similar.
  • Stakeholder management: Confidence to collaborate with, influence and constructively challenge senior stakeholders across finance and the wider business.
  • Communication & education: Excellent written and verbal English communication skills and a degree in finance, economics, econometrics or a related field.
  • Business environment: Experience in a high-growth, international or investor-backed organisation is a strong advantage.
  • Strategic finance exposure: Familiarity with Board, investor or lender reporting, including financial covenants. A background in Big 4, transaction services or investment banking is a plus.
  • Process improvement & innovation: A track record of building scalable finance processes, implementing or improving planning systems, or leveraging AI tools to drive efficiency is highly valued.
  • Mindset & ownership: Structured, pragmatic and proactive, with a strong sense of ownership, the ability to deliver under pressure and confidence working across international teams and time zones.

Our goal is to foster an inclusive environment where everyone feels welcome and valued. Due to the large number of exceptional applications we receive, we can only reach out to shortlisted candidates. If you don't hear from us, rest assured there may be another opportunity at Coda that aligns better with your unique abilities. Remember to check our Careers Page for more exciting job openings!

title: Senior Full Stack Engineer | Experimentation - Product Analytics | Germany | Remote
descriptionHtml:
Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at grafana.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.

You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.

This is a remote opportunity and we would be interested in applications from the UK, Ireland, Sweden, Spain and Germany.

The opportunity:

Grafana Labs is building a native experimentation platform: a Grafana app that lets teams define A/B tests, connect them to feature flags and product telemetry, and get trustworthy, statistically sound answers about what their changes actually did.

It started as a hackathon project and is now used by Grafana engineering and product teams in our internal environment to run real experiments. The next step is to make it a first-class product: one we rely on every day internally and, over time, one we offer to Grafana Cloud customers alongside Frontend Observability, Session Replay and our other user-experience capabilities.

You'll join the Product Analytics team, a group of highly technical product analysts who help teams across Grafana understand how our products are used and run experiments on them. As the team's dedicated software engineer, you'll own the engineering of the experimentation app and have a lot of influence over where it goes. You'll partner closely with data scientists on the statistics, data engineers on event pipelines and the data warehouse, software engineers across Grafana on feature flags, Frontend Observability and the App Platform, and product stakeholders who rely on experiment results to make decisions. This is a hands-on engineering role that ships production code. It is not an analyst role.

About the product:

The experimentation app is built on the Grafana App Platform:

  • Frontend: a TypeScript and React app plugin using @grafana/ui, plus a custom datasource plugin that powers experiment statistics panels.
  • Backend: Go, built with the Grafana App SDK. Experiments are Kubernetes-style custom resources defined in CUE, with an operator, admission webhooks, and support for declarative, GitOps-style management.
  • Feature flags: integration with OpenFeature and the OpenFeature Remote Evaluation Protocol (OFREP), Grafana's multi-tenant feature toggle service, and an embedded GO Feature Flag evaluator.
  • Statistics engine: a Bayesian analysis engine (TypeScript, with a Go port) that produces a direction-aware verdict per metric, probability to be best, credible intervals, expected loss and sample-size recommendations.
  • Data: experiment exposure and outcome events flow from product instrumentation through RudderStack into BigQuery, or from Grafana Faro into Loki, and are queried live through Grafana datasources.
  • AI: experiment authoring assisted by Grafana Assistant, which discovers relevant data and drafts the experiment configuration for a human to review.

What You’ll be doing:

  • Evolve the experimentation app from internal tool to product. Full ownership of features end to end across the React frontend and Go backend, from problem framing and design through rollout, measurement and iteration.
  • Build the experimentation experience. Develop intuitive workflows for defining hypotheses, configuring experiments and metrics, managing their lifecycle, and exploring results. Make these experiences useful for product managers and analysts as well as engineers.
  • Make instrumentation easier to adopt and trust. Evolve the experimentation SDK and its OpenFeature and Faro integrations. Help teams connect variant assignment, actual exposure, and outcome events with consistent identity and event contracts.
  • Connect experiments to the rest of Grafana’s user-experience stack. Integrate with Grafana Faro and Frontend Observability so flag exposures and outcomes are captured automatically, and link experiment results to Session Replay and critical user journeys so teams can see why a variant won, not only that it won.
  • Harden the statistics and analysis path. Work with our data analysts to extend the statistics engine, and make analysis scalable, cost-aware and correct. Examples include moving computation server-side, scheduled analysis, alerting on experiment health, and guardrails against misleading results.
  • Use AI where it genuinely helps. Extend the Grafana Assistant integration for authoring, explaining and reporting on experiments.
  • Raise the engineering bar. Mentor teammates, including analysts who contribute code, through code review, pairing and design docs. Write the architecture decision records (ADRs), docs and demos that help other teams adopt experimentation.
  • Own what you ship. Take part in on-call for the services you build, and support the internal teams that run experiments on them.

We invest heavily in developer productivity. You can use modern AI coding assistants as part of your daily workflow (your choice of tools, within security guidelines), backed by a company-funded usage budget so you can iterate quickly without unnecessary friction. We encourage pragmatic AI-assisted development: faster prototyping, test generation, refactors, documentation, and incident follow-ups, always with strong code review and quality standards. You’ll also have access to the latest frontier models from OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google.

What makes you a great fit:

We highly value people who are intellectually curious, default to transparency, have a strong bias towards action, and are kind and enjoy working as a team.

  • Strong full-stack engineering experience. You’ve built and operated production web applications with TypeScript and React, and backend services in Go (or a similar language, with willingness to work in Go). You value maintainability, automated testing and secure development practices.
  • Experience building an in-house platform or integrating existing experimentation and A/B testing platform (for example Statsig, Eppo, GrowthBook, Optimizely, LaunchDarkly experiments, or an in-house platform).
  • Product and data intuition. You care whether what you shipped actually moved the needle, and you’re comfortable working with event data, SQL and data warehouses such as BigQuery.
  • Technical ownership. You’ve delivered complex projects with minimal supervision, broken them into short feedback loops (analyze, design, ship an MVP, learn, iterate), and helped teammates work more effectively.
  • Operational responsibility. You’ve been on call, supported software in production, and know how to make systems observable and debuggable.
  • Pragmatic AI usage. You use AI coding tools thoughtfully, validate their output, and share practices that improve the team’s speed and quality.
  • Clear communication. You can explain technical and statistical tradeoffs to engineers, analysts and product managers in a fully remote, asynchronous environment.

Bonus Points For:

  • Hands-on experience with feature flags and OpenFeature.
  • A working understanding of experiment statistics: Bayesian or frequentist testing, sample sizing, variance reduction, and common pitfalls such as peeking and sample ratio mismatch.
  • Experience with Kubernetes concepts: custom resources, operators, admission webhooks, GitOps.
  • Experience building Grafana plugins or apps, or with the Grafana App SDK or Scenes.
  • Familiarity with frontend observability and product analytics tooling, such as Grafana Faro, RUM, session replay, RudderStack or Segment.
  • Open source contribution or maintainership.
  • Experience as a user of Grafana, Prometheus, Loki or Tempo, whether at work or on a homelab.

Compensation & Rewards:

In Germany, the base compensation range for this role is €100,000 - €125,000. Actual compensation may vary based on level, experience, and skillset as assessed throughout the interview process. All of our roles include Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), giving every team member ownership in Grafana Labs' success. We believe in shared outcomes—RSUs help us stay aligned and invested as we scale globally.

*Compensation ranges are country specific. If you are applying for this role from a different location than listed above, your recruiter will discuss your specific market’s defined pay range & benefits at the beginning of the process.

Why You’ll Thrive at Grafana Labs:

  • 100% Remote, Global Culture - As a remote-only company, we bring together talent from around the world, united by a culture of collaboration and shared purpose.
  • Scaling Organization – Tackle meaningful work in a high-growth, ever-evolving environment.
  • Transparent Communication – Expect open decision-making and regular company-wide updates.
  • Innovation-Driven – Autonomy and support to ship great work and try new things.
  • Open Source Roots – Built on community-driven values that shape how we work.
  • Empowered Teams – High trust, low ego culture that values outcomes over optics.
  • Career Growth Pathways – Defined opportunities to grow and develop your career.
  • Approachable Leadership – Transparent execs who are involved, visible, and human.
  • Passionate People – Join a team of smart, supportive folks who care deeply about what they do.
  • In-Person onboarding - We want you to thrive from day 1 with your fellow new ‘Grafanistas’ to learn all about what we do and how we do it. 
  • Balance is Key - We operate a global annual leave policy of 30 days per annum. 3 days of your annual leave entitlement are reserved for Grafana Shutdown Days to allow the team to really disconnect. *We will comply with local legislation where applicable.

Equal Opportunity Employer: Grafana Labs is an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from everyone regardless of race, colour, nationality, origin, caste, sex, gender reassignment identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, religion or belief, disability, veteran status, genetic information, pregnancy, maternity, marital, family or carer status, or any other characteristic which is protected by local law. We believe that equality and diversity build a strong organisation, and we work hard to ensure that is the foundation of our organisation as we grow.

Grafana Labs may utilize AI tools in its recruitment process to assist in matching information provided in CVs to job postings. The recruitment team will continue to review inbound CVs manually to identify alignment with current openings.

title: Senior Full-Stack Engineer (m/f/d)
descriptionHtml:
Our Company

"Buying Labs is the leading global partner for sourcing and distributing premium consumer goods!"

We're looking for a Senior Full-Stack Engineer (m/f/d) to join our Tech team at our Hamburg headquarters. Our goal is to supercharge how our business works with AI and technology, wherever it makes a real difference. You'll build the systems our teams rely on every day, from internal applications to the data and AI capabilities behind them, and see the impact of your work directly in the business.

This is a role for an experienced engineer who takes real ownership: someone who designs solid systems, builds AI into them where it adds value, and drives their work through to production and real users.

Your Mission

  • Own systems end to end: Design, build and run features across frontend and backend, from technical approach through deployment and support in production.
  • Build AI into our products: Design and integrate AI-powered features such as structured extraction, classification, automation and agentic workflows. Make them reliable through validation, evaluation and human review where it matters.
  • Data modelling and architecture: Build solid data models in PostgreSQL that serve as the foundation for our applications and AI features. Make architecture decisions that keep our systems maintainable as they grow.
  • Modern and established codebases: Build new applications on our modern stack, and maintain and modernise our established JavaScript platform, which our teams rely on every day.
  • Quality you can stand behind: Write tested, reviewed code and verify your own work before it reaches users. Monitor and troubleshoot production issues.
  • Work closely with the business: Understand the processes behind what you build, work directly with our commercial and operational teams, and help shape what gets built and why.
  • Raise the bar: Share knowledge,

Your Profile

  • 6+ years of professional software engineering experience, with a track record of building and running production applications end to end.
  • Proven experience building AI into production systems or applications, for example LLM-based extraction or classification, RAG, or agentic and tool-use workflows. You know how to make AI output reliable through validation, evaluation and fallbacks. Using AI coding assistants alone does not meet this requirement.
  • You use AI tools in your daily development work and have solid habits for checking and reviewing what they produce.
  • Strong TypeScript and JavaScript, and modern React, including hooks and state management.
  • Strong backend experience with Node.js and Express or a comparable framework, REST APIs, and integrating external systems.
  • Deep PostgreSQL and SQL skills, with solid data modelling and experience with an ORM or query builder such as Knex, Sequelize or Prisma.
  • Comfortable working across both modern TypeScript applications and an established JavaScript codebase.
  • Strong quality mindset: automated testing, code reviews, and taking responsibility for what you ship.
  • High ownership and drive: you push your work through to done, raise problems early, and don't wait to be told what to do next.
  • Clear communication with both technical and non-technical colleagues.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent experience.
  • Fluent English required; German is a plus.
  • Based in Hamburg or willing to relocate.

Nice to Have

  • Depth in LLM tooling: provider APIs (Anthropic, OpenAI, Gemini), agent and tool-use patterns (MCP), and evaluating output quality.
  • Vector search (pgvector or similar).
  • Product or process awareness: experience understanding how a business works and turning messy processes into structured systems.
  • Experience integrating ERPs or operational systems (orders, inventory, master data).
  • Our wider stack: Bun, Vite, Redis, RabbitMQ, Docker, GitHub Actions, AWS.
  • Observability and product analytics tools (e.g. Sentry, Datadog, PostHog).
  • Python for data tooling.
  • Background in eCommerce, wholesale or B2B environments.

Why Us?

  • An awesome team & great vibes: Work with motivated colleagues in an agile, ambitious, and friendly atmosphere where collaboration and fun go hand in hand with high speed.
  • Flat hierarchies & real growth opportunities: Take ownership of your role and develop personally alongside the company. We promote from within and value every voice, regardless of seniority or title.
  • Modern workplace & cutting-edge equipment: State-of-the-art office setup including adjustable desks, mobile treadmills, air conditioning, and everything you need to excel in your role.
  • Company pension program (bAV): Smart pension plan with a 30% Buying Labs grant on your contribution, investing in your financial future together.
  • Corporate Benefits membership: Access exclusive discounts from a wide range of partner brands and retailers.
  • Full "Deutschlandticket" coverage: We cover the complete cost (ca. €60/month) so you can travel sustainably and conveniently throughout Germany.
  • Free bike options: Choose between a complimentary "Swapfiets" bike (original or deluxe 7) or opt for JobRad bike-leasing with an additional €26/month grant from Buying Labs.
  • Complimentary food & beverages: Free Friday lunch in the office, plus organic fruit & vegetables, drinks, snacks, coffee/tea, healthy shots and seasonal treats (e.g. ice cream, soups) throughout the week.

  • Refer-A-Friend (employee referral program): You love being part of Buying Labs? Fantastic! Then recommend people from your personal network and receive attractive rewards.

Sounds like a perfect fit? We can't wait to meet you. Apply now and be part of our journey!

title: Senior Fullstack-Entwickler (m/w/d) – PHP/Symfony & React
descriptionHtml:
Der Plan steht, jetzt fehlst du: Bring unsere Software von Legacy-PHP auf Symfony und React.

Auf einen Blick

  • Stack: PHP 8.1 (Legacy) → Symfony · jQuery/Vanilla-JS → React · MySQL/MariaDB, SingleStore · Git, CI/CD
  • Gehalt: 52.000–62.000 € brutto/Jahr, für außergewöhnliche Profile auch mehr · unbefristet, Vollzeit
  • Arbeitsmodell: hybrid, 3 Tage Büro / 2 Tage remote
  • Standort: Berlin-Zehlendorf, direkt am S-Bahnhof Zehlendorf (S1)
  • Produkt: Konsentas, ein Termin- und Vorgangsmanagement für Behörden
  • Start: so bald wie möglich oder nach Vereinbarung

Die Rolle

Unser Kernprodukt Konsentas ist über viele Jahre gewachsen, und das sieht man dem Code an. Das Backend läuft auf PHP 8.1 ohne Framework. Im Frontend stehen jQuery und Vanilla-JS neben React, und automatisierte Tests gibt es bisher wenige.

Wohin es gehen soll, ist klar: Das Backend wird schrittweise auf Symfony umgestellt, das Frontend auf React vereinheitlicht. Bis Ende 2027 soll die Migration abgeschlossen sein. Was dafür fehlt, ist kein Plan, sondern Kapazität.

Du triffst eigenständig technische Entscheidungen, bringst dich in Architektur- und Modernisierungsfragen ein und sorgst dafür, dass die Codequalität mit jedem Release besser wird. Dabei bleibt das Produkt im Einsatz: Wartung, Support und neue Features laufen parallel zur Modernisierung.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Legacy-Module bei laufendem Betrieb schrittweise durch Symfony-Services und React-Oberflächen ersetzen
  • Fullstack-Features von der Datenbank bis zum Frontend entwickeln, teils auch als kundenspezifische Erweiterungen
  • Bestehenden Legacy-Code pflegen, debuggen und weiterentwickeln
  • Code-Reviews durchführen und die Testabdeckung ausbauen
  • Mit Entwicklungsleitung und Geschäftsführung abstimmen, welche Bereiche als Nächstes modernisiert werden
  • Unsere zwei Auszubildenden im letzten Ausbildungsabschnitt fachlich begleiten (ohne disziplinarische Führung)
  • Gelegentlich an Kundenterminen teilnehmen, etwa alle 3–4 Wochen

Nach 6 Monaten …

… setzt du Features eigenständig um, hast spürbar zur Modernisierung beigetragen, die Codequalität verbessert und bist für unsere Azubis eine feste Ansprechperson.

Dein Profil

  • Erfahrung: etwa 4–5 Jahre in der professionellen Softwareentwicklung (ein Richtwert, keine harte Grenze)
  • PHP: fundierte Kenntnisse in modernem PHP 8.x mit objektorientierter Architektur, etwa Dependency Injection, Interfaces und SOLID
  • Symfony: nachweisbare Praxiserfahrung mit dem Framework
  • Legacy-Code: Du gehst sicher mit gewachsenen Codebasen um. Du refaktorierst, debuggst und entwickelst weiter, ohne alles neu zu schreiben.
  • JavaScript/React: solide Erfahrung im Frontend, jQuery schreckt dich nicht ab
  • Datenbanken: relationale Datenbanken wie MySQL/MariaDB oder SingleStore und sicherer Umgang mit SQL
  • Tooling: Git und Arbeit mit CI/CD
  • Sprache: Deutsch auf C1-Niveau, Englisch mindestens B1
  • Arbeitsweise: eigenständig, strukturiert, proaktiv und mit hohem Qualitätsanspruch
  • Persönlich: Du kommunizierst verlässlich, arbeitest gern im Team, übernimmst Verantwortung, hast keine Angst vor schwierigen Codestellen und gibst dein Wissen gern weiter.
  • Abschluss: Ausbildung oder FH-Abschluss zählen bei uns genauso viel wie ein Uni-Studium. Entscheidend ist deine Praxiserfahrung.

Pluspunkte: REST/API-Design und Schnittstellenentwicklung, automatisiertes Testing (PHPUnit, Jest), Docker, Deployment-Pipelines und Cloud, Software-Architektur und Design Patterns, produktiver Einsatz von KI-Tools wie Claude Code oder Codex. Erfahrung mit Software für den öffentlichen Sektor ist nicht nötig.

Dein Team

Ein kleines Team mit kurzen Wegen: Daniel (Developer Lead), Nico (Geschäftsführer & Projektmanager), der selbst aktiv mitentwickelt, ein externer Entwickler und zwei Auszubildende. Ihr stimmt euch täglich ab. Daniel und Nico übernehmen dein Onboarding persönlich.

Was wir bieten

  • Ein sinnstiftendes Produkt, das täglich in Bürgerämtern genutzt wird, in einem krisensicheren Markt
  • Echter Einfluss auf technische Entscheidungen und eine Modernisierung mit klarem Ziel
  • 30 Urlaubstage
  • Gleitzeit mit Kernzeit ab 10 Uhr, 2 Remote-Tage pro Woche
  • Weiterbildung während der Arbeitszeit, z. B. Udemy-Kurse; eigene Vorschläge sind willkommen
  • Claude-Lizenz, offen für weitere Tools
  • Hardware: Lenovo ThinkPad, offen für Vorschläge
  • UrbanSportsClub und JobRad
  • Gute Anbindung: S1 und Busse M48, 101, 115

So läuft der Bewerbungsprozess

  • Kennenlerngespräch mit Sara
  • Technisches Interview mit Live-Projektarbeit mit Nico und Daniel
  • Teamgespräch vor Ort
  • Angebot

Über Girona

Seit über 25 Jahren entwickelt die Girona Softwareentwicklung GmbH in Berlin Software für die öffentliche Verwaltung. Städte wie Berlin, München, Bonn und Dessau setzen seit Jahrzehnten auf unsere Lösungen, Konsentas etwa in Bürgerämtern, Gesundheitsämtern sowie Kfz-Zulassungs- und Führerscheinstellen.

Du willst ein bewährtes Produkt fit für die Zukunft machen? Dann freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung.

You’ll provide hands-on support to managers at all levels, owning day-to-day people work and helping teams grow and scale effectively.

Your GTM partnership will span teams such as Sales, Technical Success, Partnerships and Marketing. Across your portfolio, you’ll build a deep understanding of business priorities and use that context to prioritise and deliver practical people support.

As a hands-on partner to managers at all levels, you will use independent judgment to coach managers, resolve people issues and follow through on day-to-day work as teams scale. As our Senior Industrial Engineer, you turn that ambition into a production system. title: Senior Intelligence Officer, Information & Cybersecurity
descriptionHtml:
Mission Brief 

You are the founder of our Intelligence & Foresight unit. Knowing who is targeting Isar Aerospace, how and why, whether physically, in cyberspace or through our supply chain, is mission critical. You build our all-source intelligence capability from the ground up and run it: turning signals into decisions for leadership, running our sources and platforms, owning the tooling that feeds our defenders, and setting the tradecraft standards the unit grows on. 

Your Role in Our Space Mission 

  • Build the practice: design the intelligence programme end to end, from Priority Intelligence Requirements (PIRs) agreed with leadership through collection, analysis and dissemination, and document it so it scales. 
  • Protect launch operations: own the threat picture across every launch cycle, pre-launch to post-launch, across physical, cyber, insider and supply chain vectors, in liaison with Andøya Space, Norwegian authorities and our site security teams. 
  • Run collection and sources: task and operate our dark web and threat intelligence platforms, conduct or oversee lawful persona-based engagement in underground forums, manage external providers, grade every source for reliability, incentives and circularity, and apply the legal and operational security safeguards this work demands. 
  • Fuse and assess: bring physical, geopolitical, labour, supply chain and cyber developments into one threat picture, and track the actors, campaigns and vulnerabilities relevant to space, defence and manufacturing. 
  • Deliver and operationalise: produce strategic assessments for leadership, operational reporting for incident response and physical security, and curated indicators, detections and hunts for the SOC mapped to MITRE ATT&CK. Own the threat intelligence platform and feeds; automate ingestion, enrichment and reporting in Python. 
  • Grow the capability: act as intelligence lead during incidents, maintain liaison with national authorities, police, ISACs and industry peers, and mentor the analysts who join the unit. 

Qualification Checklist 

We do not expect hands-on depth in every area; tell us where you are strong and where you would rely on partners or tooling. 

  • Experience: 7+ years in threat intelligence or adjacent fields, ideally government, military, law enforcement, security vendor or MSSP; a relevant degree or equivalent experience; a track record of building intelligence capabilities, not only consuming them. 
  • Source Handling: running or handling human sources, online or otherwise, including persona-based engagement in underground communities; assessing reliability, incentives and exposure to manipulation; operating lawfully, ethically and with discretion. 
  • Analytic Tradecraft: structured analytic techniques, Admiralty Code source evaluation, analysis of competing hypotheses, estimative language, Diamond Model and MITRE ATT&CK, applied to hybrid threats where state and non-state actors combine physical, cyber, influence and economic means against critical infrastructure and operational sites. 
  • Technical and Tooling: strong Python; hands-on with a threat intelligence platform (e.g. MISP, OpenCTI), STIX/TAXII, APIs and feed integration into SIEM, EDR and email security; able to pivot on indicators and validate cyber findings yourself. 
  • Communication: concise, bottom-line-first briefings for executive and technical audiences; trusted relationships with internal and external partners. Fluent English required; Norwegian or German strongly preferred. 
  • Security Clearance: due to the sensitive nature of this role, candidates must be eligible to obtain and maintain any security clearances required under applicable legal, regulatory, customer or contractual requirements. Continued employment in this role may be subject to maintaining such clearance. 
  • Security Screening: appointment to this role is subject to a pre-employment security screening appropriate to the sensitivity of the position, conducted with the candidate’s consent and in line with applicable laws. 

Bonus Skills 

  • Aerospace, defence, launch or critical infrastructure background; work with sector ISACs (e.g. Space ISAC) or national authorities; GIAC GCTI or CREST CRTIA; export control familiarity (EAR, ITAR, EU dual-use); hands-on building of collection tooling (scrapers, crawlers, monitoring) for dark web sources.

Benefits 

  • Employee Participation Program: Share in our success through our virtual company share program
  • 6 weeks of vacation: Enjoy the days off to relax and recharge
  • Subsidised lunch: Stay energised with delicious, subsidised lunches every day
  • Relocation support: Benefit from our relocation bonus with deductible expenses up to an agreed amount
  • Wellness allowance: Stay healthy and fit with our yearly allowance for wellness activities (e.g., Gym, Massages)
  • Individual learning allowance: Grow your skills with an individual learning budget granted after the probation period
  • Physical and mental well-being: Access via OpenUp the online support from certified psychologists and lifestyle experts at no cost to you and your family
  • And Much More! Discover additional perks and benefits when you join our team.  

Who we are

We are Isar Aerospace and we are at the forefront of New Space building a modern space business to enable faster, better and cheaper access to space.

Our mission is to help democratise space and use it for good in order to improve life on Earth now and for the future generations.

We are a fast-growing company aiming to provide sustainable and environmentally friendly launch solutions for small and medium-sized satellites and constellations into Low Earth Orbit. The company is privately funded by world-leading technology investors with strong commitment and support and our team is made of driven and talented people with a real passion for space innovation.

We're making rockets in a way that hasn't been done before disrupting a traditional industry. If you are up for the challenge, want to work on cutting-edge projects and be part of a team changing the world for better, come, join us and launch your career!

title: Senior Legal Counsel
descriptionHtml:
About Zego 🚀

At Zego, we're on a mission to do the good thing, not the insurance thing.

Insurance hasn't changed much in over a century. The way we live, work and travel has. We're building the real-time, AI-driven infrastructure that powers innovative insurance, so good drivers get cover that works the way they actually drive.

We're not just updating insurance; We're leading the AI evolution in insurance 🤖

For us, AI isn't a line on a roadmap or a buzzword on a slide. It's our operating reality, and it's how we build products that back drivers instead of the old insurance playbook.

We don't do things slowly, and we don't do bureaucracy. We back high-performance builders who want ownership, early responsibility and the chance to do the most career-defining work of their lives. You'll get the space to try things, the tools to move fast, and the room to see your ideas reach millions of drivers.

Do not take our word for it. Read what Zegons say about us on Glassdoor.

If you're ready to build the future of insurance, we're hiring.

Purpose of the role

As Senior Legal Counsel, you will be Zego’s senior in-house lawyer, owning legal matters across the business and working closely with senior stakeholders as Zego continues to grow. Reporting to the Group CFO, you will work alongside Compliance and the wider Legal and Regulatory Affairs (LRA) team.

It’s a varied, hands-on role with a high degree of ownership and autonomy. You will be the go-to person for legal advice across the business: advising on key decisions, drafting and negotiating commercial contracts, and instructing external counsel where needed. This is an individual contributor role with no line management.

A particular focus will be insurance law and regulation, which sits at the heart of Zego’s business, alongside a broad range of commercial and contractual matters. You’ll work closely with colleagues responsible for compliance, financial crime and risk, providing legal advice on the regulatory questions that arise, while those teams retain responsibility for their respective areas.

What you will be doing

  • Insurance distribution and capacity. Draft and negotiate binding authority agreements, co-insurance and cooperation agreements, claims handling agreements, reinsurance-related documents.

  • Insurance products. Work with Underwriting, Product and Claims on policy wordings, endorsements and coverage questions, including large losses.

  • Regulatory legal advice. Advise on the structuring of insurance arrangements, including binding authority agreements, insurer and distribution relationships, regulatory permissions and perimeter questions, and the legal and regulatory requirements that apply to Zego's insurance and lending activities.

  • Commercial. Draft and negotiate supplier, outsourcing, technology, partnership and data sharing agreements, including material outsourcing terms required by FCA and GFSC rules.

  • Corporate and governance. Support board and committee governance, intra-group agreements, financing and capital projects, and company secretarial work in the UK and Gibraltar.

  • Legal operations. Keep templates, playbooks and self-serve tools current so the business can handle routine matters (such as NDAs) without Legal.

  • External counsel. Scope instructions, manage budgets and hold firms to account on quality and timing.

What you'll need to be successful:

  • Qualified to practise in England and Wales, with around 6+ years' PQE gained at a law firm, in-house, or both.

  • Substantial experience of insurance law and regulation, ideally advising an MGA, broker or insurer.

  • Experienced in drafting and negotiating complex commercial agreements, with sound judgement on which points matter and which to concede.

  • Comfortable working on your own with a high volume of varied matters and competing deadlines.

  • Able to explain legal risk clearly and briefly to senior leaders and boards, and to give a recommendation, not only the options.

  • Commercially minded: you find a way to get the business where it needs to go while protecting the company's interests.

  • Organised, with good records and clear file notes.

Desirable experience

  • Gibraltar insurance law or GFSC-regulated business.

  • Delegated authority, co-insurance or reinsurance arrangements.

  • Insurtech, fintech or another high-growth regulated business.

  • Corporate finance, capital raising or M&A.

  • Consumer credit or premium finance.

The Zego ways of working 🏡

Teams work better with time to collaborate and space to get things done. We call it Zego Hybrid: some of us are in our office (central London, Gibraltar or Halifax) weekly, others monthly or quarterly. It's about finding the balance between face time and focus that produces great work and a healthy life around it.

We also make a point of getting everyone in the same room. Teams come together every quarter, and once a year the whole company does, properly. It's a serious investment and consistently one of the best parts of the year.

💰 Market-competitive salary, benchmarked against your function and reviewed every year.

🏆 Annual performance bonus, linked to company performance and your contribution.

📈 Share options, a real stake in the company and a share in the future you build

🏖️ Pension, generous holiday, and £1,000 a year to spend on getting to the office or learning something new.

💻 Cutting-edge systems and tools, so you always have what you need to drive your impact.

Ready to do the most impactful work of your career? We want to hear from you.
